blocks.text: Places to Visit in Prayagraj on your Trip

Hindu pilgrimage remains incomplete if you don’t happen to pay a visit to this sacred town which is undoubtedly one of the holiest lands in the world. Here are some popular points of interests covered in our Prayagraj itineraries .

items: Witness the most divine view of the confluence of the brown water of river Ganga with the green water of Yamuna and the mysterious Saraswati River.
It is one of the holiest pilgrimages for Hindu devotees. Take a holy dip to fine- tune your spirit with the pious energy of sacred waters.
Allahabad Fort is one of the famous tourist attractions. It was built by Akbar in 1583 AD.
Witness the three magnificent galleries, Ashoka pillar, Saraswati Koop (source of Saraswati River).
Located inside the fort is a sacred Akshay Vat. It is said that one who prays here or dies under it attains Moksha.
Mankameshwar Temple is dedicated to Lord Shiva. Witness the Shivlinga from 80 ft high hillock.
It is believed that the Shivlinga was installed by Lord Rama while going to Chitrakoot.
To trap and destroy Pandavas, Duryodhana constructed Lakshagriha. So, when it was set on fire, Vidur alerted Pandavas to escape from a secret door.
Visit here to witness and learn from the tales of Mahabharata.
The temple of ISKCON is located on the soothing banks of river Ganga.
What makes it the top spiritual place in Prayagraj is its profound significance for Hindu devotees.
The devotees can spend hours in meditation and offering Seva at Goshala and prayers to Sri Radha Veni Madhava deities.
It houses all the major Mughal tombs built in the 17th century. Consider it one of the best photography spots in Prayagraj.
Some of the most prominent tombs are Khusro Tomb. Prince Khusro was the elder son of Emperor Jahangir. You can also witness the tomb of Shah Begum, mother of Prince Khusro and wife of Jahangir.
Located in Chandra Shekhar Azad Park, Allahabad Museum is one of the most popular historical places in Prayagraj. It’s a national museum of Prayagraj.
Witness the historical artefacts, paintings, sculptures in various galleries.
It is located 3km from Allahabad Railway junction, the scenic garden of the museum will seduce your soul and compel you to take pictures for Instagram.

items: Amarnath Yatra by Helicopter with Kashmir Tour

blocks.text: One of the most astonishing pilgrimages of Hindus, Amarnath Yatra is an annual pilgrimage covered by thousands of devotees

items: Route: Arrival Srinagar → Srinagar Sonamarg - Baltal → Baltal - Holy Cave - Baltal → Sonamarg - Srinagar → Srinagar - Gulmarg - Srinagar → Srinagar - Katra

blocks.text: Welcome to Srinagar/Jammu, You are greeted on arrival at Srinagar Airport/ Jammu Railway Station by My Quick Trippers representative and Transfer to Srinagar, on arrival check inn at Hotel, Overnight stay at Srinagar.
Day 2: Srinagar Sonamarg - Baltal (90 kms / 3 hrs)
Morning after Breakfast transfer to Sonmarg known as ‘Meadow of Gold’ on the valley of River Sindhu. View magnificent picturesque mountain ranges, overnight stay at Tents in Baltal.

Early morning proceed to Amarnath Caves or to helipad. (Helicopter Services is subject to weather conditions). Helicopter operates till Panchtarni, It is about 6kms from pantarni to holy cave. You can reach to the cave by pony/palki (yours cost) or by walk. After Darshan return in time to Helipad to take back Helicopter to Baltal. Overnight in Baltal, In case of late, you can stay in Panctarni at own cost. Places You’ll See

Morning proceed to Srinagar for local sightseeing at Srinagar which includes Mughal Gardens, Nishat Bagh, Cheshma Shahi (The Royal Spring) built by Shah Jahan in 1636 AD, Nishat Bagh (The Garden of Pleasure) laid out by Jahangir for his beloved Noor Jahan in 1632 AD. Round off the trip with a visit to the Oriental Kashmir Carpet factory and Shankaracharya temple, Dinner & overnight stay in houseboat/Hotel. Places You’ll See

After breakfast drive to Gulmarg, also known as the ‘Meadow of Flowers’. Enjoy a fun-filled pony ride and gondola rides (on direct payment), Gulmarg is primarily famous for its golf course with 18 holes and has one of the best ski slopes in the world, later drive back to Srinagar. Dinner &overnight stay at Gulmarg. Places You’ll See

Morning after breakfast drive to Katra, the journey will take you through breath talking mountains, forests covered with pine trees and Asia’s longest Tunnel (Jawahar Tunnel) on arrival check inn at Hotel, overnight stay at hotel.
Early morning trek to Mata Vaishno Devi shrine (12 kms), ponies can hired directly, after Darshan return back to Katra, Overnight Stat at Katra. Places You’ll See

After breakfast transfer to Jammu & Visit Famous Raghunath Temple, later transfer to Amritsar, on arrival check in at hotel & transfer to visit Indo-Pak Wagah Border to watch Flag Retreat Ceremony, overnight Stay at Amritsar. Places You’ll See

After breakfast, start your city tour with the blessings of Golden temple visit Jallianwala Bagh, Durgiana Temple. Here tour ends with happy memories as you drop to the Amritsar airport/Railway station for journey to onward destination. Places You’ll See

seo.meta_description: Discover the Andaman Islands with 7 Days / 6 Nights tour packages, featuring pristine beaches and unforgettable experiences.

og_tags.og:title: Andaman Cheap Tour Packages – 7 Days / 6 Nights
og_tags.og:description: Discover the Andaman Islands with 7 Days / 6 Nights tour packages, featuring pristine beaches and unforgettable experiences.

blocks.text: The Andaman Cheap Tour Packages offer an affordable yet enriching experience of the Andaman Islands, combining natural beauty and historical exploration.

The tour starts with a visit to Port Blair's Corbyns Cove Beach and the Cellular Jail, followed by a trip to Neil Island, known for its clear waters and sandy beaches. You’ll explore popular spots like Bharatpur Beach, Laxmanpur Beach, and Radha Nagar Beach on Havelock Island, with options for water activities like glass-bottom boat rides. The package also includes visits to North Bay Island, Ross Island, and a Harbour Cruise to Viper Island, offering a mix of nature and history.

With comfortable accommodations and a relaxed pace, the tour allows ample time for sightseeing and leisure. Whether enjoying the serene beaches or exploring historical sites, this package provides a memorable way to experience the beauty and culture of the Andaman Islands at an affordable price.
Day 1 : Pick up from Port Blair Airport– Sightseeing

Get a warm welcome at Port Blair Airport by our representative, and take a drive for the hotel. Welcome drink on check in to the hotel. After relaxing some time you will start the tremendous tour to Corbyns Cove Beach, one of the most picturesque, Enjoy coconut palm fringed beach which is located at just 7 KMs away from Port Blair city, Visit Cellular Jail-an auspicious place for all liberty loving persons. You can also see the history of the heroic freedom fight which is brought alive in a moving Light & Sound Show at the Cellular Jail. In evening come back to hotel, enjoy your night meal and stay overnight in Port Blair.

Take a departure in early morning by inter-island ferry to Neil Island (Approx 90 Minutes- 45 KMs), an island with clear turquoise sea and white sand beaches. On reaching just check in to your hotel, enjoy your breakfast later on visit Sitapur viewpoint, Bharatpur Beach- this is one of the most attractive beaches in Andaman. You can also enjoy a ride in a glass bottomed boat to see under water corals and marine life (Optional – extra cost). Late in afternoon visit to the Laxmanpur Beach II to view the natural coral bridge and also go to Laxmanpur Beach I to see the sunset. You can use your evening at leisure or exploring by self. Enjoy your dinner and overnight stay at hotel in Neil Island.

After breakfast take the transfer to Neil Island, take the inter-island ferry to Havelock Island (Approx 2 Hrs, 55 KMs). Enjoy your afternoon at Beach Number 7 which is also known as Radha Nagar Beach. Return back to your hotel at late evening, Enjoy your night meal & overnight stay at hotel in Havelock.
Enjoy your breakfast, later you can go on an optional trip to Elephant Beach (for Extra cost), or you may use it as leisure time or explore your own interest. Stay overnight at hotel in Havelock.
Day 5 : Havelock Island – Port Blair (Approx 57 kms by sea – 3Hrs)

After breakfast, check out from the hotel and head to Kalapathar Beach for a visit. Later, proceed to the Havelock jetty to board your return ferry to Port Blair. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel. Enjoy an overnight stay in Port Blair.

After breakfast get ready to see stunning sightseeing tours of North Bay Island followed by Ross Island, The island presently houses the ruins of old buildings like Chief Commissioner’s House, Church, Bakery, Government House, Press, Cemetery, Swimming Pool, etc. and all in decrepit condition. Later on you can enjoy a Harbour Cruise which includes a trip to tiny, serene, beautiful island called “VIPER ISLAND” where you can see the Gallows’s sight. At evening come back to your hotel. Enjoy your dinner & overnight stay in Port Blair.

After breakfast take a drive to Port Blair airport for your onward scheduled journey. We hope that you had a memorable tour around Andaman- Nicobar, also we wish to see you soon for your next journey. Have a safe & enjoy full journey ahead.

blocks.text: Top Places to Visit in Assam on Your Trip

Assam is among the fastest developing tourist destinations in India. In 2024- 2025 till December, Assam welcomed around 57,48,772 domestic tourists and 14,000 foreign tourists which makes it one of the top choices for tourists to visit in India. Source- ( Business Standard ). Assam has many amazing tourist attractions. Naming all at once would not be possible but here is a list of must visit places in Assam which are covered in our Assam itineraries. You can also add as many places as you want according to your choice.

items: Explore Kaziranga National Park in Assam, it is one of the most popular wildlife destinations for adventure and nature lovers. It shelters two-thirds of the world’s population of one-horned Rhinos.

You have to book a thrilling Jeep Safari or Elephant Safari in advance to witness the rich biodiversity of the park and wild creatures like Rhinos, Tigers, Elephants, wild buffaloes and various bird species which includes migratory birds and endangered bird species.

Situated in the serene Brahmaputra River, Umananda Island is a must visit place in Assam. It’s a scenic natural wonder worth visiting for awesome natural views. It hosts the beautiful Umananda Temple which is dedicated to Lord Shiva.
Seek divine blessings of Lord Shiva, spot golden langurs and enjoy a ferry ride to this beautiful island.

You must visit Kamakhya Temple in Assam. It is one of the landmark destinations due to its spiritual significance for Hindu Devotees. The temple is a Shakti Peetha, dedicated to the mother goddess Kamakhya.

It is located in the Nilachal Hill in Guwahati. In this temple location, it is believed that the Yoni (reproductive organ) of goddess Sati fell. Ma Kamakhya is a symbol of fertility and feminine creative power in Hinduism.
The festival of Ambubachi celebrates the feminine energy and annual menstrual cycle of Goddess Kamakhya.

Majuli Island is one of the famous tourist places in Assam to capture awe-inspiring Naturescapes. It is the world's largest river island which is very famous for its Neo- Vaishnavite culture and monastic institutions.
During Monsoon, the island submerged under water. May is the best time to explore Majuli Island.
Haflong Located in Dima Hasao district of Assam, Haflong is an enchanting hill station in Assam. It is in fact the only Hill station of Assam.
Capture the scenic beauty of lush green forests, scenic hills, enjoy boating and fun-filled picnics with your loved ones.
It is very famous for Vibrant Dimasa tribal culture, trekking, paragliding and local flower gardens.

Sivasagar used to be the capital of Ahom Kingdom. It is a very popular tourist attraction in Assam for history , heritage and culture. There are many ancient temples like Sivadol, palaces like Rang Ghar, Kareng Ghar and large water tanks.
You will also witness beautiful heritage attractions like Charaideo Maidam which displays Assam’s archaeological and royal past.
Listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in Assam, Manas National Park is a paradise for wildlife enthusiasts. Spot rare wildlife like golden Langurs and pygmy hogs.
Enjoy river rafting, jungle safaris along with the scenic views of Manas River, alluvial grasslands, tropical evergreen forests, and majestic Himalayan hills.

blocks.text: Things to Do in Assam on Your Trip
While enjoying Assam sightseeing Tour, here are some of the best things to do in Assam which will make your Assam vacations fun-filled and memorable-

items: Perfect for nature lovers, romantic couples and families, Visit Kakochang waterfalls in Assam. This scenic waterfall flows between the rubber and coffee plantations of Jorhat.

It attracts tourists throughout the year. Enjoy scenic views of the ruins of Numaligarh and lush green tea plantations. Post-monsoon months are the best months to explore the scenic beauty of this enchanting waterfall.

It is one of the most interesting places to visit in Assam. Established in 1911, it is one of the oldest tea research stations in the world. Assam’s tea quality needs no introduction. So, here you will witness how authentic research on extraction, cultivation and processing of tea is done.
The research is done to enhance the nutritional value of tea. It also conducts tea tasting tours for the tourists.
Don’t miss the ancient pilgrimage site in Assam known as Hajo. Located on the serene banks of Brahmaputra River. It features many ancient temples and sacred artifacts.
Hayagriva Madhava Temple and Hajo Powa Mecca are the two most prominent tourist attractions which you must not miss.
Your Assam holidays will be incomplete without enjoying thrilling wildlife safaris in Assam at various national parks like Kaziranga, Manas, Nameri National Park etc.

Assam is a very popular tourist destination for wildlife lovers. Its forests, wetlands, grasslands shelter various rare and endangered faunas and floras making it one of the best biodiversity spots to explore in India.
Don’t miss the enchanting Silk Village of Assam - Sualkuchi. It is also known as the Manchester of Assam.
The village is very famous for the craft of Silk weaving which dates back to ancient times. You will witness various types of Silk like Muga, Pat, Eri (Ahimsa silk), and Endi cloth here.
Explore Brahmaputra River in Assam. It is a must visit spot to enjoy the beauty of Assam Tourism. Not only it’s a popular destination for nature lovers but also, it’s a paradise for adventure lovers.
Enjoy adventure activities such as river rafting and cruises on the Brahmaputra, kayaking, trekking and birdwatching.

blocks.text: Enjoy a 5 Day spiritual and adventure trip to the captivating mountains of Uttarakhand- Dev Bhoomi.

blocks.text: Day 1: Arrival in Delhi - Srinagar (320-340 kms/10 Hrs.)

What you’ll Get- Our travel representative will pick you up at Delhi airport/ railway station and then you will be driven to Srinagar. Important Stops- On the way, we will explore Devprayag. It is a place where two holy rivers Bhagirathi and Alaknanda meet and merge to form river Ganga. What to do- Taking a holy dip into the Sangam is spiritually enriching. The holy bath is believed to absolve all the sins and karmic backlog of the devotees. Thereafter, check in to your pre-booked hotel for an overnight stay. Places You’ll See
Day 2: Srinagar - Rudraprayag – Karnaprayag Nandprayag- Joshimath- Auli (150 kms / 7-8 Hrs.)

What you’ll get- Morning after breakfast, you will be driven to Auli. It’s a beautiful hill station and one of the top ski resort destinations in India . On your way to Auli, enjoy many beautiful scenic spots along the way. Important Stops- Rudraprayag- Witness the beauty of the sacred confluence of Alaknanda and Mandakini River Karnaprayag- Capture the scenic confluence of Alaknanda and Pindar River Nandprayag- See the breathtaking confluence of Alaknanda and Nandakini river Vridha Badri- Visit one of the Sapt Badri Temples dedicated to Lord Vishnu. Joshimath- Visit Joshimath, winter seat of lord Badri. Seek divine blessings. Auli- Enjoy the scenic beauty of Auli. It’s one of the stunning hill stations to enjoy snow adventure activities. Thereafter, check into your hotel room for overnight stay at Auli. Places You’ll See
Day 3: Auli Skiing Adventure (January to March)

What you’ll get- Morning after breakfast, you will witness the breathtaking views of the snowy peaks of Auli and the stunning Alaknanda Valley. What you’ll do- Enjoy a full day ski adventure with your loved ones. Optional- If you want to explore nearby scenic spots then you must visit- Chattrakund- Small scenic lake surrounded with Himalayan mountains and lush greenery. Saildhar Tapovan- It is very famous for its hot water springs and sacred temples. You can also buy traditional handicrafts of the region as a souvenir here. Auli artificial Lake- It’s a beautiful turquoise lake surrounded by the majestic Himalayan slopes. Kwani Bugyal- Enjoy lush greenery, beauty of snow-laden mountain peaks. It’s a great spot for trekking adventures. Gorson Bugyal- Surrounded by the dense forests of Oak and conifers, you must visit Gorson Bugyal. It’s a nature lover paradise. Also witness the majestic Nanda Devi, Dron and Trishul Parvat. After Auli sightseeing Tour , get back to your hotel room for an overnight stay. Places You’ll See
Day 4: Auli/ Joshimath Drive. Shivpuri Camping (270 kms/ 8Hrs)

What you’ll get- After breakfast, we will drive to Joshimath. You will visit some of the most popular spiritual spots in Joshimath to seek divine blessings. Important Stops- Narasimha Temple- It’s a part of Sapt Badri Temple dedicated to the fourth Avatar of lord Vishnu- Lord Narasimha (Half Lion and Half Man) Bhavishya Kedar- Visit this small temple dedicated to Lord Shiva and goddess Parvati. It is believed to be the future home of Kedarnath. Jyotirmath- Also known as Shri Shankaracharya Math, Jyotirmath is a sanctuary for peace lovers. Get divine blessings of Laxmi Narayan at Laxmi Narayan temple located inside the math. After Joshimath sacred sightseeing tour , Drive to Shivpuri to enjoy camping with your loved ones At the camp- Enjoy evening tea & snacks, delightful campfire stories, star gazing and delicious food. blocks.text: Ayodhya tour packages offer one-of-a-kind spiritual, cultural and historical experiences. Not only is it the most popular sacred destination for Hindu devotees, it is also a historical city and a cultural hub of living traditions. Devotees are mostly drawn to its sacred significance as the birthplace of Lord Rama, and Ayodhya is strongly linked to spirituality and Hindu mythology. Situated along the sacred Sarayu River's banks, the holy city is deeply linked with the Ramayana — referred to as the ancient Kosala Kingdom's capital in the epic. The city enjoys a special place in the hearts of all Hindus, and many devotees choose the Ayodhya pilgrimage trip to seek spiritual solace and closeness to God.

In 2024, Ayodhya recorded over 203 million visitors, strengthening its position as one of the leading spiritual destinations in India. Ayodhya's significance has grown further after the consecration of the Ram Janmabhoomi Mandir on 22 January 2024 — a moment millions of devotees had awaited for decades.
Why Choose My Quick Trippers for Your Ayodhya Tour Package?

The sacred city of Ayodhya has a lot to offer - whether it's the pious Ghats, unique architecture, stunning temples, or vibrant local markets. At My Quick Trippers, we understand travellers' mindsets and curate Ayodhya itineraries that help you explore in a carefree and comfortable way. Our Ayodhya travel packages cover:

items: Guided tours by licensed, experienced local guides
Best hotels as per the itinerary
Senior-citizen-friendly itineraries with paced schedules and rest breaks
Footwear counter assistance and queue guidance at Ram Janmabhoomi
Sarayu Aarti coordination at Ram Ki Paidi

blocks.text: Don't wait - book your Ayodhya Yatra today!
Other Reasons to Visit Ayodhya in 2026

items: Ayodhya has numerous places which will transport you back to the Treta Yuga. You can relive the tales of the Ramayana.
Witness festivals related to Lord Rama - Ram Navami, Dussehra, and Deepotsav - celebrated here with unmatched devotion as this is the birthplace of Lord Rama.
Visit the original birthplace of Lord Rama - Ram Janmabhoomi. This is the most iconic landmark in Ayodhya which you must not miss.
Maharishi Valmiki International Airport now connects Ayodhya directly to Delhi, Mumbai, and other major cities - 2026 is the most connected year to visit.
Ayodhya is one of the seven Sapta Moksha Puris - sacred cities believed to grant moksha. A visit here holds the highest spiritual merit for Hindu pilgrims.
The new Ram Path corridor, upgraded Ghats, and modern amenities make sightseeing more comfortable than ever before.

blocks.text: Best Time to Go for an Ayodhya Trip

Standard Ayodhya tours start from INR 18,900 (hotels, meals, transfers, Darshan assistance, guide). Luxury package go up to INR 38,500 with luxury hotels, private car, VIP Darshan assistance, and a tour guide. We have packages for every budget.

October to March are the best months to travel to Ayodhya. During this time you can explore Ayodhya's famous temples and sacred places comfortably. The weather stays pleasant for sightseeing and strolling the Ghats for hours. Outdoor activities like boating on the Sarayu are also fully enjoyable.

Summer is not a favourable season to explore Ayodhya. The day's heat can be exhausting, especially for senior citizens and children. If you do visit in April, plan all temple visits before 9 AM and after 5 PM.

Heavy rains from July to September will disrupt sightseeing plans and boat rides on the Sarayu River. Ghat steps become slippery and unsafe. You may miss out on key activities and not be able to enjoy the full potential of your Ayodhya travel package. Avoid this season unless you are visiting specifically for Sawan (Shravan) religious observances.
Festival Special — Plan Around These 2026 Dates
Note: During Ram Navami and Deepotsav, Ayodhya attracts lakhs of additional visitors. Hotel prices rise and availability drops quickly. Book well in advance for festival travel.
Places to Visit on Your Ayodhya Trip

Ayodhya holds a special place in the hearts of Hindus as the birthplace of Lord Rama. Beyond its spiritual significance, the city also offers deep historical and cultural experiences. Here are the best places to include in your Ayodhya holiday package:
Ram Janmabhoomi Mandir (Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra)

items: This is the most iconic place in Ayodhya and the single most important reason millions visit every year. The grand temple was consecrated on 22 January 2024 after decades of anticipation.

As the name suggests, this is the place where Lord Rama was born as per Hindu scripture. The temple is built in the Nagara style using pink Rajasthani sandstone and houses the idol of Ram Lalla (infant Rama) in the main sanctum.
For a peaceful Darshan, visit on weekday mornings. VIP Darshan passes are available at the temple counter for priority access.

Resting atop a hill with 76 steps leading to the entrance, Hanuman Garhi is a prominent Lord Hanuman temple. It is customary in Ayodhya to seek Hanuman ji's blessings here before visiting Ram Janmabhoomi.
Devotees commonly offer Ladoo Prasad — easily available from vendors outside. The panoramic views of Ayodhya from the top are stunning, and the temple architecture is a sight to behold.
This stunning temple, also known locally as 'Sone Ka Ghar' (House of Gold), is believed to have been gifted to Goddess Sita by Queen Kaikeyi as a wedding present.
Devotees love the exquisitely adorned golden-crowned idols of Lord Rama and Sita, and the intricate carvings on the temple walls. It is one of the most photographed temples in Ayodhya.

blocks.text: Located a few kilometres from Ayodhya, Bharat Kund is the sacred spot where Bharat — Lord Rama's devoted brother — performed penance for 14 years during Rama's exile, awaiting his return. The Kund (sacred tank) here is considered holy.

items: This temple is famous as the site where Lord Rama performed the Ashwamedha Yagna. Visiting during Diwali, when the temple is decorated beautifully, is an experience like no other.
Unique to this temple: the idols of Lord Rama, Sita, Lakshmana, and Hanuman are carved from black sandstone, giving them a rare look not found in other Ayodhya temples.

blocks.text: This memorial is dedicated to the poet-saint Tulsidas, the author of Ramcharitmanas. Regular recitals of the Ramayana are performed here, along with other spiritual and cultural events.

items: This popular museum houses manuscripts, artefacts, and paintings related to the Ramayana and Lord Rama.
The museum takes about 1–2 hours to explore fully, offering a deep understanding of the city's cultural heritage.
Gulab Bari is a beautiful 18th-century mausoleum and garden complex of Nawab Shuja-ud-Daula — a fascinating piece of Mughal-era history within a Hindu pilgrimage city.
Capture the stunning rose gardens and Mughal-era architecture. Open from 4 AM to 7 PM.
Mani Parvat is a sacred hillock in Ayodhya. It is believed to be a part of the Sanjeevani hill that Lord Hanuman carried from the Himalayas to revive Lakshmana.
As Hanuman flew with the Sanjeevani Hill, a part of it fell here at Ayodhya — forming Mani Parvat. The view from the top offers a good perspective of the city.

blocks.text: Located in the northwest corner of the Ram Janmabhoomi complex, Sita Ki Rasoi is believed to be the kitchen where Goddess Sita cooked after her marriage with Lord Rama. The site houses idols of Rama, Sita, Lakshmana, Bharat, and Shatrughan, and carries a calm, intimate atmosphere.

One of Ayodhya's oldest temples, Nageshwarnath is dedicated to Lord Shiva and is believed to have been established by Kush, the son of Lord Rama. Significant during the Shivratri festival, it is the only temple that was maintained during Ayodhya's long period of obscurity.

Believed to be the palace of King Dashrath, father of Lord Rama, Dashrath Mahal features a colourful entrance, beautiful idols of Ram, Sita, and Lakshmana, and hosts daily Aarti and Bhajans. Located close to Ram Janmabhoomi, it fits into any Ayodhya Darshan plan.

Guptar Ghat is where Lord Rama is believed to have taken Jal Samadhi — leaving his earthly form and ascending to Vaikuntha through the sacred Sarayu waters. Beautiful temples surround the Ghat and the serene atmosphere makes it deeply moving, especially at sunrise.

Ram Ki Paidi is the main Ghat complex on the Sarayu riverfront and the heart of Ayodhya's spiritual evenings. The nightly Sarayu Aarti here — with lamps, conch shells, and devotional chanting — is one of Ayodhya's most beautiful experiences. During Deepotsav, this Ghat glows with hundreds of thousands of Diyas in a world-record setting.
Things to Do on Your Ayodhya Trip
Ayodhya is a sacred city centred on Lord Rama. While you are enjoying your Ayodhya travel package, make sure you do the following to get the most out of your experience:

items: All festivals related to Lord Rama take on a different meaning in Ayodhya. Ram Navami — celebrating Lord Rama's birth — is marked with grand processions and cultural events across the city.
Deepotsav and Diwali are where Ayodhya glows with millions of lamps to commemorate the return of Lord Rama. The riverfront during Deepotsav is truly unforgettable.
Guptar Ghat holds a special place among devotees as the site where Lord Rama left his earthly body. The site is surrounded by beautiful temples and tourists enjoy the calm ambiance.

blocks.text: Take a Boat Ride on the Sarayu River

items: A boat ride on the Sarayu River is a relaxing and beautiful way to see the ghats and temples from the water. The surrounding views are breathtaking. The best time is early morning or evening.

blocks.text: Ayodhya, being a spiritual centre, offers a variety of vegetarian dishes you must try:
Attend Sarayu Aarti at Ram Ki Paidi

Experience the divine atmosphere at the banks of the Sarayu River during the evening Aarti — with recitation of hymns, lamps, and chanting. Also attend the Mangala Aarti at Ram Janmabhoomi Mandir in the early morning for the most spiritually powerful start to your day (free Aarti pass required, collected from trust office 30 minutes before the Aarti).

items: Local bazaars near the Ghats and temples have a wide variety of souvenirs and spiritual goods.

From handmade artefacts to traditional sweets, there is much to explore. Ayodhya, being a religious hub, also offers temple bells, brass items, Rudraksha beads, religious books, and Ramayana scriptures.
Best shopping areas: Ram Ki Paidi market, Chowk Bazaar, Kanak Bhawan Temple shops, Faizabad Main Market, and the Tulsi Smarak Bhawan market.

blocks.text: Take a Holy Dip at the Sarayu River

A holy dip in the Sarayu River — particularly at Ram Ki Paidi or Guptar Ghat — is considered deeply auspicious. Pilgrims believe it cleanses sins and brings spiritual merit. The most sacred time is at sunrise.
Watch the Light and Sound Show

Ayodhya's Light and Sound Show (typically starting at 7:30 PM) narrates the story of the Ramayana through visual storytelling and light effects. It is a highly recommended evening activity, especially for families visiting with children.

Ayodhya now has its own airport: Maharishi Valmiki International Airport (AYJ), approximately 10 km from the city. Direct flights connect Ayodhya to Delhi, Mumbai, Ahmedabad, and Bengaluru. Lucknow Airport (LKO), 135 km away, is an alternative with wider connectivity. Our packages include airport pickup.

Ayodhya Dham Junction is the main railway station — recently upgraded and located about 1.5 km from Ram Janmabhoomi. Direct trains from Delhi (Vande Bharat, Ayodhya Express), Mumbai, Lucknow, Varanasi , Kolkata, and Prayagraj. Electric auto-rickshaws and e-cabs are available outside the station.

Ayodhya is connected via NH-27 and the Purvanchal Expressway. Regular buses and cabs are available from Lucknow (135 km, ~2.5 hrs), Varanasi (200 km, ~3.5 hrs), and Prayagraj (170 km, ~3 hrs). Note: private vehicles are not permitted near the Ram Janmabhoomi complex — e-rickshaws and walking are the only options within the temple zone.
Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Mandir Darshan Timings (2026)

rows: Early morning — collect free pass from trust office 30 mins prior
Darshan continues; pace slows around noon
Evening — Aarti pass required; temple closes after Shayan Aarti

blocks.text: Aarti passes are free and issued by the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust at their office 30 minutes before each Aarti. Carry a valid government ID (Aadhaar card). Only 30 devotees per session. VIP Darshan passes (paid, available at trust counter) allow faster access during peak times.
Frequently Asked Questions — Ayodhya Tour Packages
Q1. Is Ayodhya safe for tourists?

Ans: Ayodhya is normally considered safe for tourists. However, it's always good practice to be cautious and keep your belongings secure. Be respectful of local traditions and follow the guidelines at temple premises.
Q2. What are some rules for visiting temples in Ayodhya?

items: Remove your shoes before entering temple premises
Maintain silence as much as possible
Follow the queue system during busy hours
Always wear covered, modest clothing at temples and sacred sites
Accept Prasad with both cupped hands — not from the left hand alone
Take a bath before visiting; if not possible, ensure hands and feet are clean

blocks.text: Q3. What are the entry fees of the temples?

Ans: There are no entry fees for almost all temples in Ayodhya, including Ram Janmabhoomi Mandir, Hanuman Garhi, and Kanak Bhawan. Donations are appreciated. VIP Darshan passes are available at the Ram Janmabhoomi trust counter for priority access. Free Aarti passes (for Mangala, Sandhya, and Shayan Aarti) are issued at the trust office 30 minutes before each Aarti — carry your Aadhaar card.
Q4. What is the accommodation scene in Ayodhya?

Ans: Ayodhya has a wide range of accommodations — from Dharamshalas (₹300–800/night) to budget hotels (₹800–2,000), mid-range hotels (₹2,000–5,000), and 4-star/luxury properties (₹5,000+). New hotels have been opening rapidly since 2024. For peak season (October–March), Ram Navami, and Deepotsav, advance booking 2–3 months ahead is recommended.
Q5. How many days is enough for the Ayodhya trip?

Ans: Generally, a 2–3-day visit is enough to cover all major places such as Ram Janmabhoomi Temple, Kanak Bhawan, and Hanuman Garhi. For a combined Ayodhya + Varanasi + Prayagraj trip, plan for 5–7 days.
Q6. What are the best things to do in Ayodhya?

items: Visit all sacred temples and spots to experience devotion and inner peace
Take a holy dip in the Sarayu River at sunrise — believed to cleanse sins
Enjoy the pure vegetarian local food of Ayodhya
Explore the local markets for spiritual items — temple bells, brass items, Rudraksha beads, religious books, and deity footwear

blocks.text: Q7. How to plan a trip to Ayodhya?

Ans: Book a My Quick Trippers Ayodhya package to get rid of all travel logistics. Our dedicated team will prepare your complete itinerary and handle all arrangements — from transport and hotel to guided tours and meals. You are just one call away from the best Ayodhya pilgrimage of your life.
Q8. What is the best time to plan an Ayodhya trip?

Ans: October to March is the best time — the weather is ideal for spiritual sightseeing, taking a bath at the sacred Ghats, and other activities like boating and food tours, without the heat of summer or the heavy rains of monsoon.
Q9. What is the best place for shopping in Ayodhya?
Ans: Some of the best shopping areas in Ayodhya are Ram Ki Paidi market, Chowk Bazaar, Kanak Bhawan Temple shops, Faizabad Main Market, and the Tulsi Smarak Bhawan market.
Q10. Is a visit to Shri Ram Janmabhoomi included in Ayodhya tour package?
Ans: Yes, we include Ram Janmabhoomi Darshan in our Ayodhya package. If you want to include specific places not listed, you can simply customise your Ayodhya tour with us.
Q11. What are the most popular temples in Ayodhya covered in the tour?
Ans: Ayodhya has numerous temples. The most popular ones covered in our tour itineraries include:
Q12. What are the popular cuisines of Ayodhya to try?
Ans: You must try Ram Laddu, Kachori Sabzi, Chole Bhature, Lassi and Thandai, Jalebi, Puri Aloo, and Vegetable Pulao — some of the most popular foods when enjoying the hospitality of Ayodhya.
Q13. How do we get around within Ayodhya?

Ans: We arrange comfortable vehicles for all point-to-point transfers. Within Ayodhya, auto-rickshaws, private vehicles, and electric tempos are available for full-day sightseeing. For visitors with mobility issues, we have special arrangements including wheelchair assistance and private vehicles. Note: private vehicles are not permitted near the Ram Janmabhoomi temple zone — e-rickshaws are used for the final stretch.
Q14. What to pack for a trip to Ayodhya?

Ans: Pack decent, covered clothing for temple visits. Carry a stole to cover your head inside temple premises. Wear comfortable footwear that can be easily removed at sacred places. Keep a small bag for important documents (ID, phone, wallet). For summer, carry sunscreen and a cap. For winter (December–January), a light jacket is needed.
Q15. Do you have Ayodhya tour packages for couples?

Ans: Yes, our packages are a perfect deal for couples and young spiritually-inclined travellers looking for the best budget deals. Advance booking discounts apply. The package includes hotel, transport, meals, and guided tours. You can also add scenic Ghat walks, boating, or other activities.
Q16. What is VIP Darshan in Ayodhya? Is it available in your packages?
Ans: VIP Darshan allows visitors to get priority access to temples by bypassing long queues. Yes, we offer VIP Darshan assistance in our mid-range and luxury Ayodhya packages.
Q17. What places can we combine with the Ayodhya tour?

Ans: You can combine Ayodhya with Prayagraj, Varanasi, and Chitrakoot for a broader spiritual circuit of North India. These cities offer fascinating insights into the heritage and culture of Uttar Pradesh. We have combined packages available for all these routes.
Q18. What are the must-see Aartis in Ayodhya?

Ans: Apart from all the spiritual experiences, Aartis are a must-attend in Ayodhya. You should attend the Saryu River Aarti at Ram Ki Paidi and the Mangala Aarti and Sandhya Aarti at Ram Janmabhoomi Mandir.
Q19. What is the shoulder season in Ayodhya? Is it good to travel?

Ans: February to March is the shoulder season in Ayodhya. Temperatures begin to rise in March but travel is still comfortable. Hotels are cheaper during this period. You can also enjoy festivals like Holi and Vasant Panchami, which are celebrated with great energy in Ayodhya.

items: Badrinath Kedarnath Do Dham Yatra from Delhi

blocks.text: Welcome to the abodes of the Gods on your Badrinath Kedarnath Do Dham Yatra! Perched high in the serene Himalayas, the sacred temples are dedicated to the almighty Gods.

items: Route: Delhi – Haridwar → Haridwar – Guptkashi → Guptkashi – Sonprayag – Kedarnath → Kedarnath – Sonprayag – Rudraprayag → Rudraprayag – Badrinath Dham → Badrinath – Rudraprayag

blocks.text: Your Do Dham Yatra will commence from the time you arrive in New Delhi. Our tour representative will transfer you into your transportation that will drop you off at your first destination in Haridwar which is also known as the 'gateway to Char Dham' since all the Char Dham Yatras begin from Rishikesh and Haridwar. This will be a road journey of around 5-6 hours as you have decided to cover Badrinath Kedarnath Yatra by Car.On arrival in Haridwar, you shall be checked into your hotel or accommodation of your choice. If you want then you can also attend the iconic Ganga Aarti at Har Ki Pauri. You shall be staying overnight at the hotel here.Places You’ll See

After a delicious breakfast in the morning, you will be driven to your next destination of Guptkashi which is around 230 kms away from Haridwar. It will be an extremely scenic drive which will be one of the most scenic experiences of your life. You will reach there by lunch or pre-dinner time and will immediately be checked in to your hotel here for an overnight stay.If there is time for you to explore or if you are not tired much then you can even visit the famous Kashi Vishwanath Mandir here. The best option would be for you to go on a soulful leisurely walk and explore the surroundings nicely. You will be staying at your allotted hotel in Guptkashi.Places You’ll See

Early in the morning as the sun rises you shall be driven to your next destination for the day to Sonprayag. This is will be a short drive where you will be served lunch in between and will take just half an hour to 45 minutes to cover depending on the traffic.Sonprayag is a key checkpoint and registration point on the Kedarnath route. From Sonprayag, pilgrims take a shared jeep or taxi to Gaurikund (approx. 5 km) - which is the actual base camp and starting point of the 16-18 km Kedarnath trek.From here you will be able to choose to go on foot or hire some alternative method to travel like ponies or Pithu service. On reaching Kedarnath you will be staying in one of the tents or the hall accommodations here. After settling in, head to the temple for evening Darshan. Kedarnath Temple closes at approximately 8:00-9:00 PM after the evening Aarti. The post-Aarti Darshan is deeply peaceful - plan your visit accordingly.Places You’ll See

Early in the morning, you will be taken for the morning Aarti Darshan of Baba Kedar. The spirituality of this place when paired up with the purity of the morning sun rays is one experience that you need to have as words will not do justice. After this holy Darshan of Baba Kedar, you will be your trek back to the starting point of Sonprayag will begin.Here you will meet a driver who will then transfer you to your next destination of Rudraprayag which is around 60 kms away. It is one of the holiest Panch Prayags of Uttarakhand - the sacred confluence of the Mandakini and Alaknanda rivers. From here the Alaknanda flows further downstream, eventually meeting the Bhagirathi at Devprayag to form the holy Ganga.On reaching Rudraprayag you will be transferred to your allotted choice of accommodation here for an overnight stay.Places You’ll See

Early in the morning after breakfast, you will be transferred to your next destination of Badrinath via a car ride. Traveling through the hills guarantees picturesque vistas during your road trip. On your way, you will be made to visit and offer Darshan at Shri Narsingh Temple which is situated in the holy town of Joshimath that lies just before Badri Vishal.After covering a distance of 158 kms and finally arriving in Badrinath you will be checked into your hotel here for an overnight stay. In the evening after freshening up or if you are in the mood to explore your surroundings you will be taken for a brief sightseeing tour of tourist attractions in Badrinath. This will include Vyas Gufa, Mana Village (3km away), Saraswati River, Bheem Pul, etc.After completing your Badrinath Yatra if you want then you can attend the evening Aarti procession at Badri Vishal Temple. Later on, you will be made to head back to your accommodation in Badrinath town for an overnight stay.Places You’ll See

You will be made to visit the holy Badrinath temple early in the morning to attend the holy Aarti ceremony here. After the completion of your Darshan and puja rituals, you will be driven to your next destination for the day which will be Rudraprayag.After covering a scenic journey, you will be made to check in to your hotel for an overnight stay. The remainder of the day will be free for you to indulge in some leisurely activities like strolling around the holy village and relaxing amidst its scenic beauty. You shall be staying for the night in Rudraprayag.Places You’ll See

Your journey to Rishikesh will begin early in the morning after your breakfast. You will be driven to Rishikesh via a car journey which you will remember for a long time. You will cover a journey of around 133 kms and on arriving at Rishikesh you will be checked into your allotted hotel for an overnight stay.In the evening you will have a fun time in attending the holy Ganga Aarti at any of the ghats of Rishikesh.Places You’ll See

Your journey back home will commence early in the morning from Rishikesh via the road. It will be a trip of around 5-6 hours and you will be dropped off at your departure location at the New Delhi railway station. This final drop-off will mark the end of your Do Dham pilgrimage to Kedarnath and Badrinath.

blocks.text: If you are searching for a Badrinath tour package in 2026, the two questions most pilgrims ask first are the same: how much will it cost, and will someone handle everything so I do not have to figure it out myself?

Getting to Badrinath from any Indian city involves long-distance travel, a 10–12 hour mountain road drive, accommodation at 3,133 metres altitude, Yatra Registration , and temple logistics — all of which need advance coordination. Most pilgrims who try to plan this independently spend weeks on it and still arrive uncertain about what comes next.

My Quick Trippers is a Ministry of Tourism, Government of India approved operator with 17 years of Himalayan pilgrimage experience. We offer Badrinath Yatra packages starting from ₹18,500 per person — budget group options, standard private packages, deluxe tours, and helicopter packages — all fully managed from your departure city to your safe return.
What Is a Badrinath Tour Package?

A Badrinath tour package is an all-inclusive Badrinath pilgrimage tour covering travel to the temple and back. It includes hotel accommodation, pure vegetarian meals, private transport, VIP Darshan assistance, and a dedicated tour manager. Standard packages start from ₹18,500 per person (3N/4D Ex Haridwar) and go up to ₹75,000+ for helicopter packages. Duration ranges from 3 nights to 8 nights depending on departure city and package tier.

Badrinath Dham is one of the four sacred Char Dhams and one of the most essential pilgrimages for Hindu devotees across India. Dedicated to Lord Vishnu, the temple sits at 3,133 metres in the Garhwal Himalayas of Uttarakhand, on the banks of the Alaknanda River.

Badrinath is one of the 108 Divya Desams - the most sacred Vishnu shrines in the Vaishnava tradition and a realm of Moksha (liberation from the cycle of birth and death). Open to devotees for approximately six months each year, pilgrims from across India and the world visit the Badrinath temple to seek the blessings of Badri Vishal.

The temple was established and systematised by Adi Shankaracharya in the 8th century CE. He instituted the tradition of the Rawal - the head priest - being from Kerala's Namboodiri Brahmin community, a practice that continues today. This connection makes the Badrinath Dham Yatra especially significant for South Indian Vaishnava families.
On the 2026 opening day (23rd April) , over 16,000 devotees attended as the Kapat opened amid Vedic chants.

Key Attractions Covered in Our Badrinath Packages

The main sanctum houses the idol of Lord Badrinarayan — a black Shaligram stone idol in Padmasana posture, approximately 1 metre tall. The Abhishek Puja at 4:30 AM and Sandhya Aarti at 7:30 PM are the most auspicious daily rituals. VIP Darshan is included in all our packages.

Natural sulphur hot spring at 45°C , directly adjacent to the temple. Pilgrims traditionally bathe here before Darshan — believed to purify before entering the sanctum. Our tour manager guides you on timing to avoid the mid-morning rush.

A sacred ghat on the Alaknanda River where pitru tarpan (ancestral prayers) are performed. For families wishing to offer prayers for departed relatives, Brahma Kapal is the most significant spot near Badrinath. Priest fees are paid directly (approximately ₹500–₹2,000). Our packages include dedicated time here.

Located 3 km from Badrinath by road — one of the last inhabited villages near the Indo-Tibet border. Contains Vyas Gufa (where sage Vyasa composed the Mahabharata), Ganesh Gufa , and Bhim Pul — a natural rock bridge over the Saraswati River. Our itinerary schedules Mana Village at 8 AM — before tourist crowds arrive.
A 145-metre waterfall located 9 km from Badrinath (3 km by road to Mana, then 6 km trek). Included as an optional add-on for fit pilgrims with adequate time.

Five sacred river confluences on the Haridwar–Badrinath highway: Devprayag, Rudraprayag, Karnaprayag, Nandaprayag, and Vishnuprayag. Our standard and deluxe packages include short stops at key confluences — adding spiritual depth to the journey.
Peak season general queue: 3–6 hours . Our VIP Darshan arrangement reduces wait time to 20–40 minutes . Booking VIP Darshan well in advance is essential for May–June visits.

Mandatory Yatra Registration — Do This First
Every Char Dham pilgrim must register before travel. This is compulsory — not optional.

items: Visit registrationandtouristcare.uk.gov.in on your phone or computer
Enter personal details — name, age, address, Aadhaar number
Select your pilgrimage destinations and travel dates
Submit and download your Yatra Registration Number (YRN)

blocks.text: Each group member registers individually — one YRN per person. Carry printed + digital copy. YRN is checked at checkpoints throughout the route. Pilgrims without YRN are turned back at the first checkpoint and must register on-site — causing significant delay during peak season.
When you book with us, our team verifies your YRN before departure and assists anyone facing difficulties with the portal.
Health and Safety for Badrinath Yatra
At 3,133 metres , oxygen levels are approximately 30% lower than at sea level.

items: Consult your doctor before booking — essential for anyone above 60 or with cardiovascular, BP, or respiratory conditions
Drink 3–4 litres of water daily on mountain days
Eat light, warm meals at altitude — your body is already managing adjustment
AMS symptoms: headache, nausea, dizziness, breathlessness — stop ascending and rest immediately
Our itineraries include an acclimatisation night at Joshimath — this is non-negotiable

blocks.text: What to Pack for Badrinath Yatra

items: Thermal inner wear (top and bottom) — 2 sets minimum. Even June nights reach 2–6°C at Badrinath.
Ankle-support walking shoes with grip sole — not sandals or flat-soled shoes
One extra pair of warm socks in waterproof bag
Personal daily medicines — carry 3 extra days' supply
ORS sachets, pain relief, antiseptic cream
Pulse oximeter (₹800–₹1,200) — monitors blood oxygen at altitude
Sunscreen SPF 50+ — UV intensity significantly higher at 3,133m
Yatra Registration Number — printed copy + saved offline on phone
₹3,000–₹5,000 cash from Haridwar — ATMs at Badrinath fail frequently during peak season due to network issues
Skipping Joshimath acclimatisation. Direct Haridwar-to-Badrinath in one day is the leading cause of AMS on this route. Our itinerary builds this rest day in — it is not removable.

Booking without checking inclusions. A ₹10,000 "Badrinath package" excluding accommodation and transport is not cheaper than our ₹12,500 all-inclusive option. Always get a written line-by-line breakdown before paying.
Travelling in July–August without buffer days. Landslides close the Haridwar–Badrinath highway for 12–48 hours multiple times per season. No buffer days means no Yatra.
Not registering online before leaving home. Registration at registrationandtouristcare.uk.gov.in takes 10 minutes. On-site registration at checkpoints during peak season causes 2–4 hour delays.
Underpacking warm clothing. Badrinath is at 3,133 metres. Even June nights reach 2–4°C. One light jacket is not enough.
Booking helicopter without lead time. Helicopter slots for May–June fill 60–90 days in advance. Walking in and expecting same-day availability is not realistic.
Schedule Mana Village at 8 AM, not 11 AM. Tourist crowd at Mana peaks between 10 AM and 2 PM. An 8 AM visit gives you Vyas Gufa and Bhim Pul with almost no crowd — a completely different experience.

Attend both the 4:30 AM Abhishek Puja and the 7:30 PM Sandhya Aarti. Most pilgrims attend one. The Abhishek Puja at dawn with snow peaks in the background, and the Sandhya Aarti at dusk with the temple lit — these are two distinctly different and equally powerful experiences.
Carry cash from Haridwar — not just Joshimath. ATMs along the entire Haridwar–Badrinath route have limited cash availability during peak season. Withdrawing from Haridwar eliminates any risk.

Book ground-floor rooms if travelling with parents above 65. Mountain hotels at Joshimath and Badrinath do not have lifts. After a long mountain drive, climbing 3 flights of stairs at altitude is genuinely exhausting.

Start your Day 1 mountain drive by 6:00–6:30 AM from Haridwar. The 10–12 hour Haridwar–Joshimath drive is long. Starting early means arriving before dark — mountain roads at night are not advisable even with experienced drivers.

blocks.text: Q2. Is Badrinath Yatra by helicopter safe?

Q3. When does the Badrinath Yatra start in 2026?
Ans. The Badrinath Dham usually opens on or around the auspicious event of Akshaya Tritiya which falls on 24 April 2026. The temple will open from 24 April 2026!
Q4. What is the price of the Badrinath Yatra by helicopter?

Ans. The Badrinath Dham Yatra Package by helicopter can range anywhere from 30,000 to 1 Lakh. The cost really depends on your starting point, inclusions, luxury level, inclusions, travel duration, etc.
Q5. How to plan Badrinath Yatra?
Ans. You can either purchase Badrinath Tour Packages or plan your Badrinath trip all by yourself! Here are a few steps to follow:

items: Decide whether you'll take the road route or fly to the Badrinath Dham by helicopter!
Choose the time period of your travelling.
Plan your route from Haridwar. Normally people visit in a sequence like: Haridwar → Devprayag → Srinagar → Rudraprayag → Joshimath → Badrinath.

Create an itinerary for yourself, keeping the nearby attractions in mind as well.

blocks.text: Q6. How much time will I get for VIP Darshan?

Q7. How far is the Badrinath helipad from the main temple?
Ans. The Badrinath helipad is about 1 km away from the main entrance.
Q8. Which helipad is best for Badrinath Helicopter Yatra?
Ans. Sahastradhara Helipad is the closest one to Kedarnath Dham.
Q9. Is there any helicopter service from Delhi to Badrinath?
Ans. All helicopter trips to Dham temples of Badrinath, Kedarnath, Gangotri and Yamunotri starts off from Sahastradhara helipad in Dehradun.
Q10. How far is Badrinath from Rishikesh by road?
Ans. Kedarnath is 294 kms away from Rishikesh by road.
Q11. What Is The Best Time To Visit Badrinath?
Ans. May and June and then September and October are the most preferred months to plan your Badrinath trip.

Ans. To complete your Badrinath Yatra by flying, you can check out a few customized Badrinath holiday packages that are inclusive of helicopter service.

Ans. It is always a nice idea to do pre-planning for your holiday and reading out Badrinath travel guide and Kedarnath travel guide helps you to enjoy your Badrinath Kedarnath Yatra to the fullest.
Q14. How Can I Go To Badrinath?
Ans. Badrinath is accessible via all modes of transport viz. airways, railways, and roadways.

items: By Flight: Jolly Grant Airport in Dehradun is the nearest airport to the pilgrimage.
By Railways: Rishikesh Railway Station is the nearest railway station to Badrinath where trains from different cities come on regular basis.

blocks.text: Q15. Is There Any Helicopter Service To Badrinath?

Ans. Badrinath Packages rates depend completely on several parameters including the place of your overnight stay, transportation, etc. Hence, checking out different Badrinath packages helps you in a proper planning.
Q17. Can We Go To Badrinath by Own Car?

Ans. Yes, you can reach the holy shrine of Lord Badri by your own car but we would not recommend it much as the roads are not very to drive. Hence, reach out a reputed travel company to provide transportation for your Badrinath Yatra.
Q18. What Is Badrinath Famous For?
Ans. Dedicated to Lord Badri, Badrinath is reckoned for its spiritual aura and also for its picturesque location amidst the Himalayas. Also, Mana Village the last Indian village is located here only.
Q19. What Is The Story Of Badrinath?

Ans. According to Hindu mythology, Lord Vishnu once sat for a deep meditation here in the mountains and to save him from the harsh climatic conditions, Goddess Laxmi, his consort took the form of a berry tree and protected him from the scorching heat of the sun rays and rain.
Q20. What Is The Significance Of Badrinath Yatra?

Ans. Being one of the most important pilgrimages of Chota Chardham and Char Dham Yatra, Badrinath attracts a lot of tourists from far around the world. Hindus believe that doing the philosophy of Lord Badri blesses them with lifelong prosperity and wealth.
Q21. What Can I Buy In Badrinath?
Ans. Badrinath being a religious place is home to shops selling puja items.
Q22. How Do I Get To Joshimath From Badrinath?
Ans. The total distance between Joshimath and Badrinath is 46 km by road. There are direct cabs from Joshimath to Badrinath.

blocks.text: Bali is a dream destination for couples looking for a romantic honeymoon. This 4-day Bali honeymoon tour package is specially designed for couples who want a mix of romance, relaxation, and a little adventure on their honeymoon.

Imagine waking up in a private villa surrounded by palm trees, stunning views, hearing soft ocean waves, and having a floating breakfast just for the two of you. Well, that’s what Bali can bring to the table for couples looking for a memorable romantic honeymoon trip.
From exploring lush green rice terraces to enjoying beachside cafes, from watching stunning sunsets to exploring the key attractions…Bali is full of surprises waiting for you.
So let's quickly get in and explore what Bali has got for couples!
Day 1 : Arrival in Bali and Check In At Luxurious Resort/Villa
Your honeymoon trip will start from Bali Airport (Ngurah Rai International Airport) . Our representative will drive you to your hotel/resort (in your preferred location) for a comfortable check-in.

items: Check in with a Warm Welcome: Enjoy welcome drinks, a cozy ambience, and a romantic honeymoon room setup.
Spend Your Day at Your Pace: Take a relaxing walk near your hotel. Enjoy the nearby beach (if staying in a coastal area). Explore cafés, local markets, or just relax in your room.
Romantic Dinner: A romantic candlelight dinner setup just for the lovely couple. Enjoy your dinner alongside a beautiful view, surrounded by palm trees, and peaceful nature.

blocks.text: Day 2 : Visit to Tanjung Benoa Beach

Start your morning with a comfortable, delicious breakfast at your hotel. After breakfast, meet your driver, who will take you to explore one of the most exciting destinations of your Bali honeymoon trip.
Tanjung Benoa Beach – Bali's Watersports Hub

Witness the stunning views of the Indian Ocean, sandy beaches, crystal clear water, and water sports activities. It is the perfect place for couples to have a mix of fun, excitement, and playful moments together.

items: Bali Turtle Park (Optional can be added on request)

blocks.text: After all the fun, enjoy a relaxing lunch at a nearby restaurant—many offer views of the ocean, giving you a peaceful break.
Romantic Spa Session (Can be added on request)

items: You can also have a couple's spa session.
Balinese massage, warm oils, soft music, dim lights, and complete relaxation.
A perfect way to enjoy relaxing moments together.

blocks.text: Return to the hotel for dinner
Finally, as the day comes to a close, you'll drive back to your hotel, where a romantic candlelight dinner awaits you for a perfect end to the day.
Head back, relax, freshen up, and spend quality time together under soft lights, gentle waves, and delicious food.
Day 3 : Uluwatu Sightseeing & Kecak Fire Dance Show

Day 3 of this honeymoon package is full of culture, cliffs, sunsets, and unforgettable moments in Bali. So, start your day with a delicious breakfast at the hotel. Next, you'll head to South Bali to visit some of the most iconic destinations.
This is one of Bali's most iconic cultural landmarks. This place is a mix of culture, tradition, nature, and some breathtaking views.

items: The massive Garuda Wisnu Kencana statue is considered one of the tallest statues in the world.
Beautiful Gardens and Pathways - Perfect for clicking couple's photographs
Watch Cultural Performances, Balinese Music & Artistic Displays
Walk through famous areas like Lotus Pond, Wisnu Plaza, etc.

blocks.text: After spending some time exploring the cultural park, you will head to the next destination.
2. Visit Uluwatu Temple - The Sunset Point
Ready to experience some breathtaking views from the mountain cliff, and a spiritual experience? Your next stop is the iconic Uluwatu Temple.

items: The temple is situated on a 70-meter-high cliff, which offers some stunning views. You can enjoy the beautiful sunset from the top.
Visit the temple to explore the unique Balinese culture and history

blocks.text: The temple is open for visitors from 7 AM to 7 PM. You have to pay an entry fee of IDR 50,000.
As soon as the sun sets you can attend Bali's famous and most iconic dance performances... the Kecak Fire Dance.
This is a unique art form, with No Musical Instruments.
It is when 50+ men chant "chak chak chak" together in a rhythmic manner to create a magical atmosphere. The performance narrates the story of Ramayana.
Plus, the Fire Dance is one of the thrilling acts of this performance, which will surely make you go wow.
This dance performance starts around 6 PM. The ticket price is IDR 150,000 per person, which you can buy from the ticket counter near the temple itself.
Another day, another experience. After enjoying the beautiful sunset and attending the dance performance, you'll head back to the hotel for the final overnight stay in Bali.
Enjoy your dinner, and prepare for the last day of your honeymoon trip.
Today is the final day of your honeymoon in Bali.
After a delicious breakfast at the hotel, you can explore, relax, and make a few more memories before you fly back home.

items: You can visit the local market
Go shopping, buy handcrafted souvenirs, Wooden art & decor, couples ornaments
You can go to the café for a quick coffee
Or have a refreshing coconut drink at the beachside

blocks.text: Q1. Can we customize the honeymoon itinerary based on our preferences?

Ans. Absolutely! We know that every couple has different preferences and requirements. Therefore, at My Quick Trippers, we offer customizable honeymoon packages for Bali. Want a private beach dinner or dinner on a cruise during sunset? Want to skip a place and add something else? Just let us know, and our team will be happy to make the adjustments to your itinerary.
Q2. Can you arrange a sunset dinner cruise?

Ans. Yes, we can! A sunset dinner cruise is actually one of the most romantic things you can do in Bali, and couples absolutely love it. If you want, we can arrange a romantic dinner on a luxury yacht, traditional boat cruises, or a catamaran cruise. Note: This is not included in the package cost; you have to pay extra for this.
Q3. What adventure activities can couples do together in Bali?
Ans. Bali is the PERFECT place for adventurous couples! There's so much you can do together -

items: Water adventures, such as Snorkeling or diving, Jet skiing, parasailing, or banana boat rides.
Land adventures, like Sunrise trek to Mount Batur volcano, ATV rides, Jungle swings, Zip-lining, etc.

blocks.text: These activities are a fun way to create amazing honeymoon memories.
Q4. Can we upgrade to a luxury resort?

Ans. Of course. Our base package includes comfortable 3-star or 4-star hotels that are clean, well-located, and perfect. However, if you want to have a luxurious experience, we absolutely can arrange luxury upgrades. This includes: Private villas, complimentary floating breakfasts, Five-star resorts with multiple pools, fine dining restaurants, world-class amenities, and many more options. Just tell us your budget, and we'll suggest the best options.
Q5. Can we have free days to relax instead of sightseeing?
Ans. Yes! If you prefer to have some free time to relax, or just want to spend some quality time together, you are absolutely free to make changes to the itinerary.
Q6. Is 4 days enough for a Bali honeymoon?

Ans. Four days is okay. This 4-day honeymoon itinerary is a perfect mix of exploration, adventure, and romantic couple time. A hassle-free, comfortable honeymoon in Bali, exploring some of the iconic landmarks, watching beautiful views, and doing adventurous activities, while spending quality time together.
Q7. Are flights included in the honeymoon package?
Ans. No, flights are not included in our package pricing.
Q8. Is airport pickup and drop included in the package?
Ans. Yes, absolutely! Airport transfers are 100% included — both pickup when you arrive and drop-off when you leave.

og_tags.og:title: Best of Gujarat Tour Package – Culture, Wildlife & Heritage
og_tags.og:description: Explore Gujarat’s best with Gir lions, Somnath temples, Dwarka shrines & Diu beaches in one unforgettable tour package.

blocks.text: Gujarat, the westernmost state of India is worldwide for its white sandy deserts, holy destinations, historical and cultural places, and glimmering beaches. Browsing our Best of Gujarat Tour Package offers you an opportunity to explore various other tourist destinations dotted in the state. As you are on a family tour and the taste of each family member is different so we have compiled all such destinations that could match with the taste of each member of your group.
Best of Gujarat Tour Itinerary Package

Once you get down at the Ahmedabad airport or the railway station, you will find our representative waiting for you and then take you to one of your pre-decided hotels through a private transfer. Once you are ok with all the formalities required to do the check-in at the hotel get yourself ready to explore the destinations scheduled for today. The day visit commences with the exploration of Gandhi Ashram, Sidi Saiyyed Mosque, a perfect example of architecture grandeurs, enjoy visiting boat ride in Kankaria Lake, Akshardham Temple, and Adalaj Temple. After completing the day visitation, retire to the hotel for gorging upon the night cuisine and staying overnight.
Day 2 : Drive to Dwarka via Jamnagar

Post goring upon your morning meal, get yourself done with the formalities needed to check-out from the hotel and get ready to explore the leftover destinations that are covered under the Gujarat tour package. From Ahmedabad, you will be taken to Jamnagar en-route which you can visit Lakhota Museum and Lakhota Lake. After visiting these spots you will drive straight towards Dwarka by the road where you can seek the blessings of Bala Hanuman Temple. After covering a long distance from Ahmedabad to Dwarka and on reaching Dwarka, drive towards the hotel where you can accommodate yourself with your family and can relax for the next day trip. If time allows you then visit the Dwarkadhish Temple in the evening where you can participate in the evening Aarti ceremony.

Give a perfect start to your third day of the trip with a relishing breakfast at the hotel and after treating your taste buds with the morning meal, take a holy dip into the River Gomati and then start your temple-hopping tour in Dwarka. Nageshwar Jyotirlinga Temple, Gopi Talav, and Bet Talav are some of the best destinations and after completing these destinations when you drive back to Dwarka via the boat ride visit the popular Rukmini Devi Temple. Spend your afternoon in exploring the coastal attractions including the lighthouse standing tall at the beach. If you are left with some energy after the daily schedule then attend the evening Aarti at the Dwarkadhish Temple. Conclude your third day of the tour with a scrumptious Gujarati meal served at the night.
Day 4 : Transfer to Somnath via Porbandar

This is your last day in Dwarka from where you will drive straight to Somnath via Porbandar. On the way to Somnath, make your visit to the destinations falling en-route especially Kirti Mandir which is considered to be the place where Mahatma Gandhi was born and also visit the Sudama Temple. This is the time to start exploring the destinations established in Somnath. On reaching the destination town, complete the check-in formalities at the hotel where you are going to stay in Somnath. Bhalka Tirth, Geeta Mandir, and Triveni Sangam are some of the destinations you are exploring today. Later in the evening, visit the Somnath Temple again for attending the evening Aarti ceremony and to participate in the light and sound show at the temple. This is all for the day so conclude your day with a relaxing overnight stay.
Day 5 : Drive to Diu and Sightseeing

According to the schedule of the Gujarat tour package, check-out from your stay in Somnath drive towards Diu with your family members. On reaching the destination city, enter your room after completing the check-in formalities and then unwind yourself. Here you will be visiting Nagaon Beach, Diu Fort, and Diu Museum, Gangeshwar Temple, Naida Caves, and Chakratirth Beach. By the time it gets dark, drive back to the hotel for a night of sound sleep.

Early morning after completing the check-out formalities at the hotel and continue your drive towards Gir where on arrival you will be dropped at the hotel to get freshen up and unwind yourself followed by a trip to Gir National Park. Board the bus to spot Asiatic lions where you can enjoy the incredible wildlife of Gujarat. On the 6th day of the tour you will be treating your taste buds with the traditional Gujarati cuisines in dinner which is then followed by a relaxing night stay.

On the very last day of your Gujarat Trip, kick start your day with a relishing morning meal. Finally, the day has come where you will be returning to Ahmedabad and on the way to Junagarh including Navlakha Palace, Gondal, and Uparkot Fort. After covering such destinations, you will be escorted back to the Ahmedabad Airport or the railway station from where you board the flight or train for your onward journey towards home. I hope you had a great time in Gujarat with us and wish you a happy and safe journey.

blocks.text: Q. How Long Does It Take To Visit Somnath?

Ans. You could visit Somnath for 4 or 5 days. You could begin at Somnath Temple and take in views of Somnath Beach and Chorwad Beach. Visit the Prabhas Patan Museum. Visit the Gita Temple, the Dehotsarg Teerth, the Triveni Sangam, and the Suraj Mandir.

Ans. Somnath has been a pilgrimage site since ancient times due to its location as a Triveni Sangam (the confluence of three rivers: Kapila, Hiran, and Saraswati). Soma, the Moon god, is said to have lost his lustre due to a curse and bathed in the Sarasvati River at this location to reclaim it.
Q. What Draws People To Somnath?

Ans. Somnath temple, one of the most well-known pilgrimage sites, is located on Gujarat's western coast. The temple is very important to Lord Shiva devotees because it is thought to house one of India's 12 Jyotirlinga, or holy shrines where Lord Shiva is said to have manifested.
Q. What Is Somnath's Culinary Speciality?

Ans. Lassi, Buttermilk, Chaas, and ice creams are popular and widely available dairy products. Gujarati snacks such as Dhokla, Khakra, Fafda, Sev, Khandvi, and Khaman, as well as sweets such as Ghevar, Malpua, Shrikhand, Puran Poli, and others, are available in the area.
Q. What Is The Somnath Temple Legend?

Ans. At this point, Chandra desperately prayed to Shiva at Prabhas Tirtha to restore his light. Given how earnestly Chandra prayed to Shiva, he was freed from his curse. The Moon God only built the Somnath Temple in gold after Brahma advised him to build a temple in honour of Shiva.

blocks.text: This well-curated Kerala tour package mainly covers Munnar, Guruvayur, Alleppey and Thekkady in 7days and 6 nights.
Day 1: Cochin Arrival - Transfer to Guruvayur (3 Hrs/100 Kms)

Arrival at Kochi airport or railway station and then transfer to Guruvayur. On the way you will see some natural scenic spots and waterfalls. On arrival at Guruvayur you will check into your pre-booked hotel and relax and unwind for the rest of the day. Visit the Elephant Camp that houses different varieties of elephants. Seek the blessings of Lord Krishna at Guruvayur Temple where the entry is permitted only for the Hindus. After the sightseeing tour, get back to your hotel and have an overnight stay. Places You’ll See

From Guruvayur you’ll head out on a scenic drive to Munnar, a scenic hill station. On the way, you will appreciate the breathtaking sceneries ranging from towering mountains to spice plantations and beautiful tea gardens. Upon arrival in Munnar, you will check-in to your pre-booked hotel. You can spend the rest of the day as you like relaxing in your room or exploring the local attractions.

After a delicious breakfast you will head out for sightseeing tour of Munnar. You will visit the famous attractions including Mattupetty Lake & Dam , Echo Point , Kundale Lake , Tea Gardens and Rajamalai (Eravikulam National Park) . Mattupetty Lake & Dam: Mattupetty Lake & Dam is one of the most beautiful attractions of Munnar with lush greenery and towering hills. Echo Point: Echo Point is famous for its natural beauty. Here you can listen to your voice echoing from the hills. Rajamalai (Eravikulam National Park): This national park is home to diverse flora and fauna. Tea Gardens: For nature lovers and tea enthusiasts, tea gardens are an absolute dream. You can sample freshly brewed teas over here. Kundala Lake: This is a man-made marvel surrounded by flowers and lush green trees. This lake is ideal for pedal boating. Return to your hotel after the sightseeing tour and have an overnight stay. Places You’ll See

Post breakfast, you’ll head to Thekkady. On the way you'll appreciate the beautiful sceneries and splendid views. Upon arrival at Thekkady, check-in at your hotel. Explore the spice plantations , which will revive your mind with the aroma of different spices. Explore Periyar Forest of Thekkady, the finest wildlife reserve in India. You can also enjoy boating at Periyar Lake . Head out for spice plantation tour and fall in love with the aromatic smell of the spices. Overnight stay at your hotel in Thekkady. Places You’ll See

After breakfast you will head out on a scenic drive to Alleppey, which is also known as the Venice of the East. Alleppey, also referred to as Alappuzha, is hailed as one of the oldest planned towns in the region. It is renowned for houseboat cruises, clear beaches, and boat races. Option 1: Stay at Hotel Upon arrival, you will check into the pre-reserved hotel and spend the rest of the day as you want. You can indulge in some interesting activities including: Shopping: Stock up on your favourite items from the local bazaars and floating markets of Alleppey. You can buy spices, paintings, artworks, and banana chips. Sunset Cruise on Vembanadu Lake (Optional): Witness the sunset as you enjoy a cruise on Vembanadu Lake at your own price. Alleppey Beach: Stroll by the shoreline of Alleppey Beach or spend a peaceful moment by the sea admiring the breathtaking views. Option 2: Houseboat Stay After arriving at Alleppey you can stay in a houseboat and sail along the backwater. Houseboat Cruise: The fanciful and strikingly beautiful houseboats transport you to a world of luxury and royalty, making it a once-in-a-lifetime experience. You can either stay the whole night in these majestic boathouses, or you can book your stay for a few hours as per your preference. You can also have a mesmerizing view of the seawater and the greenery as the boathouse floats in the water. Places You’ll See
DAY 6: Alleppey – Kovalam – Trivandrum (4 Hrs/164 Kms)

Post breakfast, you will leave for Kovalam. On arrival at Kovalam, begin the city excursion and visit the popular tourist attractions including: Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple: This is a well-known Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Anantha, Lord Vishnu’s avatar. The temple’s architecture is an amalgamation of Dravidian and Kerala style, and it features a hundred-foot tall gopuram. Optional Sightseeing: If you have time on hand, you can plan to visit the main tourist attractions such as the City Museum, Napier Museum, and other nearby sites. After visiting Trivandrum you’ll proceed to Kovalam, a serene coastal retreat of Kerala. You can stroll by the Kovalam beach and appreciate the scintillating sceneries. You will then have an overnight stay at your hotel in Kovalam. Places You’ll See
DAY 7: Kovalam – Trivandrum / Cochin Departure (6 Hrs/220 Kms)

Watch the stunning sunset on Kovalam beach and then enjoy breakfast. Post breakfast, you’ll be transferred to Cochin or Trivandrum depending on your convenience. Our driver will drop you off at the railway station or airport. With this, the Kerala tour package will come to an end.

blocks.text: Bhaktapur is a very popular city, known as the place of devotees. It is an ancient Newa city situated in the eastern corner of the Kathmandu Valley. The city is also known for its beautiful historical architecture and is one of the most visited destinations by tourists in Nepal. Notably, the language that is spoken in this region is also really very different from the other cities in Nepal.

It is a structured city, which was built years and years ago, but the royal palace courtyards are still preserved in this city, which makes it unique and worthy as a tourist spot. Hence, it is also listed as a World Heritage Site by UNESCO. All the architectures are built with very fine details and are worth visiting at least once in a lifetime. In most of the monuments or architecture, you will find the finest artwork of wood and stone.

The city is also known for its delicious local food, and especially for its special kind of yogurt, which is called Juju Dhau, which you can only find in this region, and is a must-try if you are visiting Bhaktapur. With all the architectural beauty and historical importance, the city is filled with a devotional vibe and is a must-visit for those who are seeking peace.

blocks.text: The Bhubaneswar Konark Puri Tour Package is planned to give you everything a traveler needs in one package. Your trip starts in Bhubaneswar, a city famous for its temples but there is much more to explore.

items: Route: Arrival in Bhubaneswar → Bhubaneswar - Konark - Puri → Puri to Bhubaneswar

blocks.text: Arrive in Bhubaneswar, Odisha’s capital, our representative will meet you at the airport or railway station and take you to your hotel. After some rest visit an old Jain temple and the caves on the twin hills of Khandagiri and Udayagiri, including Lion, Queen and Elephant Caves built in the 1st century BC.Then, explore Bhubaneswar’s famous temples built between the 7th and 13th centuries like - Lingaraj Temple, Mukteshwar Temple, Parshuram Temple, Rajarani Temple, Kedargouri, and Bindusagar. Overnight stay at the hotel.Places You’ll See

(Distances- Bhubaneswar to Konark 99 km and Konark to Puri 36 km ) Total duration: 2.5 to 3.5 hoursMorning, after breakfast drive to Konark and visit the Sun Temple, historic monument recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, built in the 13th century by King Narasimha I. Then proceed to Puri stop at Chandrabhaga Beach and Ramchandi Temple on the way. Arrive and check in to your hotel.Spend the evening in Puri by visiting the famous Shri Jagannath Temple, a very old and highly respected Hindu temple known for its rich cultural and religious importance. It is near the Bay of Bengal and has a long history that attracts both pilgrims and tourists.Note:Panda arrangements at the Jagannath temple in Puri can be made according to guests’ needs.Places You’ll See
Day 3: Puri to Bhubaneswar (67 km / 1-2 hrs drive)

After breakfast, check out from Puri and drive to Bhubaneswar. On the way, visit Raghurajpur, a beautiful village famous for Pattachitra paintings, palm leaf art, stone work, wooden toys and Tussar paintings. If time allows, stop at Sakhigopal Temple, Pipli (known for colorful fabric work) and Dhauli to see the Buddhist Stupa and the Peace Pagoda, a monument.You will be dropped at the Bhubaneswar railway station, and your Puri Bhubaneswar Konark tour package comes to an end with unforgettable memories.Places You’ll See
