items: Route: Arrival in Bhubaneswar → Bhubaneswar- Dhauli - Pipli - Konark - Puri → Puri - Raghurajpur - Chilika - Gopalpur → In Gopalpur → Gopalpur - Bhubaneswar Departure

blocks.text: Welcome to Bhubaneswar (Odisha’s capital), where our team welcomes you at the airport or station and takes you to your hotel. After a short rest, visit the famous twin hills of Khandagiri and Udayagiri, where you can see Jain temples and rock-cut caves like- Elephant Cave, Lion Cave, and Queen Cave.Explore the temples in the evening, including Lingaraj, Mukteshwar, Parshuram, Rajarani, Bindusagar, and Kedargouri Temple.Places You’ll See
Day 2: Bhubaneswar- Dhauli - Pipli - Konark - Puri

(Distance- Bhubaneswar to Dhauli 11 km, Dhauli to Pipli 16 km, Pipli to Konark 44 km, Konark to Puri 36 km ) Total duration: 3 - 4 hoursAfter breakfast, drive to Konark, stop at Dhauli to see the Buddhist Stupa, and Pipli, famous for its traditional fabric art. In Konark, visit the Sun Temple, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, built by King Narasimha.Later, continue to Puri, and on the way, visit Chandrabhaga Beach, perfect for a short walk and some photos. Check in at the hotel and in the evening, explore Shri Jagannath Temple, one of the oldest and most world-famous Hindu temple near the Bay of Bengal. Check in at the hotel for the night.Note-Your Puri Konark Bhubaneswar Gopalpur Tour Plan can include special arrangements with temple priests at the Jagannath Temple in Puri. (If guests wish)Places You’ll See

(Puri to Raghurajpur -18 km, Raghurajpur to Chilika (Barkul) - 60 km, Chilika (Barkul) to Gopalpur - 114 km) Total duration: Approx. 5 HoursDrive to Chilika Lake, Asia’s largest brackish water lake (a mix of fresh and salt water). On the way, stop at Raghurajpur craft village to see its traditional art. Then stop at Barkul on Chilika Lake and take a boat to see different kinds of birds and a small temple on an island (boat charges paid directly). Continue to Gopalpur for an overnight stay.Places You’ll See
The day is free to enjoy the beach. Watch the stunning sunrise and sunset views. If you wish you may also visit Berhampur or the Tara Tarini Temple.Places You’ll See
Day 5: Gopalpur - Bhubaneswar Departure (173 km/ 3-4 hours)

Your Bhubaneswar Puri Konark Travel Package ends today. Travel back to Bhubaneswar and visit the ISKCON Temple and Ekamra Haat if time allows. Later, you will be dropped at the airport or railway station.Places You’ll See

blocks.text: Bhutan, a country of Buddhist Culture is quite an expensive country as a travel destination but the story doesn’t end here only because the scenic beauty and the surprising elements of the country attracts tourist. Bhutanese are very well-educated, updated with the world news, and always fun-loving. Give yourself a chance to visit this Buddhist country and learn about the cultures. Walking along the fascinating Himalayan landscapes can give you a mesmerizing sight of the snow-capped mountains and the greenery of the forests.

Textiles and handicrafts, scandalous competitions of archery, trekking at a higher altitude, and astonishing flora, and faunas are the other elements that compel people to visit this place once in their life at least. The food taste of Bhutanese is very different from others they consume Chillies as a main dish, Here you can find authentic Bhutanese dishes or it can be crossovers like Tibet, Chinese, etc. Unlike in other countries, there is a strict rule made by the government to conserve at least 60% of the forest so that the future generation will not have to face any problems. The journey to Bhutan ends with visiting of a hot water bath culture where you can find a wooden bathtub in the shape of a coffin whose water gets heated by stones coming directly from the fire.

So, now there is a question Who doesn’t want to enjoy the Bhutan Tour? I think everyone wants it so what are you waiting for? My Quick Trippers is offering you several Tour Packages for Bhutan which you can opt for to make your journey the most exhilarated one.

blocks.text: Buddhism is a religion embraced by millions across the globe. It is one of the oldest religions in the world whose origins date back to over 2,500 years ago. Ever since it was brought to light by Gautam Buddha at a very young age it has brought with it a sense of peace and belonging among its followers. According to some scholars, the basic roots of Buddhism is deeply steeped in the teachings of Hinduism. Being the world's 4th largest religion it has over 535 million followers i.e. about 7% of the world population. Just like in any other religion, pilgrimage forms a very important part in Buddhism as well. Since the wheel of dharma was set forth in the eastern gangetic plains, most of these spiritual Buddhist centres are concentrated in those parts of the subcontinent.

With the development and encouragement of tourism in India, the connectivity of these places have developed massively. The Buddhist tour packages ensure a convenient travel experience to these spiritual centres. Throughout the journey you will experience a sense of peace and calm that will leave a lasting impression in your heart for a long time. A Buddhist pilgrimage is said to provide liberation or nirvana. This pilgrimage goes from Lumbini to Bodh Gaya and explores various sites, Stupas and places related to the teachings of Buddhism. The whole pilgrimage is all about offering an experience that will be a refreshing experience in itself while also looking forward to the future.

blocks.text: All prices are per person on twin sharing. Packages are fully customizable — duration, hotel category, and starting city can be adjusted. Contact us for group rates and single occupancy pricing.

Buddhism is one of the oldest and majorly followed religions in the world. Originating in Bihar around 5th century BC this religion has garnered a huge following all over the world. The philosophy of the religion was developed from the teachings of Gautam Buddha or the awakened / enlightened one. Ever since its birth the teachings made its way across borders like China, Korea and Japan. Seekers and religious students started to make their way to India in order to learn more about this unique religion that was being taught by Gautam Buddha himself in Nalanda University.

Buddhism was preached in the language of the masses that was Pali and Sanskrit, the same language in which the literary texts and source of the religion survives till date. This was one of the most appealing features for the spreading of Buddhism as a religion tenfold. This day, Buddhism stands as one of the majorly followed religions in the world.

The founder of Buddhism was called Siddharth Gautam who lived from c. 563 to 483 BCE. He was born in a royal family as a son of an Indian warrior king in Lumbini (present-day Nepal). Gautam led a very extravagant and privileged life which was the direct result of his position and social standing. However, soon he got very bored and started feeling unfulfilled of his privileges and got the urge to look for something more, a different purpose in life. He left the royal indulgences, his wife and his child, to pursue the greater meaning in life.

He started wandering and during one of these instances he met with an old man, an ill man, a corpse and an ascetic who made him believe that all worldly pleasures need to be renounced. He came to the realisation or gained enlightenment while meditating under a Peepal tree (Ficus religiosa) in Bodh Gaya — this sacred tree is now known as the Bodhi Tree. After achieving salvation, he decided to walk all over India while spreading the teachings of dharma, beginning with his first sermon at the Deer Park in Sarnath .
With a rich historical background there are several interesting aspects and facts about Buddhism. Here are some facts about Buddhism:

items: Half of the world's Buddhist population resides in China according to research. Still, they make up for only about 18% of the country's population. Other than this, 13% of the Buddhist population resides in Thailand, 9% in Japan and only 1.4% of the Buddhist population outside Asia.

Buddhism in Asia is a matter of both practice and identity. Various journalists and scholars have studied that many people living in Asian countries may even engage in various Buddhist practices without recognizing themselves as a part of any other organised religion.
The first mention of Buddha in western writing is in the writings of Clement of Alexandria that dates around 2 AD.
The Buddha founded the concept of Sanghas which is an order of monks and nuns that helps in preserving the knowledge and teachings of Buddhism even to this day.
There is no single holy book when it comes to Buddhism. Various scriptures about its teachings are preserved in a variety of Asian languages.
Buddhism emphasises on mindfulness and meditation because of which it is often considered as a form of psychology over a widely practised religion.

blocks.text: The primary feature of any Buddhist teaching is the concept of four noble truths in life. These are: the truth of suffering, the truth of the cause of suffering, the truth of the end of suffering and the truth of the path that leads to the end of suffering. To put it simply, suffering exists, it stems from somewhere and eventually it has to come to an end. The intention of talking about suffering is not to create a negative view of the world but a rather more pragmatic approach to deal with the world as it is along with the attempts to rectify it.

Unlike the concept of karma in contemporary society, the Buddhist interpretation of karma does not refer to preordained faith. Karma according to Buddhism refers to the good and bad actions that a person takes in their lifetime. The weight of these actions is determined by certain conditions such as: frequent and repetitive actions, determined intentional action, actions performed without regret, action against extraordinary persons and action toward those who have helped one in the past.

Karma plays out in the Buddhism cycle of rebirth. There are 6 separate planes into which any living being can be reborn which consists of — three fortunate realms and three unfortunate realms. People with favourable and positive karma are born in the fortunate realm and the realm of man is considered as the highest realm of rebirth. In the same manner, the inhabitants of the unfortunate realm suffer from untold suffering.

Places of Buddhist relevance mostly lie in the Indo-Gangetic Plain of Nepal and North India. These are the places where Gautam Buddha was born, lived, achieved salvation and taught Buddhism. Here are the four main pilgrimage sites listed by Buddha himself:

items: Lumbini, Nepal: Birthplace of Siddharth Gautam and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The Maya Devi Temple marks the exact birth spot. Also visit the Ashoka Pillar (249 BCE), Bodhi Tree, and the zone of international monasteries from 20+ countries.

Bodh Gaya, Bihar: The most sacred site in Buddhism — where Buddha attained enlightenment under the Bodhi Tree. The Mahabodhi Temple is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Also visit the Great Buddha Statue, Niranjana River, and Sujata Temple.

Sarnath, Uttar Pradesh: Where the enlightened Buddha delivered his first sermon in the Deer Park. Located 10 km from Varanasi. Key sites: Dhamek Stupa, Chaukhandi Stupa, and Sarnath Archaeological Museum (houses the original Lion Capital of Ashoka).
Kushinagar, Uttar Pradesh: Where Buddha attained Mahaparinirvana (final liberation). The Mahaparinirvana Temple houses a reclining Buddha statue. The Rambhar Stupa marks the cremation site.

blocks.text: The extended Buddhist circuit also includes:

items: Rajgir, Bihar: Where Buddha spent several rainy seasons and delivered important teachings. Visit Gridhakuta (Vulture's Peak) and Shanti Stupa (Japanese Peace Pagoda, accessible by ropeway).
Nalanda, Bihar: Site of the ancient Nalanda Mahavihara — one of the world's first residential universities where Buddhist scholars from across Asia came to study. UNESCO World Heritage Site.
Vaishali, Bihar: Where Buddha delivered his last sermon before Mahaparinirvana. The Ashoka Pillar here is among the best preserved. Also visit the World Peace Pagoda.
Sravasti, Uttar Pradesh: Where Buddha spent 24 rainy seasons. The Jetavana Gardens and Sahet-Mahet ruins are the main pilgrimage sites.

Q1: What Is The Buddhist Pilgrimage Route?

The core Buddhist pilgrimage route covers the four main sites: Lumbini (Nepal, birthplace), Bodhgaya (Bihar, enlightenment), Sarnath (Uttar Pradesh, first sermon), and Kushinagar (Uttar Pradesh, Mahaparinirvana). The extended Buddhist circuit adds Rajgir, Nalanda, Vaishali, and Sravasti. Most dedicated tours start from Delhi or Bodhgaya and cover 8 to 17 days depending on which sites are included.
Q2: Which City Is The Holy City For Buddhism?
Lumbini — the birthplace of Gautam Buddha — is considered the holiest Buddhist city for Buddhists.
Yes. Gautam Buddha was born in a Hindu family.
Q4: What Is The Symbolism Of Buddhism?

The wheel of dharma is the primary symbol for Buddhism. It represents the Buddha's first sermon at Sarnath and the path to liberation. The Dharma Chakra also forms the central motif of the national flag of India.

After cremation at Kushinagar, the ashes and relics of Buddha were distributed and enshrined in Stupas at locations connected to his life — Lumbini, Bodhgaya, Sarnath, Kushinagar, Vaishali, and Rajgir among them. The Rambhar Stupa in Kushinagar marks the cremation site.
Q6: How Many Days Are Needed for a Buddhist Pilgrimage Tour in India?

For the four main sites (Lumbini, Bodhgaya, Sarnath, Kushinagar), 8 to 10 days are sufficient. For the full extended Buddhist circuit including Rajgir, Nalanda, Vaishali, and Sravasti, 12 to 17 days is ideal. My Quick Trippers offers packages from 5 days (Ajanta-Ellora) up to 17 days (Footsteps of Buddha full circuit).
Q7: What Is The Cost of a Buddhist Pilgrimage Tour Package?

Packages start from ₹14,500 per person (5-day Ajanta-Ellora tour, twin sharing). The standard 8-day Buddhist Pilgrimage Tour starts from ₹24,500 per person. The 17-day Footsteps of Buddha complete circuit starts from ₹48,500 per person. Prices vary based on hotel category, group size, and season. Contact us for a custom quote.
Q8: Is a Visa Required for Lumbini (Nepal)?

Indian citizens can enter Nepal without a visa using a valid photo ID — Aadhaar card, voter ID, or passport. International visitors need a valid passport and Nepal visa (available on arrival at the border). My Quick Trippers handles all border crossing formalities for packages that include Lumbini.
Q9: Is There a Buddhist Circuit Tourist Train?

Yes. IRCTC runs the Mahaparinirvan Express — a dedicated Buddhist Circuit Tourist Train covering Delhi, Gaya (for Bodhgaya), Varanasi (for Sarnath), Kushinagar, Lumbini, Sravasti, and back to Delhi. My Quick Trippers is IRCTC affiliated and can arrange Buddhist Circuit Train tour packages.
Q10: Can Non-Buddhist Travellers Book These Packages?

Yes. The Buddhist circuit is open to everyone — Hindus, non-Hindus, historians, heritage travellers, and spiritual seekers of all backgrounds. The combination of UNESCO World Heritage Sites, ancient university ruins, living monasteries, and Gangetic plains scenery makes it one of India's most unique heritage circuits.
Q11: What Is Included in the Buddhist Tour Package?

Standard inclusions: AC vehicle for all transfers and sightseeing, hotel accommodation (twin sharing), daily breakfast and dinner, driver allowance, tolls, fuel, and airport or station pickup and drop. Exclusions: airfare or train fare, monument entry fees, Nepal border charges (if Lumbini included), lunch, and personal expenses. Customized packages may vary — confirm at the time of booking.

items: Char Dham Yatra by Helicopter from Dehradun

blocks.text: One of the most acclaimed pilgrimages in India, Char Dham Yatra is renowned as the wish-granting Yatra. Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath, and Badrinath collectively form this revered circuit.

items: Route: Dehradun – Gangotri – Yamunotri → Yamunotri – Kedarnath – Badrinath – Dehradun

blocks.text: Your journey of Char Dham Yatra by helicopter commences from Dehradun. There are also options for Char Dham Yatra by helicopter by Uttarakhand government. On reaching Sahastradhara helipad at Dehradun board the helicopter to reach Harsil Helipad which is the base of Gangotri. Keep in mind that every Char Dham Yatra by helicopter starts from Dehradun. It takes almost 35 to 40 minutes to reach the destination helipad. After reaching Harsil helipad, gorge upon the scrumptious morning meal and then head towards the sacred Gangotri Temple. Pay your offerings and homage to Goddess Ganga return back to the helipad by 11 am. Next, you will drive back to Harsil helipad to board the helicopter to visit Yamunotri. It takes almost 35 minutes to reach the destination. On reaching Yamunotri, check-into the cottages in Yamunotri and then after savoring the delectable lunch head towards the shrine. You can also opt for Palki ride and also enjoy the panoramic landscapes of the surroundings. Upon reaching the shrine, pay homage to the goddess and seek the blessings of River Yamuna. After seeking the blessings drive towards Kharsali Village and serve yourself with mouth-watering Garhwali cuisines and then go for a relaxing overnight stay.

Start your day little early in the morning and savor yourself with a hearty breakfast. Pack your bags and set out of the cottage to leave for Kharsali. As per the norms of Uttarakhand government, you will have to change the helicopter at Guptkashi and take another aircraft to reach Kedarnath which will take approx. 35 minutes more. By 8 AM you will arrive at Kedarnath Shrine. You will have to cover a distance of 500 meters, not more than that to reach the shrine from the helipad. Pay homage at this sacred shrine and wash away all your sins and attain liberation from the cycle of birth and death. You will not have to stand in the long queue of pilgrims as you will be provided with VIP Darshan Pass in this package. After completing the puja rituals return to the helipad. By 10 AM leave for the last pilgrimage of the journey, Badrinath Temple which is one of the most prime destinations of Vishnu worshippers. Post Darshan at Badrinath you will be transferred back to the helipad around 1 pm. Board the helicopter and reach Sahastradhara helipad in Dehradun and this is how your journey with us concludes here. Places You’ll See

blocks.text: Best Places to Visit on Chardham Tour
Besides the four main shrines, the pilgrimage opens a gateway to visit other nearby places as well.

rows: Yamunotri Temple Surya Kund Divya Shila
Main shrine dedicated to Goddess Yamuna. Boiling hot spring used to prepare Prasad; believed to have healing properties. Sacred stone pilgrims must worship before entering the temple.
Gangotri Temple Bhagirath Shila Tapovan Gaumukh

Main temple where Ganga is believed to have first descended; built of white granite. Rock where King Bhagirath meditated to bring Ganga to Earth. Picturesque meadow with snow-capped peaks; ideal for nature lovers. Glacier source of the Ganga River; popular trekking site.
Kedarnath Temple Adi Shankaracharya Samadhi Gaurikund Rudra Cave

Ancient Shiva temple built by the Pandavas, revived by Adi Shankaracharya. Final resting place of Adi Shankaracharya. Starting point of the Kedarnath trek; where Goddess Parvati meditated. Meditation cave; gained fame after PM Modi's 2019 visit.
Badrinath Temple Tapt Kund Mana Village Charan Paduka Joshimath

Main shrine of Lord Vishnu; self-manifested black stone idol. Sacred hot spring for pre-Darshan purification. Last village of India before Tibet border — must visit, often missed. Boulder bearing Lord Vishnu's footprints; panoramic valley views. Winter seat of Lord Badrinath; skiing, trekking, and spiritual significance.

Char Dham pilgrimage is mentally invigorating yet physically tiresome. It involves lengthy road journeys, rough geography, high altitude, and erratic weather in the upper Himalayan areas.

blocks.text: Medical Advisory for Senior Citizens and Health-Restricted Pilgrims

Completing the Char Dham Yatra is a deeply personal and spiritual aspiration — and helicopter packages make it possible for pilgrims who may not be able to manage the physical demands of road travel and trekking. However, even the helicopter Yatra involves some exposure to high altitude. Here is what you need to know:

items: Heart patients with controlled conditions: Safe for helicopter Yatra in most cases. Mandatory requirement: written fitness certificate from your cardiologist before departure.
Emergency oxygen: Available on all our helicopter flights and at our ground support stations.
Altitude: Kedarnath helipad is at 3,583 m. Even with helicopter travel, some mild breathlessness is normal at this altitude for unacclimatised individuals.
Patients with uncontrolled blood pressure or recent surgery (within 6 months): Consult your doctor before booking — your safety is our priority.
Diabetic pilgrims: Carry insulin and all medications. Our hotel kitchens can accommodate dietary requirements — inform us at booking.
Pulse oximeters: Recommended for all pilgrims above 60 — carry one to monitor oxygen saturation at altitude.
Our ground coordinators are trained in basic first aid and altitude sickness management. They accompany every senior group throughout the journey.
Walk slowly and do not panic.
Hydrate continuously with water and ORS.
Do not smoke or drink alcohol.
Take 20-30 minute rest breaks on the Kedarnath trek.
Carry doctor-recommended medication and portable oxygen.
Dress in layers to handle changing temperatures.

blocks.text: Helicopter Slot Availability and Priority Rules

blocks.text: Chardham Yatra by Helicopter is the quickest and easiest method to visit the four holy Himalayan sacred sites, Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath, and Badrinath, in a brief period of time. This aerial pilgrimage has been planned to serve the elderly, families, and pilgrims with time constraints, thus avoiding roads and long walks.

items: Route: Arrival in Dehradun → Dehradun - Yamunotri → Yamunotri - Gangotri → Gangotri - Kedarnath → Kedarnath - Badrinath → Badrinath - Dehradun

blocks.text: One the first day of your Chardham Yatra by Helicopter, you will be arriving at Dehradun and greeted by our tour representative. You will be transferred to your allotted here for an overnight complimentary stay in Dehradun. You shall be staying the night here.

This day will mark the official commencement of your helicopter Char Dham Yatra. You will be checked out of the hotel and dropped off at the Sahastradhara Helipad of Dehradun which is also the starting point of this holy journey. You will be flown to the first destination of Kharsali Helipad which is located near Yamunotri Temple. On arriving in Kharsali you will further be transferred to the starting point of the 7 km long trek to this easternmost temple. This 7 km long route can easily be covered on a pony or a Palki ride with ease. After completing your VIP Darshan, you will be taken back to Kharsali. You will be checked in to your hotel here for an overnight stay. The remainder of the day will be free for you to relax in the hotel. Places You’ll See

Your journey to Gangotri by helicopter will begin early in the morning the next day after breakfast. After a helicopter ride of around 45 minutes, you will be dropped off at Harsil Helipad which is the nearest and the only Helipad for Gangotri Dham temple. On reaching Harsil you will be taken to the temple of Gangotri via a cab ride which will take around one hour. By afternoon your VIP holy Darshan of Gangotri Temple will be completed and you will be taken to your allotted hotel in Harsil for an overnight stay. After Darshan, the remainder of the day will be free for you to relax and spend time in leisure amidst the grand Himalayan beauty. Places You’ll See

Your trip to Kedarnath will begin early in the morning after breakfast. It will be a journey of around 45 minutes from Harsil Helipad to the Helipad for Kedarnath which can be Guptkashi, Sersi, Sitapur or Phata. As per the directions of Uttarakhand government in order to preserve the untouched beauty of the Kedarnath Himalayas, you will be transferred into a government chopper which has the permit to get you to Kedarnath Temple directly. Surpassing the 18 km long uphill trek you will be taken to Kedarnath Helipad within 10 minutes and is located just 500 metres away from the main temple entrance. You will be given 1.5 hours to complete your Darshan in Kedarnath before heading back to the helipad. From here on you will be taken back to your hotel near Kedarnath for an overnight stay. You can plan some sightseeing around Kedarnath as well during this time. Places You’ll See

After having your breakfast early in the morning your journey to your next destination of Badrinath Dham will begin. This will be a chopper ride of around 45 minutes to half an hour. After the completion of your Darshan and sightseeing of Badrinath Dham you will be taken back to your hotel near the temple for an overnight stay. Places You’ll See

After the special Abhishek Puja in Badrinath Dham Temple, you will be taken for another Darshan of Badri Vishal. Finally, after the completion of your puja rituals in Badrinath, you will be headed to the Badrinath Helipad. Finally, your Char Dham Yatra by Helicopter will come to an end with your drop-off in Sahastradhara Helipad where the journey had kickstarted. Upon your drop off in Dehradun Helipad, you will be free to go to your desired destination.

items: Chennai Mahabalipuram Thanjavur Trichy Madurai Tour

blocks.text: Explore beautiful heritage of South India with our Chennai Mahabalipuram Thanjavur Trichy Madurai Tour. Journey starts from Chennai, a city full of history, temples and beautiful beaches.

items: Route: Arrive at Chennai - Mahabalipuram - Pondicherry

blocks.text: Day 1: Arrive at Chennai - Mahabalipuram - Pondicherry (Approx. 208 km/ 4-5 Hours)

Start your trip to with a warm welcome at Chennai Airport or Railway Station. Our My Quick Trippers representative will meet you and help you travel to Mahabalipuram. If you include a guide, he will come with the driver to assist you throughout the day. After pick-up, you will start your tour and visit- Arjuna’s Penance (Monument) Krishna Mandapam (Rock cut cave temple) Cave Temples Pancha Rathas (UNESCO World Heritage Site) After completing the main sightseeing in Mahabalipuram , drive to Pondicherry. On arrival, check into your hotel and enjoy your overnight stay in Pondicherry. Note- Arjuna’s Penance timings are from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Places You’ll See
DAY 2: Pondicherry- Chidambaram - Kumbakonam (Approx. 133 km / 3 hrs Drive)

Morning after breakfast, check out from the hotel and visit Auroville Matrimandir , a place for meditation. It is believed that it took 37 years to build Matrimandir (It is a beautiful spot to click photos). After checking into your hotel, visit Sri Aurobindo Ashram , a famous and wealthy ashram in India, where people from all over the world come to relax and feel calm. Next, explore Arulmigu Manakula Vinayagar Temple , dedicated to Lord Ganesh. Go to the Puducherry Museum , where the huge Chola-era statues look so real, it feels like they could move any moment. Later, drive to Chidambaram , a temple town famous for the Thillai Nataraja Temple , spread over 40 acres and part of the Pancha Bhoota, which represents Sky (Akasha). Proceed to Gangaikonda Cholapuram , popular for the Brihadeeswarar Temple , dedicated to Lord Shiva. The temple has one of the largest Shivling in India, around 13.5 ft tall. Drive to Kumbakonam. On arrival, check into the hotel. Overnight stay at the hotel. Places You’ll See
DAY 3: Kumbakonam - Thanjavur (Tanjore) - Rameshwaram (300 - 310 km / 5.5-6 Hrs Drive)

After breakfast, check out of the hotel and visit Kumbakonam , popular for Adi Kumbeswarar Temple , and go to the nearby Mahamaham Tank, where pilgrims take a holy dip. Later, Then explore Airavatesvara Temple at Darasuram , a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The temple walls show dances, musicians, and stories of gods that will amaze art lovers! Drive to Thanjavur (Tanjore). On arrival, travel to the Brihadeeswara Temple. The interesting fact is that no cement was used in this temple. Now, go to Thanjavur Palace , where the Maratha kings lived from 1674 to 1855 and explore Thanjavur Art Gallery. Drive to Rameshwaram , located on Pamban Island. According to legend, this is the place where Lord Rama built a bridge across the sea to Lanka to rescue Sita from Ravana. On arrival, check into the hotel. Overnight stay at Rameshwaram. Note- Wear comfortable shoes as there will be a lot of walking at the temples. Places You’ll See
DAY 4: In Rameswaram - Full Sightseeing Tour

Early in the morning, around 5:00 AM , proceed to the Spatika Linga Darshan , also called Mani Darshan , where the natural crystal Shivling (not man-made) is very important in Hinduism and looks very beautiful. Later you will head out for Agni Teertham to have a holy bath in the sea. Further proceed to the main temple through North gate and Take sacred bath with holy water of the 22 wells, inside the Ramanathaswamy Temple during Theerth Snanam. Then proceed for darshan and pooja at the main temple. After breakfast, proceed for a full sightseeing tour of Rameswaram , which includes Five-faced Hanuman Temple, Ramar Patham, Kothandaramaswamy Temple, Gandamadana Parvatham (where Lord Rama’s Footprint is located), Rama Setu / Adam’s Bridge, Former President A. P. J. Abdul Kalam House , and Dhanushkodi. After finishing the sightseeing, return to the hotel and stay overnight in Rameswaram. Places You’ll See

In the Morning, visit the Ramanathaswamy Temple once again or take a Samudra Snanam (holy dip in the sea). After this, check out of the hotel and drive to Kanyakumari where the Bay of Bengal , the Arabian Sea and the Indian Ocean meet. Kanyakumari is special because it’s the only place where you can see both the sunrise and sunset over the ocean (perfect spot for amazing photos ). On arrival check into your hotel and relax for the rest of the day. Overnight stay at the hotel. Places You’ll See

Wake up early to enjoy the sunrise view in Kanyakumari . Return to the hotel for breakfast. After breakfast, you can visit Swami Vivekananda Rock Memorial , located on a small rock surrounded by water, the landscape views of the sea is outstanding! Walk over the Sea by Glass bridge to reach Thiruvalluvar Statue. Then, travel to Kanyakumari Mandir , this temple is built in Kerala-style architecture , so just get ready to click photos. Next, see Tri Samudra Milan and Gandhi Mandapam , and later drive to Madurai Note- You can’t take pictures inside the inner temple. Places You’ll See

Morning after breakfast, check out of the hotel and begin a sightseeing tour of Madurai. Visit Meenakshi Sundareswarar Temple , Here, the temple’s famous elephant, Parvathi, used to bless people by softly placing her trunk on their heads. She was loved by many tourists. After temple Darshan, visit Thiruparankundram Murugan Temple. Next, travel to Tiruchirappalli (Trichy) , known for its rich heritage and monuments. Once you reach, check into the hotel and stay overnight. Places You’ll See

Morning after breakfast, check out from the hotel and start your sightseeing tour of Tiruchirappalli. Your tour starts at the Sri Ranganatha Swamy Temple in Srirangam, one of the 108 holy Vishnu temple, famous for its 21 towers and impressive architecture (great photo spot). Next, visit the nearby Jambukeswarar Akilandeswari Temple , the fact is that it represents the element of Water and the temple's underground water never dries up, even when removed. Then, explore the Ucchi Pillayar Temple , built on top of Rockfort. From here, enjoy a stunning view of the city and the Cauvery River (don’t forget to click pictures). After that visit Government Museum at Rani Mangammal Mahal - where unique artwork and the region's history will amaze you.. Next, visit the Butterfly Park , a calm place full of colorful butterflies. Then travel to Nakshatra Vanam , a beautiful garden nearby. After sightseeing, proceed to Tiruvannamalai . On arrival, check in to your hotel and relax. Overnight stay at Tiruvannamalai. Note- Try the local snacks near Rockfort - it’s tasty and part of Trichy’s culture. Places You’ll See

Morning after breakfast, check out from the hotel and visit the Annamalaiyar Temple , one of the biggest temples in India. It’s a peaceful place where you can feel strong spiritual vibes. After your temple visit, drive towards Kanchipuram . Long ago, Kanchipuram was a great learning hub where people studied Hinduism, Jainism, and Buddhism. On arrival, check in to the hotel. Overnight stay at Kanchipuram. Places You’ll See

After breakfast, check out of the hotel and visit Kamakshi Amman Temple dedicated to Goddess Kamakshi where devotees believe their wishes are fulfilled if they go with a pure heart. Next visit Varadharaja Perumal Temple , dedicated to Lord Vishnu and one of the 108 Divya Desams. Continue to Kailasanathar Temple , it’s 1,350 years old temple dedicated to Lord Shiva. Then explore Ekambareswarar Temple dedicated to Lord Murugan. It is part of the Pancha Bhoota (five elements) and is connected with the earth element (Prithvi). Also visit Kumarakottam Temple , dedicated to Lord Murugan. If time allows, go shopping in Kanchipuram , famous for its hand-made silk Sarees. Later, drive to Chennai. Your Chennai Mahabalipuram Thanjavur Trichy Madurai travel package ends with happy memories as you are transferred to Chennai Airport or the railway station for your journey to your next destination. blocks.text: China is an ancient country and one of those nations where one of the great human civilizations was born and nurtured, with a history spanning over 5000 years it is a tempting place for tourists on Tour Packages. Not only history the vast and varied geography of China is a huge attraction in itself, extending from the deserts in the west and to the ocean in the east, snowcapped mountains and green carpeted hilly region, this place provides unforgettable time on Tour Packages.

Some of the topnotch attractions of China deserving to be a part of every tour package include historical places, natural spots, cities and architectural wonders. The Forbidden City or Palace Museum is at the center of the city of Beijing, a UNESCO world heritage site and imperial seat of Qing and Ming dynasty. The Great Wall of China is not to miss attraction of this country, an architectural grandeur which took more than 2000 years to complete. The views from the wall are mesmerizing and unending view of the wall captivates the visitors, truly a wonder and must visit on China Tour Packages.

Hangzhou is called China’s paradise on Earth, this city is cultural center of China and situated around famous West Lake. This city has greenery, tranquil temples, hills surrounding the city with green slopes and streets full of historical buildings. The atmosphere in the city is very relaxing and calm and one finds it soothing place to be on China Holiday Packages. Potala Palace in Lhasa is now a Chinese museum with imposing white walls surrounding the red colored majestic palace inside with golden roof. This palace used to be the seat of Dalai Lama but now houses many wonderful exhibits depicting history, art and culture of the country. Tibet is full of natural splendor and one must not miss a chance to visit this place on China Travel Packages.

No China Holiday Package is complete without visiting Xian, this city is one of the seven ancient capitals of China and served as capital for more than 1000 years. This city houses many ancient relics and remnants of China’s imperial history. Places like Entombed Warriors the eighth wonder of the world, two Buddhist Pagodas named as Big Wild Goose and Small Wild Goose Pagodas, the City Wall and Banpo Site a prehistoric museum are must see places of Xian on China Travel Packages.

One cannot miss Hong Kong while on China Tour Package. Named as Oriental London, this city has fusion of many cultures and an exotic display of amalgamation of modernism with ancient traditions. World’s most famous shopping paradise and a vibrant city has many natural places to visit, Lantau Island are one of them. Exotic beaches and nightlife is the biggest attraction of this city for tourists on Tour Packages. Guilin is famous for its stunning natural beauty and attracts people on Tour Packages by its verdant mountains, unique rockeries, crystal clear waters and unique caves and stones of different shapes. Ethnic minorities living here since ages add up to the cultural wealth of this city and makes it a captivating place to be on China Tour Packages.

blocks.text: Cochin Munnar Thekkady Alleppey Tour Package is perfect for travelers who want to see Kerala's nature, wildlife, and culture - all in one tour.

items: Route: Cochin Arrival and Sightseeing → Cochin - Munnar → Munnar Sightseeing → Munnar - Thekkady → Thekkady - Alleppey → Alleppey - Cochin

blocks.text: When you arrive at Cochin Airport, our My Quick Trippers representative will welcome you and take you to the hotel for check-in. If you have hired a guide, they will come with the driver and help you in the whole trip. After check-in, enjoy your Cochin tour and visit- Jewish Synagogue Dutch Palace (Mattancherry Palace): Famous for its beautiful wall paintings that show stories from the Ramayana and Mahabharata. St. Francis Church Chinese Fishing Net- Famous spot in Cochin, introduced by Chinese traders. The sunset view here is stunning (Don't forget to click pictures). Once your sightseeing is done, relax and stay overnight in Cochin. Note- Dutch Palace is closed on Fridays. Places You’ll See

In the morning have breakfast and then drive to Munnar , one of Kerala's top destination. Experience the journey as you travel through beautiful landscapes full of green hills, rivers, and flowing waterfalls. On the way, enjoy the beautiful tea gardens, spice plantations and thick forests. Their fragrance makes journey refreshing and shows Kerala's beauty. When you reach Munnar, check into your hotel and spend the day relaxing or exploring the surroundings freely. Overnight stay at Munnar . Places You’ll See

After an early morning breakfast get ready to explore the scenic beauty and attractions of Munnar . Walk through Munnar's beautiful tea gardens famous for their high quality tea. Smell the fresh leaves and learn how tea is made. Visit Mattupetty Lake and Dam , a peaceful spot surrounded by hills, where you can enjoy boating (optional). Next go to Echo Point and have fun in this unique spot as your voice bounces back from hills. Now proceed to Kundala Lake, a calm spot perfect for photography and enjoying the peaceful surroundings. If you get time try to meditate here. Explore Rajamalai famous for the rare Nilgiri Tahr, and enjoy the amazing views. You can also see unique plants and wildlife here. Places You’ll See

After breakfast, go to Thekkady , a perfect spot for nature lovers. Drive takes you through green valleys, tea gardens, and hills with great views all around. Visit Periyar Tiger Reserve in Thekkady and explore its rich wildlife, full of animals, birds, and natural beauty. Stay overnight at the hotel. Places You’ll See

After breakfast proceed to Alleppey (Alappuzha), famously known as the "Venice of the East." Option 1- Stay at Hotel On arrival check into your hotel. Evening Activities- Go on a peaceful cruise ride on Vembanad Lake (optional) and enjoy the calm water and sunset. (Pay separately) Walk along Alleppey Beach , enjoy the peaceful surroundings, and take some time for a small picnic. Enjoy shopping in local markets where you can find unique gifts, handmade crafts, and regional products. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay in Alleppey. Option 2- Houseboat Stay On arrival check in to your traditional Kettuvallam (Houseboat) for a unique backwater experience. As the boat moves, you'll pass through local villages, see many coconut trees, and spot different bird species - it's a special time to take amazing videos. Enjoy fresh meals on the houseboat, including a delicious dinner. Stay overnight on the houseboat. Note - Mosquitoes can be around while on the houseboat, so don't forget to bring some insect repellent. Places You’ll See

After a breakfast, leave the hotel or houseboat and go to Cochin, you will be dropped at the bus station, airport, or railway station for your next destination. Thank you for choosing us for your journey. Your trip ends with happy memories you will always remember. Places You’ll See

blocks.text: Located in Karnataka, India, Coorg is known as the “Scotland of India”. It has the charm of a long-lost world and tourists are pleased to discover historical and sacred places that can be admired, as well as spectacular views and recreational sites. Coorg is also a popular honeymoon destination. Why choose this peaceful town? There are a lot of reasons and the most important one is the fact that it offers you a break from your fast-paced life. You are going to spend some time in a place where there are no worries, no everyday chores, and where no one is in a hurry. Enjoy this spectacular vacation trip with Coorg Tour Packages.

You will have the possibility of discovering the past hand in hand with your spouse and walking together in sacred places in front of the divinity. Visit this romantic place with Coorg honeymoon packages to enjoy a beautiful vacation. What better way to get to know each other than walking together in an orange orchard and remaining breathless in front of the wonders of nature on the banks of Brahmagiri Tank? If you want to know how Indian kings felt when watching the sunset, you should go to the tourist place that is considered the most scenic in India: the Raja’s Seat. It is not reserved for kings anymore, but it is a public garden. Why not take a few minutes to see what the splendid landscape looked like for the kings?

If you are looking for tourist places that are related to the beauty of nature, you should go to Abbey Falls. The sight of the water falling and the noise that it makes are a true symbol of the superiority of nature. This is also a great place for picnics, so take your time here and enjoy. Irrupu Falls is a tourist place that religious people should see. It is a place of pilgrimage because it is strongly associated with the hero of Ramayana. A temple built for Lord Shiva can also be found in the nearby of the Ramathiratha River. Another tourist place for those interested in religion is Omakareswhara temple. It was built over two hundred years ago to honor both Shiva and Vishnu. What’s amazing about this temple is the fact that it combines the Islamic and Gothic architectural styles. Book your Coorg Tour Packages and get an insight into this fabulous honeymoon destination.

items: Corbett Nainital Tour Package from Delhi

blocks.text: Curious to walk near beautiful lakes and experience nature’s wildlife?

This 4-day Corbett Nainital Tour Package from Delhi is full of adventures and calm atmosphere you’ll remember forever. The journey begins in Nainital, where you’ll explore Naini Lake, shaped like a human eye and people enjoy its magical sunset views.

Don’t miss Snow View Point, known for its stunning views of the snow-covered Himalayas. You can also take a Ropeway Ride where clouds pass by and everything below looks small and beautiful, which creates a memorable experience.

Now, the tour moves to Jim Corbett National Park, India’s first national park. Animal lovers will have a fantastic time here, with the jungle safari as one of the most exciting part of this trip. If time permits, try to explore the hidden waterfalls, a perfect spot to relax and enjoy the peaceful forest. This Delhi to Corbett and Nainital Travel plan includes transport, hotel stays and guides. Let’s dive into this adventure!

blocks.text: Q1. What is the Nainital to Corbett National Park Distance?
Ans. Nainital is around 130–140 km from Corbett National Park, and it takes roughly 3–4 hours to drive, depending on traffic and road conditions.
Q2. What is the best time to visit Nainital and Jim Corbett?
Ans. The best time to explore Nainital and Corbett is March to June for nice weather and wildlife spotting, or September to November for cooler, clearer and less crowded days.
Q3. What animals can we see on a Corbett jeep safari?
Ans. While visiting, you can see tigers, elephants, leopards, deer, and different birds. Seeing these animals in the forest is a wonderful experience.
Q4. Can we customize the tour package?
Ans. Absolutely! Tour packages can be customized. You can extend your stay, choose different hotels or add extra sightseeing places so the trip matches your personal interests and comfort.
Q5. Are road conditions good between Nainital and Corbett?
Ans. Main roads are usually well maintained but in the hills some areas are narrow. Take your time while driving and enjoy the journey safely.

Nainital, formerly anglicized as Naini Tal, is a town and headquarters of Nainital district of Kumaon division, Uttarakhand, India. It is the judicial capital of Uttarakhand, the High Court of the state being located there and is the headquarters of an eponymous district. It also houses the Governor of Uttarakhand, who resides in the Raj Bhavan. Nainital was the summer capital of the United Provinces.

Nainital is renowned for its rich cultural heritage, historical significance, and diverse attractions. From ancient temples and forts to modern amenities and natural beauty, Nainital offers an unforgettable experience for every traveler.

The ideal time to visit Nainital is during the winter months (October to March) when the weather is pleasant and perfect for sightseeing. Monsoon season (July to September) brings lush greenery, while summer (April to June) is suitable for high-altitude areas.

Nainital is well-connected by road, rail, and air. The nearest airport and major railway stations provide convenient access from all major Indian cities. Our tour packages include comfortable AC transport and professional guides.

blocks.text: Dalhousie is one of the most popular hill stations in the district of Chamba located in Himachal Pradesh. Dalhousie is present in the outskirts of the Dhauladhar ranges in Himachal Pradesh. The hill station is named after Lord Dalhousie – the founder of the place. Surrounding Dalhousie there are 5 hills and they are- Tehra, Bakrota, Balun, Kathlog and Petreyn. It covers an area of about 13 sq km. Dalhousie ranges between the altitude of 1,525m – 2,378m above the level of the sea. The Dalhousie Tour Packages include the entire area.

In 1903 the St Andrew’s Church also known as the Church of Scotland was built. It is a Protestant Catholic Church in Baloon. The St Francis Church is a replica of one the famous Church in England. The church has a striking blend of stone and glass work. Apart from these two churches, the Dalhousie Holiday Packages also include the St Patrick’s Church and the St John’s Church. Scottish and Victorian architecture is the main beauty of these monuments. In between a dense forest is the Bara Pathar Temple. The temple is famous for the forest. One of the most picturesque places to visit in Dalhousie is Panchpula. It is the stream in Panchpula that adds to the splendor of the place.

At a height of about 2,000 m above the level of the sea is located Khajjar. It is at a distance of 27 km from the town of Dalhousie. There is a small lake surrounded by deodar and pine trees. There is a 12th century temple in this lush green vicinity. The Dalhousie Tour Packages include Subhash Baoli,which is a famous spot named after Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose – an eminent freedom fighter of India. Kalatop is another spot that provides you with the picturesque view of the areas surrounding Dalhousie. It is located at a height of about 2,440 m above the level of the sea and is at 8.5 km from Dalhousie.

At a distance of 10 km from Dalhousie town is Bakrota hills. It is at a height of about 2,745 m above the level of the sea. The Bakrota hills are very famous among tourists as it provides you with a picturesque view of the mountains. Dainkund is one of the most famous locations included in the Dalhousie Travel Packages. It is at an altitude of about 2,745 m above the level of the sea. On a clear day you can see the rivers – Chenab, Beas and Ravi, flowing. It is located at 10 km from Dalhousie.

Adventure sports play an important part in the Dalhousie holiday packages. The Bakrota hills provide good trekking opportunities. Trekking via the Chobia pass from Chamba to Udaipur is very famous. Trekking along Mcleod Gang from Chamba through Minkiani pass is another favorite route. The other sport that is very famous in Dalhousie is camping. The Khajjar Lake is a beautiful location for camping. The best season to visit Dalhousie is from the month of May till the month of September.

blocks.text: Popularly known as “Queen of Hills”, Darjeeling is one of the most eminent holiday destinations of almost every travel enthusiast. The breathtaking views of the mountains, picturesque surroundings, beautiful monasteries, and panoramic landscapes take Darjeeling tourism a notch higher.
This gorgeous hill station is blessed with steep mountain ridges bestowed with lush green tea plantations and offers you mesmerizing views of the sunrise from snow-peaked mountains.

Gangtok, the capital city of Sikkim, leaves every traveler awestruck and spellbound with its impeccable spiritual aura and tremendous scenic vista. The city boasts of various exciting tourist places where travelers from far around the country visit and feel immensely astonished with the views of Kanchenjunga, the third highest mountain peak in the world. It happens to be one of the best places to start your newly married life with positivity and love.

On this 5 nights and 6 days long Darjeeling honeymoon package you will be provided with enough time and opportunity to witness the glory and charm of these cities and can enjoy some really amazing and romantic moments with your family and friends. On this honeymoon trip, My Quick Trippers will provide you great services and facilities that include transportation, food, a cozy and comfy stay, and many more.

Arrive in New Jalpaiguri and Bagdogra to a warm welcome by our tour guide who then escorts you to the coach that will take you to your hotel. Relax a bit and as the sun starts dipping, set out to explore The Mall and sample the local cuisine.

Rise early at around 3 AM and set out in the cool air of pre-dawn to Tiger Hill and wait with bated breath for the Sun to rise over the Kanchenjunga. This sight alone is worth the trip and both of you will remember it forever. Return via Batasia Loop where you can see the railway line spiraling around before vanishing into a tunnel. Take in the Ghoom Monastery later in the day and then you can, on your own, visit the Japanese Temple and Peace Pagoda or wander out of town to stroll along the waterfalls. Lovers love riding on the toy train and this is something you should not miss.

After breakfast, the group sets out on an excursion that will take you to the Himalayan Mountaineering Institute, the Dhirdham Temple, and the Zoological Gardens. There is a brief interlude as you take a ride on the ropeway after which we visit Lebong Race Course, Gombu Rock, Happy valley tea estate, and the Peace Pagoda. Return to your room for the night.

Enjoy a Bengali breakfast in the crisp morning air and board the coach for the 100 km drive to Gangtok across scenic, winding mountain roads. The half-day trip to Gangtok includes a visit to Hanuman Tok, Namgyal Institute of Tibetology, Tashi View Point with its wonderful view of the Himalayas, Rumtek Monastery, and Ganesh Tok. Stay in the picturesque Buddhist environment of Gangtok for the night.

Enjoy a Tibetan breakfast and then we take you to Tsomgo Lake in East Sikkim. The trip includes a visit to Baba Harbhajan Temple and the forbidden Nathula Pass located at a height of 4310 meters that was once a part of the Silk Route.

On this last and final day, you have a sumptuous breakfast and board the coach for the return drive to New Jalpaiguri/Bagdogra over a distance of 110 km that in itself is a beautiful journey that lovers enjoy. When you arrive the tour guide assists you with onward travel and bids you a fond farewell.

blocks.text: Delhi is rich in history! From its heritage buildings to its palaces to trendy markets, there's just so much to see here! Book our Delhi Tour Packages and we'll take you to all the great places here. With our services, you get meals, hotels, and transport, which will make your trip utterly comfortable and luxurious. Contact us now and let us help you uncover the real glory of the capital!
Visiting Delhi means enjoying the following:

First stop, Old Delhi! Imagine for a second several blocks of narrow streets with the smell of various tasty foods and the sound of the packed crowd. There, you can admire the Jama Masjid , which is a beautiful mosque with splendid domes. The awe-inspiring Red Fort is the next, a place of monumental importance and history. Furthermore, cast a glance at Qutub Minar , an old monument that towers high and carries lots of stories within itself.

We move our focus now to New Delhi and see everything glistening and brand new. In this place, you can probably observe super-high skyscrapers and government facades. The Presidential Palace, or the Rashtrapati Bhavan , in which the President lives, is a very beautiful building! Definitely add these to your Delhi Sightseeing Tour!
A Feast for the Senses: A Feast for the Senses

Delhi offers some good food also. Away from spicy street food like chaat, there is equally rich Mughlai food to please every mood or requirement. So come on, take a bite, and let your taste buds go on the tour.

Walk to Lodhi Colony, a street where every stone is aching to serve as a means of expression. In addition, visit the city museums and galleries, which are a wonderful avenue to learn about the history and tradition of Delhi.
Delhi has a lot to offer you and these varieties of destinations should definitely be a part of your Delhi Tour Package.

items: Top places to explore in Delhi
Delhi has always been a hub of culture while the megalopolis' past space of many ethnicities weaving together is full of stories hundreds and even thousands of years old.
It simply exudes a unique blend of old and new, classic and contemporary. Embracing a whole spectrum of tastes and propensities.

Because we have spiritual, historical & political interests here, we will travel to Central Delhi next. There, we can see the Raj Ghat , India Gate , Bangla Sahib , Rashtrapati Bhavan , and the Parliament House , which are all located in proximity.
Delhi tourism offers several occasions to experience its kaleidoscope of festivals, lip-smacking food, majestic monuments, sparkling museums, and nightlight flamboyance.
The journey to Delhi can be made very economical by choosing our affordable Delhi travel packages curated by travel experts.

blocks.text: Delhi offers diverse transport options. The Indira Gandhi International Airport set the scene for air travel links to main cities. On top of that, there's a railway network. Locally, you can also enjoy your Delhi tour with buses, taxis, and the Metro. Our Delhi tour package with hotel and guide helps you with transport in and around the city as well.

Delhi's Indira Gandhi International Airport provides robust air connectivity as it operates both domestic and international flights. Departures from Terminals 1D and 3 correspond to different airlines and offer outstanding service through shuttle buses, metro, and taxi pre-booking for onward travel to the city center.

Delhi's railway network, including principal stations like New Delhi, Old Delhi, and Nizamuddin, makes it possible to connect several cities from different parts of the country. Upon getting off at the station, travellers can easily get a taxi, take a Metro, or use the buses of DTC for local transport.

Delhi has a well-established network of roads linking it with the neighbouring states and cities using buses and private motor cars. Interstate bus terminals and national highways have options for traveling to Delhi and beyond, from short to long distances.

Delhi's local transport has many varieties. You have many options like DTC buses, taxis, Metro, auto rickshaws, and eco-friendly options like electric rickshaws and smart bikes. Each transportation system has its particular purpose for travellers, ensuring accessibility and convenience in the busy streets.
With our Delhi Holiday Packages, you don't have to worry about the local transport, as we'll provide you with a private luxury car that will take you to all the destinations in this trip.

Delhi's seasons promise varied experiences: summer mango festivals and indoor fun, monsoon rejuvenating art gallery visits and park explorations, winter demanding festive mood, and sightseeing in smog being a necessity with season-specific safety measures.
The best time to visit Delhi is from October to March . It's perfect for enjoying pleasant weather. Moreover, you also get to witness the vibrant festivals that happen here in this window.
However, if you're looking for a full spectrum of Delhi experience, then here's a season-wise breakdown.

Enjoy amazing sightseeing in Delhi, and beware of smog. Carry woolen clothes and warm layers.

blocks.text: The cost of our Delhi Local Sightseeing Tour is just INR 3,500 . And if you 3ant to club this tour with other nearby attractions, such as Agra, Haridwar, Nainital, or Jaipur, then the cost will go up to INR 7,000. Check out our various trip packages and see what suits you best!
In our tour plan, we include meals, hotels, and dedicated transport with a professional driver. Come and join in this unique adventure that you’ve never been on before!
Top Places to Visit on Delhi Sightseeing Tour
To taste the real Delhi, add the following places to your Delhi Travel Packages itinerary and thank us later!

Humayun's tomb is a clear manifestation of the eternal love between Mughal emperor Humayun and his first wife, Empress Haji Begum. The mausoleum guards the graves of both rulers. It's popular for its magical appearance and beautiful natural surroundings.

The Qutub Minar is a 73-foot-tall monument that has been here almost as long as the history of the Delhi Sultanate. It is proudly referenced as the world's tallest brick minaret by the UNESCO World Heritage Site.

This Mughal architectural masterpiece has red sandstone walls, where Shah Jahan resided. It showcases a subtle blend of Islamic, Hindu, Persian, and Timurid design features. Must be included in any Delhi Tourism Package!

Check into New Delhi's Air Force Museum to understand the story of the Indian Air Force. Interactive memorials, photos, and artifacts presented in different ways allow visitors a memorable experience.
Delhi's National Crafts Museum & Hastkala Academy house unique artifacts featuring traditional crafts such as textiles and clay figures.

Founded in 1949, the institute boasts an expansive repository of artefacts that date as far back as ancient civilizations. From manuscripts to numismatics, jewellery to textiles, you can find every form of historic creation here.

The National Science Centre, named "Dream Castle for One and All," is one of the largest science centers in Asia. Spreading from 8 floors, it displays interactive science exhibits including the Heritage & Dinosaur Gallery and Human Biology Gallery.
Paranthe wali Gali, Kuremal Mohan Lal Kulfi Wale, Khan Omelette Corner, etc.
Nazim's Kathi Roll, Mutton Curry at Kake Da Hotel, Jain Chawal Wale, etc. A perfect addition for a weekend tour packages from Delhi!

Sikh spirituality is epitomized by Gurudwara Bangla Sahib, which is distinguished by its peaceful and uninterrupted (24/7) prayer services. The quiet pond makes it look even more appealing, so this place should be visited, especially at night.

To feel the energy of old and new coexisting, visit Hauz Khas Village, which has a vibrant nightlife and historic reservoirs. The area has many pubs, clubs, and restaurants. A must-visit on your 1 day Delhi tour.
A popular morning walking spot, Deer Park consists of Picnic Huts and is located close to Hauz Khas village.
The garden is particularly well known for its green features, artwork placements, and statues, immersing its visitors in a sensuous experience.
It has large meadows, plenty of flower beds, and wooded grounds that bring people here for walks, picnics, and to take a break.

items: Always have a water bottle with you to avoid waterborne diseases.
While visiting any religious institutions, make sure you wear modest clothes.
Book your Delhi City Tour in advance.
If you're going on a Delhi tour in the summer, then wear cotton clothes.
To protect yourself from pollution, wear N-95 or N-99 masks.
Be wary of pickpockets, especially in crowded markets and other areas.

blocks.text: Dharamshala is a beautiful one-of-a-kind hill station in Himachal Pradesh where impeccable natural beauty meets unmatched spirituality. Home of the Dalai Lama, the entire region is dotted with big and small monasteries and places of worship that have helped in making this place extremely peaceful, scenic, and with a level of positivity that cannot be experienced anywhere in the world. There are several places for a curious travel bug to explore. This place is the epitome of a spiritual travel destination, encapsulated by thick green forests, decorated with varied biodiversity and valleys and gorges that add a deeper sense of beauty.

Dharamshala is primarily famous for its scenic vistas and grandeur along with holding a lot of spiritual value, especially for the followers of Buddhism. People prefer to go there as a part of their extended weekend getaway from Delhi or even for solo travel expeditions. Going there is truly an experience of a lifetime and a journey worth every while. There is no dearth of places for one to visit there like Namgyal Monastery – the largest Tibetan temple outside of Tibet, Thekchen Choling Temple Complex, Tsuglagkhang – the first monastery to be built during the arrival of Dalai Lama in India in 1959, Kangra art museum, Kangra fort and so much more.

Dharamshala is not just about typical mountain beauty it has a very dynamic history and represents various traditions, beliefs, and culture that has survived over the years. Recently it has also turned into one of the most top-notch destinations for going on forest hikes, trekking expeditions, and other such offbeat trails. Triund has become a paradise for beginner trekkers and has gained a lot of attention from travelers across the globe since at the end of the trek i.e. at Triund top you can Savour scenic views of the snowcapped hill ranges on all sides.

We offer you the opportunity to cater to your needs and requirements as well since all our Dharamshala travel packages are highly customizable.

Sound good? blocks.text: Book Your Divine Do Dham Yatra Now

A journey to Kedarnath & Badrinath or Gangotri & Yamunotri is not just about visiting temples - it's an opportunity to reconnect with your spiritual self. Let us plan every tour detail for you while you immerse in devotion and natural beauty!
Call us now at +91-8171158569 or send an inquiry to know more about travel solutions, fixed departures, and early booking offers!
Q1. How many days are required for Do Dham Yatra?
Usually, 4 to 6 days are sufficient for road travel. The exact duration depends on the route and travel mode. Helicopter packages can complete the Yatra in 1-4 days.
Q2. Can I cover Kedarnath without trekking?
Yes, you can skip the trek entirely and opt for helicopter service from Phata, Sirsi, or Guptkashi helipads. Pony and Palki (palanquin) services are also available from Gaurikund.
Q3. Are Do Dham helicopter tours safe for senior citizens?

Yes, the helicopter journey is designed keeping elderly pilgrims in mind. It eliminates the 18 km Kedarnath trek and long mountain road travel. Senior citizens with heart conditions, high BP, or respiratory issues must get a doctor's clearance before booking. Medical certificate is required at the time of registration for those above 60.
Q4. Can I customize my Do Dham Yatra package?
Yes, full customization is available - from the city you start, to the duration, stopovers, hotel category, and mode of travel. Contact us for a tailored quote.
Q5. Are medical services available on the route?

Yes, first-aid kits, oxygen support, and contact with nearby hospitals are available. SDRF (State Disaster Response Force) posts are staffed on the Kedarnath trek route. Helicopter evacuation can be arranged in emergencies by informing any checkpoint staff.
Q6. Is Yatra registration mandatory for Do Dham in 2026?

Yes - registration is compulsory for all four temples. Register at registrationandtouristcare.uk.gov.in before travelling. You'll receive a Yatra Pass that must be printed and carried. Checkpoints at Sonprayag (Kedarnath route) and on the Badrinath highway verify it. Arriving without a pass means you'll be turned back.
Q7. What is the best Do Dham combination - Kedarnath-Badrinath or Gangotri-Yamunotri?

Both combinations are spiritually complete in their own right. Kedarnath-Badrinath is more popular - it covers a Jyotirlinga (Shiva) and a Divya Desam (Vishnu). Gangotri-Yamunotri is less crowded, involves less physical strain (no 18 km trek), and is ideal for those who want a peaceful yatra focused on the river goddess temples.
Q8. What is the Do Dham Yatra cost by helicopter in 2026?

Same-day Kedarnath-Badrinath helicopter packages start at approximately INR 1,20,000-1,35,000 per person. Multi-day helicopter packages (3-4 days) range from INR 1,30,000 to 1,45,000. Prices include helicopter flights, VIP Darshan, meals, and transfers. Contact us for the most current 2026 pricing.
Q9. When do the Kedarnath and Badrinath temples open in 2026?

Kedarnath opens on 22 April 2026 and closes approximately 11 November 2026 (Bhai Dooj). Badrinath opens on 23 April 2026 and closes approximately 13 November 2026. Gangotri and Yamunotri both open on 19 April 2026 (Akshaya Tritiya) and close around Diwali (10-11 November 2026). Always confirm final dates at bktc.net closer to your travel date.
Q10. Can I do Kedarnath-Badrinath Do Dham by road in 5 days?

Yes - 5 days is the minimum comfortable timeline. Day 1: Haridwar/Delhi → Guptkashi. Day 2: Kedarnath Darshan (trek or helicopter) → return to Guptkashi. Day 3: Guptkashi → Joshimath. Day 4: Joshimath → Badrinath Darshan → Joshimath. Day 5: Return to Haridwar/Delhi. Rushing in fewer than 5 days is not recommended on mountain roads.
Q11. What nearby attractions can I add to my Do Dham trip?

For Kedarnath-Badrinath: Mana Village (last Indian village, 3 km from Badrinath), Tapt Kund (hot spring at Badrinath), Triyuginarayan Temple, Valley of Flowers (seasonal, June-Oct), Hemkund Sahib. For Gangotri-Yamunotri: Harsil Valley, Surya Kund at Yamunotri, Gaumukh glacier trek (19 km from Gangotri). Ask us to add these to your itinerary.
Q12. Is Do Dham Yatra possible in monsoon (July-August)?

Technically the temples are open, but travel is risky. July and August bring heavy landslides, especially on the Rudraprayag-Gaurikund road and Uttarkashi-Gangotri road. Road closures can last multiple days. For road travellers, July-August should be avoided. Helicopter Yatras are possible in monsoon but flights are frequently cancelled due to cloud cover - always keep buffer days if travelling in this window.

blocks.content: Gangotri is a town and a Nagar Panchayat (municipality) in Uttarkashi district in the state of Uttarakhand, India. It is 99 km from Uttarkashi, the main district headquarter. It is a Hindu pilgrim town on the banks of the river Bhagirathi – the origin of the river Ganges. The town is located on the Greater Himalayan Range, at a height of 3,100 metres (10,200 ft). According to a popular Hindu legend, the goddess Ganga descended here when Shiva released the mighty river from the locks of his hair.

Gangotri is renowned for its rich cultural heritage, historical significance, and diverse attractions. From ancient temples and forts to modern amenities and natural beauty, Gangotri offers an unforgettable experience for every traveler.

blocks.text: Some Surprising Truths on Dubai- World's most Ambitious City

Dubai has tall, towering buildings, a glimmering skyline, a place where numerous movies are shot each year, where people come together as one and create a vibe of immense adoration to this unbelievable man-made feat that makes us realize that anything is possible in the world. Here are some amazing facts to know about Dubai-
Dubai was once a Fishing Hub

Dubai's development started through oil exports after the 1960s. Before it, Dubai was only a simple fishing village. Today it is one of the fastest growing cities in the world which attracts travelers from all across the globe.

You will be compelled to think about whether Dubai is a city or a collection of world records. It has over 300 extraordinary achievements. It has the world's tallest building- Burj Khalifa, one of the world's largest shopping malls by total area — Dubai Mall, and the iconic luxury Burj Al Arab hotel, widely considered the world's most luxurious hotel.
Islands in Shape of Palm Tree

Have you ever seen the world's largest artificial archipelago? No? then see Palm Jumeirah. It is best seen from above from a helicopter ride or skydiving adventure. You will also see the iconic Burj Khalifa, Burj Al Arab, Atlantis, the Palm and Jumeirah beach shoreline.

Dubai receives sunshine throughout the year, and it has a very hot desert climate. Sometimes, the summer temperature can exceed 100 degrees. It receives very little rainfall (average of 25 days per year).

Can you believe that in Dubai you will enjoy snowfall? Well, Dubai is a city with endless possibilities. So, snowfall is also possible. At Ski Dubai, you will be able to enjoy snow adventures in summer. Enjoy indoor skiing and other snow adventure activities. The temperature will be around -2°C.
Experience Dubai like Never Before- Best Places to Visit in Dubai

Rising from a desert land creating an aura of ultimate thrill, adventure, and vibrancy it is a place for people of all age groups to have fun. Let's know about some of the best places to explore in Dubai -
In Burj Khalifa you will not only see a new tower but a new horizon. It is the tallest building in the World. Scale the new heights on the world's fastest glass elevator to the 124th floor.

In Dubai's Global Village, every culture finds home. You will be amazed to see various countries setting up pavilions to introduce you to their culture. There will be many shops, dining stalls where you will get to taste cuisine from all over the world.

Expect world's most delightful and exciting underwater adventure at Dubai's Aquarium and underwater Zoo. This underwater universe is home to thousands of marine species you have never seen before. Spot endangered tiger sharks, King Croc crocodile, Ray, giant Pacific octopus, giant grouper, blacktip reef sharks, etc.

Shaped like a Palm tree, Palm Jumeirah is one of the most visited tourist attractions in Dubai. It is the world's most exclusive shoreline. Enjoy world class luxury dining at places like Maiden Shanghai and Grand ZOR - Fairmount the Palm, adventure activities at water parks and exciting desert safari in the Dubai desert. Also, do you enjoy arcade games? If yes, visit GAME OVER Escape Rooms at Palm Jumeirah to enjoy family friendly escape rooms and arcade games.

Don't miss one of the world's largest shopping malls by total area. It is indeed one of the best places to hang out with your family and friends in Dubai. It's the beating heart of Dubai. There are around 1200 stores here and 120 restaurants and cafes. Shopping here means shopping around the world. There are also tons of leisure and entertainment options like Ekart Zabeel, VR Park, KidZania, China Town, Ice Rink and Dubai fountain show.

Mesmerized by Dubai's waterfront view at Dubai Marina. The views here will enchant your soul. There are also many eateries and cafes to savor delicious cuisines with your loved ones. Also enjoy skydiving over Palm Jumeirah yacht cruises and boat rides, and shop and dine at Marina Mall.
Dubai Bucket List- Things to Do
Dubai will leave you amazed right from the moment you step in. Let's check out some of the best activities to do in Dubai-
Dubai Miracle Garden - Blooming Miracles in the Desert

items: Explore Dubai Miracle Garden as it offers a variety of amazing botanical and artistic expressions.
Here you will witness a life- sized A38 aircraft which is not made of metal but of million petals. Don't miss the flower parade which features vibrant costumes, dance and music.
Pose for a selfie at one of the most scenic locations- Sunflower field here. It's a perfect place for a honeymoon couples' trip in Dubai.
Enjoy a thrilling desert safari adventure in Dubai deserts. Capture the beautiful views of dunes and sunset. Try exciting adventures like camelback riding and sandboarding.
Later, relax at a traditional desert campsite, savor delicious cuisines and enjoy cultural folk dance performances such as Tanoura Dance.
Dubai Fountain lake boat ride is one of the best things to do in Dubai. Leave all the chaos of the city on the shore and enjoy stunning views of Burj Khalifa.
Also view the most scenic and largest choreographed fountain from Burj Lake.

blocks.text: Rides at IMG Worlds of Adventure

items: IMG World adventure is one of the best places to explore in Dubai if you love adventures and want to spend quality time with your family.
Enjoy thrilling rides like The Last Valley and savor delicious food and buy amazing toys, merchandise and clothes as souvenirs from various stalls.
Sky Dubai's charm is unparalleled. It is the Middle East's first indoor Ski resort which is located in the Mall of Emirates.

If you want to try something unique then you must visit here. Enjoy snow adventure activities in summer like snowboarding, skiing and interacting with penguins. The resort is accessible throughout the year.

blocks.text: Standing 150 metres tall and shaped like a giant picture frame, Dubai Frame is one of the top 5 most-visited attractions in Dubai. The glass-floored sky bridge between the two towers gives you stunning views of old Dubai on one side and modern Dubai on the other. Located in Zabeel Park, it is an easy half-day visit. Price of Ticket: AED 50 | Timings: 9 AM — 9 PM daily

Originally built for Expo 2020, Expo City Dubai is now a permanent attraction. It houses the Terra — The Sustainability Pavilion, Al Wasl Plaza (the world's largest 360° projection dome), and the Women's Pavilion. Great for families and those interested in innovation and sustainability. Entry to the main grounds is free; individual pavilions have separate ticket prices.

blocks.text: Ramadan Travel in Dubai — What to Know

items: Eating, drinking and smoking in public during daylight hours is prohibited during Ramadan. Tourists must follow this rule outside of hotels and designated areas.
Many restaurants open only after iftar (sunset). Hotel restaurants remain open during the day for guests.
Dubai is still very much open to tourism during Ramadan — shopping malls, attractions operate (sometimes with adjusted hours). Nightlife after iftar can be lively.
Dress modestly when visiting public places during Ramadan.
