items: Hanoi Danang Ho Chi Minh City Tour

blocks.text: Book our Hanoi Danang Ho Chi Minh City Tour package and you're guaranteed to see the best of Vietnam. Your journey will begin from the cultural capital of Hanoi itself! Marvel at the ancient temples, colonial architecture, and beautiful lakesides that are its star attractions. Also, enjoy the luxe cruise across the Halong Bay which is beautifully surrounded by majestic emerald waters.

items: Route: HANOI ARRIVAL → HANOI - HALONG BAY → FLY TO DANANG - HOI AN → Full-Day Ba Na Hills Excursion → Fly To Ho Chi Minh - Cu Chi Tunnel → Mekong Delta

blocks.text: Once you arrive at the Hanoi airport, complete your immigration process and get your visa on arrival. Our driver will be waiting for you at the airport and will take you to your pre-booked hotel. Once you reach the hotel, check in and freshen up. Then get ready for the capital city tour. 13:30 : You'll be picked up by our driver and then taken to the Temple of Literature . This is the first university of Vietnam and was established in the 11th century. Do click snaps of its courtyards and ancient gates. 15:15 : Now, visit the Hoa Lo Prison Museum (aka "Hanoi Hilton") which showcases Vietnam's struggle for independence. You'll be surprised to know that this museum was actually once a prison used to keep political prisoners. 16:15 - 16:30 : Later, you'll be taken back to your hotel for an overnight stay. Places You’ll See

Savour a delicious breakfast in the morning. 08:00 - 08:30: Now a bus will take you to the scenic countryside to Tuan Chau Island in Halong City. Our guide will also be there with you. We'll also take a refreshment break during the journey. 12:00: Once you arrive at the Tuan Chau Harbor, our crew will give you a warm welcome aboard the cruise ship. A safety briefing will also be given to you. Get ready for a 5-hour journey on this tour where you'll get to enjoy the breathtaking landscapes, full of islets and outcrops, named after their unique shapes! Enjoy the authentic, delicious Vietnamese lunch on the boat while admiring the beautiful scenery. 13:45: You'll arrive at the Bo Hon archipelago . Deboard the ship and go for exploring the Surprising Cave (aka Sung Sot Cave). It houses impressive stalagmites and stalactites that resemble sea creatures! Now you can go kayaking or indulge in a bamboo boat ride in Luon Cave, and discover the beautiful lagoons. Later, visit Titop Island . You can enjoy the sandy beaches here that lie adjacent to the limestone Mountains. You can also take a trek to the top, from where you can get panoramic views of the whole area! 16:30: Return to your cruise ship, which will take you back to the Tuan Chau Harbour. During your journey back, indulge in sunbathing and music, and the natural scenery all around you. 18:00: Disembark from the cruise ship and you'll be taken back to Hanoi via the new highway. 20:00: You'll reach your hotel. Enjoy an overnight stay. Places You’ll See
Day 3: FLY TO DANANG - HOI AN

Relish a nice breakfast in the morning. After this you'll be transferred to the airport to take a flight to Danang . Once you reach there, check into your hotel and relax for a while. In the afternoon, get ready to explore the beautiful Hoi An Town. 15:00: This is a guided tour, and we'll arrange our guide to meet you at the hotel itself. Your Hoi An City Tour begins! The very first place on the itinerary today is the Hoi An Market . Get lost in its colourful sights, sounds, and smells! This bustling market is a must-visit if you want to do some real Vietnam shopping. Our guide will get you tickets to the Hoi An Old Town (included in your package). Explore here the Phuc Kien Assembly Hall . The vibrant Chinese architecture here will treat you with bright gates, dragon statues, and grand rooftops! Also, see the well-preserved old houses, like Phung Hung Ancient House and Tan Ky House . These homes are here for over 200 years and have withstood centuries of weather and war! You can also learn about the lifestyle of merchants that used to live here. Now, visit the Japanese Bridge , which is over 400 years old. This was originally constructed to connect the Japanese and Chinese communities who live on either side of the waters. Also, take a detour to the handicraft shops of Hoi An. You can explore the artwork galleries here. Lastly, in the evening, take a stroll on the lantern-lit alleys and enjoy a boat ride on the Thu Bon River . Tourists release the floating lanterns in the river to attract good luck. Do capture the reflections of the lantern-lit surroundings in the river. Take a restful night of sleep in your hotel at Da Nang. Places You’ll See
Day 4: Full-Day Ba Na Hills Excursion (40 km / 1 hr each way)

Start your day with a delicious breakfast in the morning. Now, you'll be taken to the Ba Na Hills , which is famous for everything from picturesque mountain scenery to entertainment complexes! Once you get there, take a scenic cable car ride and enjoy the breathtaking landscapes that lie along the way. Also, take a walk across the iconic Golden Bridge , which is held by the giant hands! Also, visit the following: French village with European-style buildings Flower Garden Amusement Park Wax Museum Later, enjoy a delicious lunch at the mountaintop restaurants, which serve a variety of Vietnamese and international cuisine. Later in the evening, you'll be dropped off back at the hotel, where you can take rest for the night. Places You’ll See
Day 5: Fly To Ho Chi Minh - Cu Chi Tunnel

Treat yourself to a nice breakfast in the morning. After this, check out of the hotel. Our driver will transport you to the Da Nang airport, from where you'll take the flight to the Ho Chi Minh City . Once you arrive there, relax for a while. You'll be taken to the Cu Chi tunnel in the afternoon (60 km ride). Along the way, you'll get to see rice paddy fields and lush greenery. Also, enjoy the ducks and water buffaloes that swim in the rivers. By 12:45 PM, you'll reach the tunnels. Admire this underground system of tunnels that span across 220 km! Discover the hidden chambers here, try the wartime food that the soldiers ate, and learn how the Vietnamese soldiers lived in these tunnels during wartime. You'll also have the opportunity to shoot the AK-47, one of the main guns used during the war. (Completely optional). The tour will finish by 7:00 PM, and after that, you'll be taken back to your hotel for an overnight stay. Places You’ll See

Relish a nice breakfast in the morning at the hotel. Around 8 - 8:30 am, your tour will begin. Get ready for a trip to My Tho city , which serves as a gateway to the Mekong Delta. Take the one-and-a-half-hour bus ride, taking in the lush's greenery all around you. Now, take a boat ride on the Mekong River , enjoying the floating houses and fish farms along the way. Do not forget to capture these beautiful moments. Once you're there, visit the coconut candy workshops and see how the coconut candy is made. Take this time to also visit the bee farms where you can taste the real honey! You can also enjoy the authentic Vietnamese folk music (Đờn Ca Tài Tử), which is also recognised by the UNESCO. After that, savour some delicious Vietnamese traditional lunch under a tree shade. Now, visit the Vinh Trang Pagoda which is the largest pagoda in the delta. The rest of the time is for leisure which you can utilise by discovering the region on your own. In the evening, you'll be driven back to your hotel by our driver. Enjoy an overnight stay at the hotel. Places You’ll See

Savour a hearty meal in the morning and check out of your hotel. Now, our driver will drop you off at the airport from where you can take a flight back home. This concludes your trip. Hope you have an amazing trip with us!

items: Hanoi – Halong – Da Nang – Hoi An Tour

blocks.text: The 5 day Hanoi - Halong - Da Nang - Hoi An tour will take you through Vietnam's most vibrant cities and have you witness the age-old heritage in one single trip! Your tour will begin from the bustling city of Hanoi itself! This is the cultural heartland of the country, and you'll see everything here from ancient temples to serene lakes to lively markets. This city is a living example where history meets modern charm. Take it all in before you start cruising for Halong Bay, which is all surround

items: Route: Hanoi - Halong Bay Day cruise - Hanoi - SIC → Da Nang - Bana Hills - Golden Bridge - Da Nang - SIC → Da Nang departure - No guide

blocks.text: Day 1: Hanoi arrival - Early check-in - Half day city tour (B) - Private

Once you arrive at Hanoi's Noi Bai International Airport , you'll receive a warm welcome from our tour representative. Now, you'll be driven to your pre-booked hotel in your private luxury vehicle by our driver. The journey will take about one hour. You'll reach there after 14:00 hours. Get ready to enjoy your half-day city tour in the afternoon. Our very first stop will be at the Temple of Literature - the very first university of Vietnam dedicated to Confucius. Enjoy the traditional architecture and the serene atmosphere here. After this, you'll be taken to the Tran Quoc Pagoda . This is one of the oldest pagodas in Vietnam. It's located by the West Lake , and the sunset view here makes for a perfect photo op. The surroundings here are really peaceful. Spare a moment to sit here and take in the whole serene vibe. Our last stop will be the Hoan Kiem Lake . Considered as Hanoi's pretty centrepiece, this place has legends at every turn of the corner. Plus, you get to see the vibrant street life here. After this, you're free to stroll through the bustling Old Quarter on your own. Discover the charming narrow streets and enjoy the vibrancy of the place. Return to the hotel for an overnight stay. Places You’ll See
Day 2: Hanoi - Halong Bay Day cruise - Hanoi (B/L) - SIC

8.00-8.45: You'll be picked up by our driver from your hotel in Hanoi Old Quarter/ Opera House, and will be taken to Halong Bay. On this three hour drive, we'll go through Hanoi, Haiphong, and Tuan Chau Highway. A 30-minute break will be taken on this trip for refreshments and relaxation. 12:00 : Once you arrive at the Tuan Chau Harbor, board the Luxury Cruise . You'll get our crew's full assistance for this. Relish the welcome drinks once you're on board. 12:30 : You'll be given the Vietnamese lunch on the boat. Enjoy your food while taking in the the beautiful scenery lined by limestone. 14.00 : Once you arrive at Bo Hon Island , deboard the cruise and visit the Sung Sot Cave . This cave has a lot of stalagmites and stalactites inside it and makes for a great exploration trip. 14.45 : Take a bamboo ride or kayaking through Luon Cave . You'll get to witness the beautiful lagoons here. 15.15 : Visit the picturesque TiTop Island and enjoy sandy beaches & swimming in the blue waters. You can also trek to the top of the island and have a panoramic view of the entire Halong Bay! 16.30 : Now get back to the boat for a trip back to the harbour. Enjoy a little sunset party with wine, tea, fruits, and biscuits on the boat. 18.00-18.15 : You'll reach the harbour. Now, get on the bus that will take you back to Hanoi. 21.00 : You'll be dropped off at the hotel. Enjoy the overnight stay. Meals : Breakfast, Lunch (local food) Notice : The cruise's itinerary depends on the specific cruise and The Cruise's program is object to be changed without notice by the cruise. Places You’ll See
Day 3: Hanoi - Halong Bay Day cruise - Hanoi (B/L) - SIC

Relish a nice breakfast in the morning. After that, you'll be driven to the Hanoi airport by our driver from where you'll take a fight to the Da Nang . Once you arrive at the Da Nang international airport. Our driver will warmly greet you and will drive you towards your hotel. (Check in after 14.00 PM) In the afternoon, you'll be taken on an adventure trip where you'll visit the Cam Thanh Coconut Forest . Enjoy a bamboo basket boat ride and float through serene waterways amidst lush greenery! You can also learn a local fishing technique or two! Later, you'll be taken to the Hoi An Ancient Town , which is also a UNESCO World Heritage site. Stroll through its narrow streets and see the traditional houses that line them. Also, take a trip to the old assembly halls while enjoying the views of the lantern-lit shops . Do not forget to see the following as well: Japanese Covered Bridge Tan Ky Old House Fujian Assembly Hall In the evening, take in Hoi An's magical aura. The streets get lit by the colourful lanterns - a sight to behold. Do take picture of its reflection in the Thu Bon River. Also, take a fun boat ride in the river. , Release paper lanterns into the water for good luck. After that, you'll be taken back to the hotel where you will enjoy your overnight stay. Places You’ll See
Day 4: Da Nang - Bana Hills - Golden Bridge - Da Nang (B/L) - SIC

08h00: Our tour guide will pick you up right from your hotel. Now, you'll be taken to the Ba Na Hills. 09h00: Enjoy the Suoi Mo cable car. This is one of the world's longest cable ride and you'll get to enjoy stunning mountain views along the way. 09h30: Walk across the iconic Golden Bridge . This 150-meter-long architectural wonder is held by giant stone hands. Also, visit the Linh Ung pagoda , where you can see the 27m high Buddha statue. Also, enjoy the following: Le Jardin Debay Wine Cellar of French Loc Uyen Garden Quan Am Cac Now, take the second cable car ride to Gare Debay, and reach the top of Ba Na. Enjoy a guided visit to the Fantasy Park where you can indulge in Love Swing, Skiver Pilot, Fire Racing Track, Bumper Car, Ghost House, and more! 12h30: Enjoy a lunch buffet at the hilltop restaurant there. 13h30 : Have some leisure time. Either rest or explore the surrounding areas. Now, hike to the Peak of Chua Mountain (1,487 m). Once you're there, visit the Ba Chua Thuong Ngan Temple . You can see the panoramic views of the entire Da Nang City from here. 15h30 : Now, return to the cable car station and get back to Da Nang. 16h30: You'll be dropped off at your hotel. The rest of the day is free for you to enjoy as you please. Have a restful night of Danang. Meals : Breakfast, Lunch (local food) Places You’ll See
Day 5: Da Nang departure (B) - No guide

Have a delicious breakfast in the morning. Now, you can either take some time to rest in the hotel or do some last minute shopping on your own. (Check out time: before 12:00) Later, our drive will drop you at the Da Nang International Airport from where you can take a flight back home. Capture the beautiful coastal views along the route. This concludes your journey. Hope to see you again soon!

items: Hanoi, Halong, Saigon, My Tho Tour

blocks.text: Explore the beauty and culture of Vietnam with this Hanoi Halong Saigon My Tho Tour Package . The journey starts from Hanoi, one of the favorite spot of every visitor. The main highlight here is Hoan Kiem Lake. The night view is completely amazing here, with colorful lights and a peaceful atmosphere.

items: Route: Hanoi - Halong Bay - Return to Hanoi → Hanoi - Fly to Saigon - Half Day City Tour → Saigon - My Tho - Saigon → Saigon Departure

blocks.text: DAY 01- Arrive Hanoi - Half Day City Tour

Start your Vietnam tour with a warm welcome at Hanoi’s Noi Bai International Airport. Our driver from My Quick Trippers will meet you and take you to the hotel, which takes around 50 - 60 minutes. If you book a guide, he will join the driver and help you the whole day. In the afternoon, start your half-day city tour and visit- Temple of Literature Tran Quoc Pagoda- One of the oldest Buddhist temple in Vietnam , located beside the beautiful West Lake. Hoan Kiem Lake After sightseeing, spend some free time exploring the Old Quarter, filled with streets and local shops. Overnight stay in Hanoi. Note- Breakfast is included. Hotel check-in time is 14:00 , but early check-in is already part of the package. Places You’ll See
Day 02- Hanoi - Halong Bay - Return to Hanoi (350 km/ 4-5 hours)

Between 8:00 and 8:45 AM , meet the driver at your hotel in Hanoi Old Quarter or at the Opera House (pickup point) to start your journey to Halong Bay . We’ll travel to Halong Bay through the Hanoi-Haiphong-Tuan Chau Highway. On the way, we stop for a short break of 30 minutes to relax. At 12:00 PM , reach Tuan Chau Harbor and get on the luxury cruise. The crew will welcome you warmly. Have a welcome drink before you start your journey. Around 12:30 , enjoy a tasty Vietnamese lunch on the boat as you pass through beautiful small islands on both sides. Don’t forget to click pictures! At 14:00 , reach Bo Hon Island and visit Sung Sot Cave , one of the most beautiful caves. As you step inside, you’ll see amazing, colorful lights - the view is so beautiful that you’ll truly enjoy it! (14:45) , try kayaking or take a bamboo boat through Luon Cave and enjoy the peaceful surroundings. 15:15 , reach Ti Top Island and relax on the beach. Go for a swim, or you can enjoy some time at the small cafes nearby. 16:30 , enjoy a sunset party on the boat with wine, tea, fruits, and biscuits while going back to the harbor (harbor means parking area for boats). 18:00-18:15 , arrive back at the harbor . Get on the bus and return to Hanoi . 21:00, you’ll be dropped off at your hotel after the tour. Stay overnight in Hanoi . Places You’ll See
Day 03- Hanoi - Fly to Saigon - Half Day City Tour (Approx. 1,160 km)

Have breakfast at the hotel before the driver takes you to the airport for your flight to Saigon . Once you land at Tan Son Nhat Airport our driver will meet you and take you to the hotel for check in after 2:00 PM. In the afternoon go to the Reunification Palace , where visitors can see old helicopters, war rooms and underground tunnels - a perfect spot for history lovers. Next, stop at the Notre Dame Cathedral , a famous old church built in the French style. Its beautiful design and calm atmosphere attract many visitors. Right in front, you can see the Saigon Central Post Office . Its architecture is excellent. Continue to the Sri Mariamman Hindu Temple dedicated to the goddess Mariamman. End the tour at Ben Thanh Market where you can enjoy shopping and try tasty local snacks. Have a peaceful overnight stay in Saigon . Places You’ll See

After breakfast, leave the busy city of Ho Chi Minh and proceed to My Tho , a peaceful town near the Mekong River. Upon arrival, visit Vinh Trang Pagoda - one of the oldest temple. Its large Buddha statues and beautiful surroundings will surely impress you. Then, enjoy a sampan boat ride on the river and see the four lovely islands – Dragon, Unicorn, Phoenix , and Tortoise. Keep your camera ready for this beautiful spot! At Unicorn Island, take a walk through small village paths, see how fruits grow, taste them fresh, and see local people singing folk songs. Enjoy a slow boat ride through the small river paths of Thoi Son Island . Visit a local honey-bee farm, taste fresh honey tea , and see how coconut candies are made. Have lunch at a local restaurant and take a short break. In the afternoon, you can go cycling around Tan Thach Village , meet the locals, and see how people live in this beautiful riverside area. If you don’t want to cycle, just relax on a hammock and enjoy the cool wind. Return to Ho Chi Minh City . Places You’ll See

Enjoy breakfast at the hotel. Your wonderful trip to Vietnam ends today. You may have a short time to shop before our driver drops you off at the airport for your return flight. Note- Check out time before 12:00

blocks.text: Travelling to Vietnam feels like turning the pages of an enchanting fairytale storybook. Our Hanoi-Ninh Binh-Halong-Da Nang-Hoi An Tour is an escape to some of the most serene corners of Vietnam. Your journey will start from the heart of Hanoi, where you tread the ancient halls of the Temple of literature and feel the delightful rush of trains passing just a foot away at the Train Street. Isn't it enchanting? The trail does not stop here. After the train view, you will visit the peaceful country
DAY 01- Hanoi Arrival - Early Check-In, Afternoon: Half Day City Tour (D)

Arriving at Noi Bai International Airport, our local driver (No Guide) will be at the airport to pick you up. You will be warmly welcomed and then transferred to check in to your pre-booked hotel room. The Check in Time will be 14:00 pm Note- Meals- Dinner (Indian Food) You will not get Early Check-ins and Breakfast options at the hotel in our Package. In the afternoon, you will enjoy a sightseeing tour of Vietnam . First, you will get a fascinating glimpse of Vietnam's heritage and royal past at the Temple of Literature. Then you will head to Old Quarter to explore Train Street and shops, cafes, eateries and enjoy exciting Nightlife. Sightseeing Outline Temple of Literature- It was built in 1076 and served as Vietnam's first university for 700 years. It was used to educate Vietnam's royalty, mandarins and members of the elite. Witness the beautiful well-preserved gardens and grand architecture which will take your breath away. Train Street- It's a famous narrow railway street located in the Old Quarter of Hanoi. Enjoy the thrill of trains passing by and sip an authentic Vietnamese coffee Old Quarter- Explore the beauty of centuries-old architecture, and rich cultural heritage and enjoy exciting nightlife. This place has 36 narrow streets which were traditionally named after guilds or trade that were famous there such as silk, silver, bamboo, cotton. Also visit some of the traditional shops to buy souvenirs. End your day with a peaceful stroll and witness a beautiful contrast of Hanoi's historical roots and rise of modernity. Places You’ll See
DAY 02- Hanoi - Ninh Binh - Hoa Lu Ancient Capital - Tam Coc (B/L/D)

Early in the morning after breakfast, we will depart from Hanoi and visit Ninh Binh province. It is 2 hours from the South of the City. Enjoy the Ninh Binh sightseeing Tour. First you will visit the ancient temples at Hoa Lư and then head to Tam Coc and enjoy a two-hour boat ride along the Ngo Dong River. Your next visit will be to the Bich Dong Pagoda complex. Note- Meals- Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner (Indian food) Overnight Stay at Hanoi Sightseeing Outline Hoa Lư Hoa Lư is one of the best places to explore in Vietnam . It's an ancient capital of Vietnam during the Dinh and Le dynasties (10th-11th century). Witness the mesmerizing ancient temples of King Dinh Tien Hoang and King Le Dai Hanh and get good insights of the city's rich history. Tam Coc It's is also fondly known as 'Halong Bay on Land' Board a traditional Sampan boat ride and enjoy a scenic 2 hours boat ride along the Ngo Dong River. From the serene waters, you will come across many scenic places like limestone karst mountains, lush rice paddies, and three natural caves that give Tam Coc its name. Bich Dong Pagoda We will not miss this beautiful Bich Dong Pagoda Complex. It is built on a mountain side near Tam Coc. See the three levels of Pagoda- Lower Pagoda, Middle Pagoda, and Upper Pagoda and the breathtaking views of nearby areas and countryside by climbing at the top. After the day tour of the natural and historical places of Ninh Binh, we will return to Hanoi in the late afternoon or early evening. Overnight stay at Hanoi to rejuvenate your senses. Places You’ll See
DAY 03- Hanoi - Halong Day Cruise - Hanoi (B/L/D)

Sightseeing Outline for Day 3 8:30 am- You will be picked from your hotel room to explore the beauty of Halong Bay. Today we will cover Hanoi- Haiphong- Tuan Chau Highway. It will be a 3 hrs drive. 12:00pm- We will reach Tuan Chau Harbor and get on a luxury cruise. You will get a warm welcome by our crew member. Enjoy a wholesome drink and start a delightful excursion tour to explore the breathtaking beauty of this heritage site. 12:30 pm- Savor delicious Vietnamese lunch on board while enjoying beautiful views on both sides. See beautiful limestones. 14:00 pm- We will discover Bon Ho Island and See Sung Sot Cave . It is one of the most beautiful caves with enchanting Stalactites and Stalagmites. 14:45pm- Through Luon Cave , enjoy the beauty of the Lagoon by Kayaking or Bamboo Boating. 15:15 pm- Also visit Titop Island with its scenic sandy beach. Try swimming or trek to the top to capture the beauty of the entire Halong Bay. 16:30pm- Return to the boat for a fun-filled sunset party which includes fresh fruits, wine, tea biscuits. While you enjoy the party, the boat will be cruising back to the harbor. 18:00-18:15pm- After arrival at the harbor, go to the beach to return to Hanoi. Enjoy Dinner. 21:30pm- we will return to the hotel room. Tour ends. Note- Overnight Stay at Hanoi Meals- Breakfast, lunch (local food on cruise), Dinner (Indian food) The itinerary of the cruise will depend on the specific cruise. The schedule of the cruise may be subject to change without any prior notice. Places You’ll See
DAY 04- Hanoi - Fly to Da Nang (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner)

After enjoying breakfast at the hotel, our driver will pick you up and transfer you to Noi Bai Airport to take a flight to Da Nang. After arriving at Da Nang Airport , our driver will take you to a restaurant to enjoy a delicious dinner. Later, take a rest to fine-tune your spirit at the hotel. Note- Meals: We offer Brunch (local food), Dinner (Indian food) Overnight Stay at the hotel in Da Nang Places You’ll See
DAY 05- Da Nang - Son Tra Peninsula - Linh Ung Pagoda - Cam Thanh Coconut Forest - Hoi An Ancient Town (B/L/D)

After breakfast, it's time for sightseeing. Sightseeing Outline Get ready to explore Son Tra Peninsula . Capture mesmerizing sea views. Visit Linh Ung Pagoda . It's famous for its display of a giant Buddha Statue, overlooking the city and the ocean. It's a place for solace seekers. Immerse in the natural beauty of Da Nang's and get useful insights on its cultural heritage. Head to Cam Thanh Coconut Forest for a day thrill. Enjoy Bamboo basket boat rides and glide through scenic waterways. Learn local fishing techniques and enjoy lush green views. Visit Hoi An . It's a beautiful ancient town and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Explore narrow streets, traditional houses, assembly halls and lantern- lit shops. Some of the major sites to explore here are- Japanese Covered Bridge, Tan Ky Old House, and the Fujian Assembly Hall. Explore the magical charm of Hoi An's riverside. As the sunsets, you will see the streets are illuminated with awe-inspiring lanterns. Enjoy a boat ride along the Thu Bon River and release paper lanterns into the water for good luck. Note- After sightseeing, go back to Da Nang hotel room Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner (Indian food) Places You’ll See
DAY 06- Danang - Bana Hills (Golden Bridge) - Danang (B/L/D)

Sightseeing outline for Day 6 Explore mountainous theme parks at an elevation of 1,500m high. It's a scenic hill resort developed by French people in the 1920's to enjoy cool mountain breeze and escape summer heat. Explore the cable car station at the foot of Ba Na Mountain . It's a first leg cable car which got two Guinness World Records in 2009 for being the longest non-stop cable car (5,042m) and highest non-stop cable car (1,292m). From above in the cabin, see the scenic treeline of forests, waterfalls, lush greenery along with pristine ecological systems of the Ba Na Mountains. Visit Le Jardin which is popular for old vineries and remnants of French villas. Explore Linh Ung Pagoda's 27 m high Buddha Statue and then leave for the second cable car station to visit the top of the mountain and see the remains of old villas. Witness the scenic peak of Chua Mountain at the height of 1,487m. From here, you can capture the whole view of Da Nang city. After that, visit the trail of Dreaming Stream, Rainbow Waterfall, Suspension Bridge, Golden Valley, and ruined Opera House. Play with old monkeys and take beautiful pictures with your family and friends. Take a leisure walk at the golden bridge amidst the foggy hills. Capture the scenic Da Nang city. After that, return to the cable car and get back to Da Nang for overnight stay. Note- Meals- Breakfast, Lunch (local food), Dinner (Indian food) Places You’ll See
Take your own leisure time until the tour guide takes you to Danang Airport for your flight to your home. Note- Meals- Breakfast

blocks.text: Start your trip with our My Quick Trippers Team. You will be welcomed at Delhi Airport / Railway Station then we will take you to Dehradun. Night stay- Overnight stay at a hotel in Dehradun.

Travel from Dehradun to Mussoorie in morning. On the way, you’ll see beautiful villages and small waterfalls, great places to pause and take photos. On arriving in Mussoorie, check into your hotel and freshen up. Later, visit Mussoorie Lake to enjoy boating. Now, walk on Mall Road to shop , try local treats, and watch street performances. Explore ,b>Kempty Falls , the best place to swim and relax in Also, in the evening, visit the Municipal Garden for a peaceful walk and see Lal Bahadur Shastri Academy with its impressive architecture. Stay overnight in a hotel. Note- Mussoorie Kempty Falls entry timing is from 6:00 am to 6:00 pm. Places You’ll See

blocks.text: Get ready for a spiritually uplifting journey to nurture your mind with the healing touch of divine in Haridwar and Rishikesh with scenic views of majestic Himalayan peaks and Shivalik ranges.

items: Route: Haridwar from Delhi → Haridwar – Dehradun - Mussoorie → Mussoorie - Dehradun - Rishikesh → Rishikesh – Haridwar - Delhi

blocks.text: Day 1: Arrival at Haridwar from Delhi (214km/5hr)

Welcome to Delhi. Our representative will pick you up from the airport/railway station and drive to Haridwar. After arrival, you will be transferred to your pre-booked hotel. Check in at the hotel and take some rest to rejuvenate your mind and body. Later, visit to some of the most famous places of Haridwar with your loved ones- Chandi Devi Temple- Situated at Neel Parvat, dedicated to goddess Chandi Devi. It is a siddha Peetha. Mansa Devi Temple- Situated at Bilwa Parvat, Mansa Devi Temple is dedicated to goddess Mansa. It is also known as Bilwa Tirth. Harihar Ashram- Feel inner peace at Harihar ashram. You can also stay here. Get the divine blessings of the sacred Parad Shivling. Daksha Mahadev Temple- Situated in Kankhal, the temple is dedicated to Lord Shiva. Bhuma Niketan- Located at Sapt Sarovar Marg, Bhuma Niketan is dedicated to Lord Shiva. Pawan Dham Temple- It is famous for attractive idols of gods and goddesses adorned with jewellery. You will also witness beautiful glass work on the temple walls. Vaishno Devi Temple- It is built as a replica of goddess Vaishno Devi of Jammu and Kashmir. Devotees from all over India come here to seek Vaishno Devi’s blessings. Doodhadhari Temple- The temple is a part of Doodhadhari Barfani Ashram. It is dedicated to Lord Rama, Devi Sita and Lord Hanuman. Bharat Mata Mandir- It’s a unique temple dedicated to India. India is represented here as mother. Evening- Take a ritualistic evening bath in the sacred Ganga River and dive deep into the spiritual vibes at Ganga Aarti. Places You’ll See

In the morning after breakfast, you will be driven to Mussoorie via Dehradun. Mussoorie is a beautiful hill station in the foothills of the Himalayas. It is also known as the queen of the hills. After arrival at Mussoorie, you will be transferred to your pre-booked hotel and take some rest. Later we will enjoy sightseeing at Mussoorie. We will explore- Mussoorie Lake- Enjoy boating and adventurous rides like giant swings, sky cycling etc. Municipal Garden- It is also known as Company Bagh. It has a beautiful mini lake with a waterfall. You can also buy amazing souvenirs from the small market located here. Kempty Falls- It’s a delightful picnic spot. The scenic 40 ft high Kempty waterfall will take your breath away. Gun Hill- It’s the second highest peak of Mussoorie. You can see the entire Doon Valley and majestic Himalayan ranges from this peak. Camel’s Back Road- Behold beautiful sunrise and sunset and embrace the beauty of nature. It is one of the most scenic nature sports for nature lovers. Mall Road- It’s a lifeline of Mussoorie. Mall Road is one of the best shopping spots to buy amazing souvenirs, eat delicious street food and sit for a laid-back evening. Places You’ll See

Morning after breakfast, we will reach Rishikesh, the Yoga capital of India. You will be transferred to your pre-booked hotel and take some rest. Later we will enjoy the Rishikesh sightseeing tour. We will witness- Ram Jhula and Laxman Jhula- Scenic suspension bridge over the sacred river Ganges. Sivananda Ashram- It was constructed by Swami Shivananda in 1936. It is one of the best yoga and meditation centres in Rishikesh to nourish your mind. Gita Bhawan- Located in Swargashram, it is the best place to sit and listen to religious discourses and meditate for peace of mind. Parmarth Niketan- It is one of the most famous Yoga centres in Rishikesh located on the holy banks of ganga river. Find your soul’s joy by doing a relaxing meditation. Add Ons- If energy permits, enjoy adventure activities like river rafting, bungee jumping or cliff jumping in Rishikesh (at your cost). Places You’ll See
After breakfast, the tour ends with happy memories. You will be driven back to the airport/railway station for further journeys.

blocks.text: Established on the banks of the River Ganges, Haridwar is a holy city located in the state of Uttarakhand. In addition, devotees come here to receive the blessings of the Goddess Ganga in order to lead a life full of prosperity and happiness. If you too want to seek the blessings of the Goddess Ganga, then check out My Quick Trippers's well-crafted Haridwar Tour Packages and set out on this divine trip!

This beautiful northern state attracts millions of travellers during the grand celebration of Kumbh Mela which is organised every 12 years. This beautiful northern state also holds a myriad of mythological tales and happens to be one of the four areas where Garuda spilled the drops of Amrit. Devotees visit this city with an unflinching faith all the time. To go on a comfortable trip here, simply book our Haridwar Pilgrimage Tour, and enjoy a smooth & convenient tour.

Also, we advise against buying your Haridwar Travel Package in the monsoon season (July–September), as the levels of the Ganga River rise during this time, which poses a risk. Therefore, it's best to avoid this season.

There are three main modes of transport by which you can reach Haridwar :

items: By Air : If you're travelling by air, then you can land at Jolly Grant Airport in Dehradun. From here, Haridwar is just 35 km away. Also, the airport is well-connected to all major cities in India.

By Train : Railways are another great mode of transportation to reach here. The Haridwar Junction here is well-connected to cities like Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, and Varanasi. Tickets can be bought from the IRCTC website.

By Road : If you're travelling by road, then get on the NH-58. It's a well-maintained highway and the journey is quite scenic too. Many buses also run from the cities of Delhi, Dehradun, and Rishikesh to Haridwar.

Things to Do on Haridwar Trip
Getting our meticulously crafted Haridwar Trip Package helps you experience the best of Haridwar in the easiest way possible. Here's what you can do here to make your trip worthwhile:

items: Get to know the huge significance of the River Ganga.
Explore the ancient temples dedicated to different gods and goddesses.
Visit the sacred Ghats like Har Ki Pauri and attend the evening Ganga Aarti.
Also, you get to visit several ashrams where you can interact with the priests who will tell you about the mythological tales of the city.

Soak in its spiritual environment that you won't find anywhere else. The moment you set your feet in the magical land of this religious city, you start hearing the enchanting prayers performed everywhere around the city!

On your trip to Haridwar, you get to witness the charm of several wonders established in the city including Har Ki Pauri, Bharat Mata Mandir, Mata Mansa Devi Temple, Anandamayi Ashram, Neel Dhara Pakshi Vihar, and there are many more in the list.

blocks.text: Top Attractions Covered in Haridwar Tour Packages

rows: Visit one of the most iconic Ghats of not only Haridwar but of the entire India! Enjoy the morning and evening Aarti here, where thousands of Diyas float by, creating a magical sight. Definitely include this in your Haridwar itinerary!
Dedicated to Goddess Mansa, this temple is believed to fulfil the wishes of the devotees. Moreover, pilgrims just love the scenic ropeway ride to the shrine. A must-visit on the Haridwar temple tour!
This temple marks the place where Goddess Chandi killed the demons Chanda and Munda. You can come here by both trekking and a ropeway ride.
Visit the temple that is associated with the immolation of Goddess Sati herself. Dedicated to Lord Shiva, this temple holds immense religious significance.
Take a peaceful retreat at this ashram, where you can engage in a session of meditation and even do some Yoga!
Founded by Baba Ramdev himself, this is one of the largest yoga institutes in the country. You can buy herbal medicines here and even Yoga gear. You can also participate in a yoga session here.

While the Haridwar local tour is all about spirituality and visiting the temples, you can always add a wildlife sanctuary to your itinerary! This park is home to over 400 species of birds. You can spot animals here like elephants, tigers, leopards, and more!

Here are some travel tips for your Haridwar sightseeing package:

items: The Haridwar trip primarily consists of visiting different temples. Make sure you wear modest clothes while going to a place of worship.
Wear footwear that can be easily removed at the temple gates. Slippers work best in this case.

If you're going to the market, make sure you have cash handy, as some vendors might not accept cards.

blocks.text: Book the Best Haridwar Tour Packages!

Haridwar is more than just visiting temples and ashrams. It's a journey to the divine and discovering the spiritual self! With our well-crafted packages, you can see the real Haridwar and experience its ancient charm like never before. Whether you're looking for a light Haridwar weekend getaway or an all-inclusive Haridwar luxury tour package, we provide it all! Book our package now or give us a call to know more about this sacred trip.
Q1. What is the best time to visit Haridwar?

Ans. The best time to go to Haridwar city is between October and February. The holy place experiences a moderate temperature and pleasant weather in this window, and therefore makes for an excellent time to come here. Also, before you leave for Haridwar, you must update yourself with its temperature and a go through a few travel guide to get detailed and authentic Haridwar tourist information.
Q2. What is Haridwar famous for?

Ans. Haridwar is nationwide famous for hosting various important spiritual events and being home to various temples. It's also reckoned as a gateway to various prominent places for devotees. Kumbh Mela happens to be one of the most auspicious events celebrated in the city. You must have heard of the beautiful Mansa Devi Temple, where devotees visit to fulfil their desires.
Q3. How many days are enough for Haridwar and Rishikesh?

Ans. In general, two days are enough to cover this trip. What most tourists do is set aside one day for sightseeing in Haridwar and the other day is reserved for enjoying adventure activities in Rishikesh.
Q4. How much is a taxi from Haridwar to Rishikesh?

Ans. Your taxi ride from Haridwar to Rishikesh doesn't cost you much, as the destinations are not so far. The taxi charges may range between INR 1,500 and INR 3,000, depending on the vehicle you opt for your road trip. If you are on a group tour, then going by the Haridwar tourist bus would be a better option.
Q5. How much does a Trip to Haridwar cost?

Ans. The Haridwar trip can cost you anywhere from INR 5,000 to INR 10,000. It depends on your travel duration and the level of luxury you're going for. My Quick Trippers offers you Haridwar Tourism Packages that are cost-effective and ensure you have a quality time on your trip.
Q6. What is the famous food of Haridwar?
Ans. While in Haridwar, make sure you enjoy Aloo Kachori, Jalebi, Rasmalai, Chaat, Samosa, Chhole Bhature, etc. These are few of the most liked food items in Haridwar.
Q7. Which is the famous temple in Haridwar?
Ans. Mansa Devi Temple is one of the most famous temples in the holy city of Haridwar. Although the city houses lots of temples, this is one of the most eminent shrines in the city!
Q8. Which God is there in Haridwar?

Ans. As the name suggests "Hari" i.e. Lord Vishnu, the city worships Vishnu. However, Haridwar is the land of gods, and there are various other gods as well that get worshipped with devotion here. Lord Shiva and Goddess Shakti are among the few main deities that are revered the most, besides Lord Vishnu.
Q9. What can I buy in Haridwar?
Ans. Haridwar is very popular for religious items. If you're looking for things like incense sticks, sandalwood, Rudraksha, etc., then you can find them easily here.
Q10. Which is better Rishikesh or Haridwar?

Ans. Both cities are beautiful and better in their own terms, and there is no comparison between them. The only thing that makes Rishikesh a bit more exciting is that in this city, you can enjoy some really enthralling adventure activities like bungee jumping, river rafting, cliff jumping, and more.

blocks.text: One of the most famous multi-day Honeymoon Tour in the Himachal. Mesmerizing Shimla & Adventure in Manali: explore Himachali cultures. Create Lifelong memories. We all go on many trips in a lifetime, but honeymoon is something special, always. Honeymoon is the most important trip of one’s life. It is the first journey of you two being together giving your lives a new start. It is meant to be more than perfect, as these memorable days of your lives ain’t going to return ever. In short, you plan it, we execute it. With our 10 days / 9 nights tour you have the most enticing and valuable offers for all the newlyweds. Bloom your love amidst the most fascinating & exquisite locations of Himachal the wonderland.
Day 1 : Delhi – Shimla (330 kms / Approx.9 Hrs)
You are greeted by My Quick Trippers representative and transfer you to Shimla, where on arrival, you will check into your hotel. The rest of the evening is at leisure, Overnight stay at Shimla.
Day 2 : In Shimla – Day Excursion to Kufri (20 kms / Approx. 1 hrs)

Morning proceed for the sightseeing of Shimla covering Kalbadevi Temple, Jakhu Temple, Hanuman Temple or stop for a while at the beautiful stained-glass-windows of Christ Church, which was built in the 1850 ‘s.

Afternoon excursion to Kufri a 30 Minutes’ drive from Shimla, an exotica of nature as a place surrounded by dense forest and snow caped mountains amidst virgin peaks and natures flora and fauna where one can completely relax and tune oneself for natural beauty, Evening free to enjoy the scenic beauty of Kufri. Fagu, Indira Gandhi Holiday Home and enjoy horse riding in the apple orchids. Return to the Hotel Rest of the day is free to explore various scenic sights or visit mall road and shopping, Night stay at Hotel.
Morning drive to Manali. Enroute visit Kullu valley, Beas River, Dashehra maidan etc. Evening free, Night stay in Manali.

The Kullu- is spread in the entire Kullu Valley which is lavishly gifted with superb scenic wealth. Kullu also known as ‘Valley of Gods’ has numerous temples. Kullu valley offers a scenic charm of peaceful wooded glades and rivers through the rocks. The Dussehra of Kullu is world famous. The ancient Hindus regarded Kullu as the farthest limit of human habitation ‘Kulantapitha’ and its original name finds mention in the epics, The Ramayana and Mahabharat as well as the Vishnu Purana. Kullu, which is located on the bank of river Beas is the Central point of this tourist complex. Running North to South, the main river valley is only 80 km. long and 2 km. at its broadest, yet a fairly wide area is open to the visitors to enjoy the spectacle of variegated mountain scenery. The deodar-fringed grassy Maidan, Dhalpur, is a stage for many colorful fairs.

Today morning, proceed on a day excursion to the Rohtang pass. If roads to Rohtang pass are closed, then visit snow point where ponies/horses can be hired directly, later visit Solang Valley where Himachal’s best ski slopes can be found( here you can enjoy paragliding, horse-riding, scooter riding etc. on direct payment basis). The rest of the day is free to explore this scenic town, Overnight stay at Hotel.

Today we will progress to Dharamsala. The plan for the day is to shop in the bazaar for Tibetan handicrafts. Here you can full your bags with exquisite Tibetan handicrafts, Tibetan carpets, garments and other trinkets. Stay overnight at hotel in Dharamsala.

Morning, after breakfast visit a quaint little town, Mcleodganj. Also known as “Little Tibet” Mcleodganj is the place of residence of Dalai Lama. Later transfer to Dalhousie. Overnight stay at Dalhousie.
Day 7 : In Dalhousie – Excursion to Khajjiar (23 kms/approx.1hrs)

In morning, drive to Khajjiar (commonly called as mini-Swiss of Himachal), a picturesque spot set amidst a backdrop of dense pines, deodars and lush green meadows. Khajjiar is exquisitely nestled down in the foothills of the imposing Dhauladhar ranges of the western Himalayas providing a panoramic and breathtaking view to the visitors. Khajjiar is part of the notified Kalatop – Khajjiar sanctuary. And later proceed to Chamba. Stands on the right bank of the river Ravi, It is well known for its splendid architecture and as the base for numerous excursions. Night stay at hotel.
After breakfast visit Dalhousie local, later drive to Amritsar. Evening you can become a part of Wagah Border. Overnight stay at Amritsar.

After Breakfast, Start your city tour with the blessings of Golden Temple-the most important Sikh shrine also known as Harmandir Sahib and Durbar Sahib. Then visit Jallianwala Bagh- the place that reminds every Indian of the brutal and heartless massacre by British general Dyer. Later Transfer to Chandigarh. Overnight at Chandigarh-Hotel.

Morning Visit Chandigarh Local like Sukhna Lake, Rock garden, later transfers to Delhi to catch your train for boarding onward journey. Thanks you for your patronage and looks forward to serving you again in the near future.

blocks.text: Best Time To Visit Himachal Pradesh

Himachal Pradesh is a best travel destination for all seasons. Your visit depends on the choice of activities you want to enjoy and places you want to cover. Ideally, March to June is the best time to travel to Himachal Pradesh . Here is a detailed overview of the best time to visit Himachal Pradesh

items: It is the best time to enjoy sightseeing of all the popular places of Himachal Pradesh. The weather is pleasant to enjoy the best Hill station tours as well as honeymoon tours in the mountains.
You can enjoy trekking, camping, paragliding, mountain biking in famous hill stations like Shimla, Manali and Dharamshala etc.
Festivals - Shimla Summer Festival, Sipi Fair, Minjar Festival, Shoolini Fair

It is the best time to enjoy a romantic honeymoon in Himachal Pradesh. Those who love winter will get mesmerized by the beauty of snow in various places of Himachal Pradesh. You can also enjoy trekking, snow related adventures in Manali, Kufri and Solan Valley.
During this time, you can also enjoy Bonfires & village stays. Many homestays and resorts in Himachal offer soothing bonfires, local food tasting, music nights and village walks etc.
Festivals - Halda Festival (Lahaul and Spiti), Losar Festival, Winter Carnival (Manali), Christmas, New Year.
It is also the best time to enjoy a sightseeing tour with family in Himachal Pradesh. You can also enjoy wildlife safari at Great Himalayan National Park and Renuka Wildlife Sanctuary.
Enjoy trekking to Pin Parvati, Triund, Hampta Pass, and the Great Himalayan National Park routes.
Try adventure activities like paragliding in Bir Billing and river rafting in Beas River.
Festival- Sazo Fair, Mandi Shivratri Fair, Kullu Dussehra, Hemis Festival, Diwali
If you want to enjoy lush greenery, cascading waterfalls and less crowd than Visit Himachal Pradesh in Monsoon.
Heavy rains and landslides may disturb your travel schedule but if you are tolerant of minor disruptions then you can enjoy the best monsoon views of Himachal Pradesh.
You can explore Jibhi, Tirthan Valley, McLeod Ganj, Kanatal and Chakrata and Chamba in Monsoon.
Festivals -Suketi Fair, Kanwar Yatra, Baisakhi Festival.

blocks.text: Best Places To Visit in Himachal Pradesh

In 2025, Himachal Pradesh welcomed around 9.99 million domestic tourists from all over India and 55,000 foreign tourists by September 2025, which shows it is one of the most visited tourist destinations in India. It is showing potential for growth for foreign tourists' arrivals. (Source- Amar Ujala ) Here are some of the best places covered in our Himachal Pradesh Travel Packages -

items: Explore the beauty of Shimla . It is one of the most visited tourist destinations in Himachal Pradesh.
Enjoy the colonial charm, scenic Mall Road, iconic ridge area. Explore some famous places in Shimla like Jakhu Temple, Kufri and Christ Church.
It is also the best place to try skiing and snowboarding, trekking, paragliding and camping etc.
Manali is best known for thrilling mountain adventures and fairytale-like setting. You must try skiing, river rafting, paragliding and trekking.
Explore famous tourist hotspots in Manali like Hadimba Devi Temple, old Manali village and hot springs at Vashisht.

Located near Manali, the beauty of this high- altitude mountain pass will take your breath away. It is also one of the best places for photography of the stunning snow-capped mountains and icy glaciers.
Enjoy adventure activities like trekking, skiing, mountain biking and snow scooter rides here. Rohtang Pass remains open from June to October. It is closed every Tuesday for maintenance.
Rich cultural heritage, natural beauty and spiritual vibes, Kangra Valley is a perfect blend of all and it is a must visit destination in Himachal Pradesh.
It is a perfect destination for travellers with varied interests. You can enjoy paragliding in Bir Billing and witness the beauty of Dhauladhar ranges.
Explore all the heritage places like Kangra Fort, Masroor Rock Cut Temples, Baijnath Temple and Kareri Lake.
Dharamshala and Mcleodganj are must not miss scenic hill stations in Himachal Pradesh. It is renowned for its Tibetan culture and spiritual significance for Buddhists and Hindus.
Dharamshala, winter capital of Himachal is famous for its lush greenery, pristine tea gardens and HPCA stadium which hosts IPL matches.
Mcleodganj is also known as 'Little Lhasa'. It is a residence of the 14th Dalai Lama and a center for Tibetan Buddhism.
Explore Kalachakra Temple, Bhagsunath Temple and Waterfall, Triund Trek base, Naddi View Point, and the serene Dal Lake.
Renowned as 'Valley of Gods' Kullu is a serene escape for travellers who want to enrich their mind by exploring the culturally rich region of Himachal Pradesh.
Explore the beautiful lush green valleys, scenic apple orchards, flowing Beas River and enjoy thrilling river rafting, trekking, hiking, mountain climbing, paragliding, and camping.
Explore Raghunath Temple, Bijli Mahadev Temple, Basheshwar Mahadev Temple, Manikaran, Naggar Castle and Parvati Valley.

blocks.text: Best Things To Do In Himachal On Your Trip
Not a single moment is dull when you are in Himachal Pradesh. There are many exciting activities to do here to enjoy the best moments of your life with your loved ones-

items: It is thrilling to soar above the lush green valleys of the scenic Bill Billing through Paragliding.
If you are in Himachal Pradesh, it is one of the best things to do.
It gives you the best chance to capture the stunning Himalayan landscapes from above. It starts from March to June, September to November.

blocks.text: Try River Rafting In Beas And Satluj Rivers

items: In Himachal, river rafting is one of the best adventure activities to do. The beauty of white water can be found nowhere else. Imagine doing river rafting in white water with waves which travel through the Himalayan Mountain terrains. Isn't it scenic and thrilling at the same time.
April to June is the best time to enjoy white water rafting. If you want exciting rapids then try it in September to early October.

blocks.text: Scenic Trekking Trails of Himachal Pradesh

items: If you are planning your vacation in Himachal Pradesh then trekking is an activity you must not miss. Himachal has some of the most beautiful trekking trails which are perfect for beginners as well as seasoned trekkers.
Try Triund, Hampta Pass, Pin Parvati, Kheerganga Trek and the Great Himalayan National Park trails for the best thrilling experience.
Himachal has India's only open- air natural ice-skating rink near Ridge area in Shimla. The charming rink is a beautiful place to try ice- skating.
Skate rentals and coaching for skating is available on site for assistance. December to February is the best time to enjoy this activity in Shimla.

blocks.text: Snow Adventure in Manali and Kufri

items: Himachal is the best place to enjoy snow adventure activities. Manali and Kufri are the two best places where you can enjoy the best of Snow adventure in Himachal Pradesh.
Enjoy skiing, snowboarding, snow tubing, and ice-skating during winter months for a memorable as well as thrilling winter vacation with family in Himachal Pradesh.

blocks.text: Explore The Heritage And Spiritual Sites

items: To understand the pulse of Himachal Pradesh, exploring spiritual and heritage places of Himachal Pradesh is mandatory. It is in fact the first thing to do in Himachal.

Explore some of the most popular spiritual and heritage places of Himachal like Hadimba Devi Temple, Kangra Fort, Jwala Devi Temple, Naggar Castle, Tabo Monastery, Baijnath Temple, Bhimakali Temple, Chintpurni Temple etc.

items: Best Time to Visit - Every season in Himachal Pradesh has its own charm. So, choose the best time according to your preferred activities. Choose March to June if you want to enjoy family holidays in Himachal Pradesh and October-February for cozy stays, snow and adventure activities.

What to Pack- Pack weather specific items for a comfortable journey in Himachal. For summers- pack light clothes and light jackets. For winters- layered woolens, thermals and heavy jackets are very important to pack.
Keep Documents Safe- Carry comfortable footwear and an anti-theft bag to keep important documents and cash.
Licensed Operators - You should hire only licensed guides and adventure operators for safety for enjoying trekking, rafting or paragliding etc.
Enough Cash- Carry enough cash with you as in most places ATM might not work or due to weak internet digital payments options might not be accessible.
Dress Code- Respect the local customs of the temples and places. Wear covered clothes while exploring any sacred site.
Responsible Tourists -Avoid plastic items, don't litter anywhere. Be a responsible tourist. It's our responsibility to keep the beauty of Himachal Pradesh intact.

blocks.text: For newly wedded couples there is nothing like a specialized and custom honeymoon tour package.When it comes to honeymoon destinations, there is no lack of bewitchingly beautiful natural places in India that can help in the blossoming of love.

Join our honeymoon tour packages along with other newlyweds or ask for a custom honeymoon tour especially created for you. We take care of everything, going as far as providing a custom flower decorated the room in one of the finest hotels in the destination of your choice for the first night. This is followed by a variety of experiences where you are taken around to view the sights, sample delectable foods and also get the time out to be alone together. If privacy and togetherness are what you desire, just in the lap of nature, away from the hustle and bustle of city life, then we recommend quaintly secluded resorts far from the beaten track.

If beaches are what stir your soul, we offer you the pick of beaches in Goa, in Odisha, in not so well known Andhra Pradesh where the crowds are few and of course Kerala. Why not head for Kutch? It has some truly secluded beaches along the coastline and a great opportunity to enjoy the Marine National Park. Beach honeymoons are perfect for winter weddings where you can cavort in the sea, carefree in the warm sunshine. On the other hand, you could consider the honeymoon in Kashmir, Himachal, and Uttarakhand even though it snows outside, a perfect excuse to light a fire and cozy up. Uttarakhand too has its share of tiny resorts where you can enjoy solitude and the warmth of love. Focus on each other while our tour arranger takes care of accommodation and transport. A cottage in a hill resort all to yourself? It is possible in our honeymoon tour packages for couples.

Joining a honeymoon tour is much better than setting off on your own. You do not have to worry about transport and accommodation or even food. You can just have a good time that will remain etched in your heart forever. Try Andaman for an exotic and memorable experience. It is so unlike any place in India. You can explore marine life underwater. You can set off to any of the islands and spend a day in isolation while being in the company of your beloved. The beaches of Kerala combine so beautifully with the backwaters of Alleppey. They are made to order for honeymooners. Try it and have a champagne honeymoon experience like nowhere else on earth. The Northeast is nature personified. Wherever you go it is lush green, the land of rolling valleys and undulating hills interspersed with lakes and rivers. Start with Darjeeling and progress to Manipur or Mizoram or Arunachal.

Think of your own honeymoon design and talk to our experts. They will put it all together for a smooth experience and the loveliest imaginable time of your life. We love honeymooners and go all out to make their time a breathtaking one through our amazing honeymoon tour packages.

blocks.text: If you think you’ve explored everything, then visit Kerala’s beautiful lagoons, traditional dances, calm backwaters, and welcoming people.

Start your Kerala tour as our My Quick Trippers team meets you at Cochin Airport or railway station and takes you to Munnar , one of Kerala’s most popular hill station . If a guide is included, they will travel with the driver and help you whenever needed. On the way, enjoy- Stunning scenery with rivers and waterfalls that make the place truly magical. Green hills and forests Beautifully arranged tea and spice gardens with a fresh, delightful fragrance all around. When you reach Munnar check into your hotel and rest. Feel free to explore the surroundings whenever you like. Stay overnight in Munnar. Note - Keep some cash; not all places accept cards or digital payments during journey.

After breakfast explore Munnar , a peaceful hill station with beautiful scenery. See the well-known tea gardens and walk through the green tea fields. Learn how tea leaves are grown, picked, and prepared, while also enjoying the calm surroundings (a great photography spot). Next, go to Mattupetty Lake and Dam , a popular place for boating (optional) and surrounded by scenic hills. Visit Echo Point and hear your voice bounce back- a fun spot for everyone. Visit Kundala Lake , perfect for relaxing and enjoying a picnic. Later, go to Rajamalai (Eravikulam National Park) and see the rare goat Nilgiri Tahr and known for its unique plants and animals. After a day of sightseeing return to your hotel and relax. Spend the night in Munnar . Places You’ll See

After breakfast, check out of your hotel in Munnar and travel to Alleppey . The town is well-known for its beautiful backwaters, small rivers, and green paddy fields. When you reach, go to your hotel and check in. Option 1- Stay at Hotel In the evening, enjoy a sunset cruise on Vembanad Lake (optional, at your own cost) and watch the beautiful sunset (Don't miss to click photos). Spend some time on Alleppey Beach , take a relaxing walk, and get a massage treatment there if you wish. Go to the local markets for shopping, purchase handmade items, and try delicious local food. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay in Alleppey . Option 2- Houseboat Stay When you arrive, check into your traditional Kettuvallam (houseboat). Enjoy a peaceful houseboat ride through Kerala’s backwaters, see the daily life of villagers, and the green paddy fields that make this journey truly special (try to make videos). Have freshly prepared meals served on the houseboat including dinner. Overnight stay on the houseboat for a new experience. Note- Mosquitoes may be present during houseboat trips. Carry a mild insect repellent, like lotion or spray, to stay comfortable and enjoy the ride. Places You’ll See
DAY 4: Alleppey - Cochin Airport (53 Kms/1 hrs)

Check out of your hotel after breakfast and travel to Cochin to continue your trip. Optional - Enjoy a sightseeing tour of Cochin- Explore Jewish Synagogue in Cochin and learn about the Jewish community. Visit the Dutch Palace ( Mattancherry Palace ) and see its beautiful paintings showing stories from the Ramayana and Mahabharata. Explore St. Francis Church , full of history and one of India’s oldest European church. Go to the beach near Fort Kochi and see people use Chinese fishing nets to catch fish. Explore the markets in Cochin and shop for handmade items and local products. Later transfer to the airport, bus station, or railway station for your departure. We hope you enjoyed your 4 days Kerala trip and made great memories! Places You’ll See

items: All India Chardham Yatra Tour Package

blocks.text: One of the most vital and extremely important pilgrimage circuits among Hindu Vaishnavites,

items: Route: Delhi – Haridwar → Haridwar – Joshimath → Joshimath – Badrinath → Badrinath – Devprayag / Srinagar → Devprayag / Srinagar – Rishikesh – Delhi → Delhi – Bhubaneshwar – Puri

blocks.text: Upon arriving at Delhi, your journey towards Haridwar will commence which will take 5 – 6 hours. Upon arriving in this holy town you will be immediately checked in to your allotted hotel. During late afternoon you will be guided to visit one of the most auspicious sites of panch tirth within Haridwar, Mansa Devi Mandir, which is set on top of Bilwa Parvat. After sundown, you will be taken for the evening Ganga Aarti at Har ki Pauri which is accompanied by the rhythmic chanting of prayers and mantras immersing the surroundings in deep devotion and spirituality. You will be spending the night in Haridwar. Places You’ll See

Early in the morning, you will be driven to Joshimath which is a 9 – 10 hours journey (depending on the weather and terrain conditions). Upon arriving you will be duly checked into your allotted hotel which will serve as the base for your trek next day to Badrinath. Pro Tip: Make sure to keep your luggage as light as possible and wear woolen clothing since no matter what month, it will be extremely cold. You are also advised to wear sports shoes for a more comfortable journey towards the holy temple.

You will be made to proceed towards Badrinath Dham temple and upon arrival, you will be required to take a holy dip in the Tapt Kund located close to the main Dham mandir. Everyone is required to do so before entering the temple for darshan. Later, after the completion of your darshan procedure you will be taken for an excursion of the nearby places like, Mana gaon (the last village of India located on the Indo-Tibetan border), Vyas Gufa (an ancient cave where sage Vyas is said to have composed the epic Mahabharata with Lord Ganesha’s help as a scribe), Charan Paduka (a rock containing the footprints of Lord Vishnu) and Bheem Pul constructed on top of Holy River Saraswati. You will then be made to head back to your allotted hotel in Badrinath where you will be staying the night. Places You’ll See

After completing the visit to first dham of the auspicious circuit, you will be escorted to Devprayag by road, which takes 8 hours to reach. Devprayag is an extremely pious town since it is located on the confluence point of Rivers Bhagirathi and Alaknanda giving rise to River Ganga. Upon arriving at Devprayag / Srinagar you will be immediately checked into your hotel where you will be spending the night. Places You’ll See

Your journey towards Delhi will commence by road in the morning, which is a 9 hours journey. On your way you will be stopping for darshan at Rishikesh (located 2.5 hours away from Devprayag). Finally, upon arriving at Delhi you will be checked in to your hotel and the evening time will be free for your leisure activities.

Your eastern leg of the yatra will commence in the morning when you will be taken to Bhubaneshwar via flight. The duration of the flight is for 2 hours 30 mines. Upon arrival at Bhubaneshwar, you will be escorted to Puri on a bus journey of 2 hours. Once you arrive there you will be checked in to your hotel right away where you will be spending the night. In the evening you will head on for darshan at Jagannath temple (the 2nd dham in the char dham yatra of India). Here you will be made to be a part of the evening Aarti and your darshan of the holy deity will be complete. Places You’ll See

Your journey towards Bhubaneshwar will commence in the morning via Konark (home to the famous Sun temple). From Puri the sun temple is located at a distance of 1 hour. This temple, dedicated to the sun god is a magnificent structure which was built in the 13th century. Available inside the temple is the holy mythological chariot of the sun god along with detailed architectural work. You will then resume your journey towards Bhubaneshwar, where upon arrival you will be taken to Parashurameshvara Temple, which was built in 7th – 8th century CE (one of the oldest existing temple in the state) and is dedicated to Lord Shiva. Your next destination will be the Lingaraj temple 9 and Mukteshwar temple – both of which represent magnificent architecture and immense spirituality which radiates from them. Finally, after a temple tour of the city you will be checked in to your allotted hotel for spending the night. Places You’ll See

Your southern leg of the Char Dham Yatra will commence today. You will be made to board the flight heading for Madurai in the morning. Upon your arrival in Madurai, you will be taken to one of the most famous temples in South, Meenakshi Amman mandir, which is a colorful and vibrant holy place and is dedicated to a form of Goddess Parvati, Meenakshi. After completing your darshan you will then be taken to a glorious 17th-century palace of Thirumalai Nayakkar, by King Thirumalai Nayak (king of the Nayak dynasty in Madurai). Located at a distance of 2 km from the Meenakshi temple this palace is an iconic representation of the grand architectural style. Your day of sightseeing in Madurai will conclude when you will be escorted to your hotel for an overnight stay. Places You’ll See

After breakfast, your journey towards the southern leg of the char dham yatra to Rameshwaram will commence. Upon arriving at Rameshwaram you will be immediately checked in to your hotel after which your sightseeing and darshan of the city will kick start. Starting with a visit to Rameshwaram temple which is the char dham centre in South. After completing your darshan here you will be taken to different temples like, Ramjharoka Temple, Ramanathaswamy Temple and Kothandaramaswamy Temple. All these temples are considered to be extremely pious and holy. Places You’ll See

Today you will be made to head back to Madurai which is a 4-hour road journey. Upon arriving at Madurai you will be checked in to your hotel where you will be spending the night. Evening time is free for you to do your leisure activities, like strolling in the nearby marketplaces for souvenirs or trying the local South Indian cuisines.

Your 4th and final destination for this all India char dham yatra will commence in the morning, by taking a flight. Once you arrive in Rajkot you will be duly checked in to your allotted hotel where you will be spending your night. During the evening time you can go on a kathiawadi food binge and buy some local souvenirs. *your destination will depend on the flight availability.

From Rajkot, you will set out to the land of Lord Krishna, Dwarka, which is located at a distance of 4.5 hours. Upon your arrival in Dwarka you will be taken for a brief sightseeing tour of the city starting with a visit to Rukmini temple (dedicated to Lord Krishna’s wife), Bet Dwarka which is also known as Shankhodhar which is actually an inhabited island on the mouth of gulf of Kutch at a distance of 30 km from Dwarka. Finally, you will be taken back to your hotel in Rajkot where you will enjoy the delicious local Gujarati cuisine Places You’ll See

Today you will be made to head on to Somnath, which will be a 6-hour road journey. En route the journey, you will be made to stop at Porbandar – birthplace of Mahatma Gandhi, where you will be made to visit Kirti Mandir and Sudama (Lord Krishna’s friend and devotee) mandir. Finally, you will reach Somnath (the western cardinal point) which will be your final (4th) destination for the all India Char Dham Yatra. During the evening you will be made to attend the aarti which is soul enriching and an opportunity which should not missed. After an auspicious visit to this holy temple you will be made to head towards your allotted hotel in Somnath where you will be spending your night. Places You’ll See

From this holy centre you will be made to head towards Rajkot, which is a 4 – 5 hours long road journey. Upon arriving here you will be checked in to your hotel and the evening will be free for you to do your leisure activities.
Today your all India Char Dham Yatra journey will conclude by escorting you to your location of departure from where you will head on to your preferred destination.

blocks.text: East or West, North or South, India does not lack wildlife sanctuaries and wildlife parks where you can indulge your wish to be at one with nature. India is vast; so you can pick a specific region and go off on a wonderful tour into the reserves to get a firsthand view and experience of the flora and fauna. India Wildlife Tour Packages come with an enticing repertoire of wildlife tours that will make you go into the hearts of forests and explore the exotic wildlife. Kashmir is better known for its breathtaking scenic beauty and you should visit the Dal Lake, Sonmarg, and Gulmarg at least once in your life. While here do not overlook the Dachigam Wildlife Sanctuary. Established in 1910 it has a unique topology comprising meadows, rocky cliffs, and grasslands as well as forests that are home to the Himalayan Black Bear, the brown bear, otters, leopards, deer, and innumerable birds.

Uttarakhand, on the other hand, is the land of gods and pilgrimages but it is also home to the Jim Corbett National Park, one of the largest parks with a wonderful of trees, hills, water bodies, and of course, animals ranging from elephants to deer and leopards to jackals not to speak of birds. There are facilities for accommodation outside the park and plenty of trekking trails inside. So, India Wildlife tour packages can let you explore the most endangered wildlife of the high Himalayas too. Travel eastwards and you will come across several nature parks but Kaziranga is a must-visit national park. Spread over 430 square kilometers, it is home to tigers, elephants, water buffalos, deer, and birds but the main attraction is the rhino. The Northeast also has Manas in Assam.

Go west and you have the choice of Sariska and Ranthambore National Park, home to the tiger and a far different experience from the lush forests of the North-east. Travel a bit south and west and you come to Sasan Gir, home to the last of the Asiatic Lion. From here you can go on to the arid regions of Kutch where the Marine National Park is located, one of the biggest of its kind encompassing drylands, swampy lands, seas, and islands. Go south and you have so many choices that it can be confusing. In Karnataka, you have the Dandeli and BR Hills wildlife sanctuaries, Mudumalai in Tamil Nadu and Periyar as well as Neyyar in Kerala. Whatever direction you choose, each wildlife park presents a different environment and experience. There are custom as well as standard India wildlife tour packages available here, a back-to-nature experience you will cherish.

blocks.text: Day 1: Arrival in Indore - Maheshwar - Omkareshwar - Ujjain (Approx. 300 km - 10 hrs)

Our tour representative will give you a warm welcome once you arrive at the Indore airport/railway station. Now, you’ll be taken to Maheshwar, where you’ll visit: Mahakaleshwar temple Ahilya Bai Fort and Palace Akhileshwar Temple (inside fort complex) Narmada Ghat (for boating) Now, proceed towards Omkareshwar, another Jyotirlinga of Lord Shiva). Once you get there, be in awe of the town, which is in the shape of an 'Om' symbol. Take holy dips in the Narmada River first, before proceeding towards the Omkareshwar temple. Have Darshan to your heart’s content and seek the Lord’s blessings in return. Later, you’ll be taken to the ancient Mamleshwar temple. This temple has its walls engraved with sacred inscriptions, dating back to 1063 AD! It was once given patronage by Maharani Ahilyabai Holkar, and today, it’s a protected monument of ASI. Now, get ready for Parikrama around the Narmada River. This 7 km circular journey on the stairs lets you enjoy views of several temples and ashrams along the way. Also, enjoy the beauty of the Hanging Bridge over the Narmada River. In the evening, take one last stop again at the Jyotirlinga Mahakaleshwar temple to attend its mesmerizing Aarti (if time permits)! Now, you’ll be driven towards Ujjain for the overnight stay. Enjoy a hearty meal at breakfast. Afterwards, you’ll be taken for a sightseeing tour in the holy city of Ujjain, where you’ll visit: Mahakaleshwar temple ISKCON temple Shakti Peeth Harsiddhi Temple Sandipani Ashram Bade Ganesh Ka Mandir Ram Ghat Finally, our representative will transfer you to Indore airport/railway station (as per your preference), from where you can continue your further journey. blocks.text: Jaipur was founded by Sawai Raja Jai Singh and is the capital of Rajasthan. Jaipur city has evolved into a great travel attraction in India and is one of the top three cities for being acclaimed Golden Triangle Tour along with Agra, the city of Taj, and Delhi, the capital of India. While traveling Jaipur tours you can visit the historical forts, flaunting palaces, full-of-life temples, brindle bazaars, and bouncy streets that have earned a special place in the hearts of the people. The uniqueness lies in the rusty pink color that envelops all the designs and the construction of the building has earned the city thus used the name, ‘The Pink City’. The pink color is meant to ‘welcome’ the Prince of Wales in 1876 and was beheld by the ruler Ram Singh II as a capable scientific way to cut down the biting blaze of the sun.

That was compulsory for everybody who was living in the old city to maintain this uniqueness of the city. The name of this city ‘Jaipur’ has dual attention – ‘Jai’ means victory and was also the first name of its maker while ‘pur’ meant city. The Govind Devji Temple is perhaps the most brilliant in the city while Galtaji Temple has natural springs to bluster it. There are three immense forts in the city Nahargarh Fort, Amber Fort, and Jaigarh Fort. The famous Jal Mahal is a perfect royal retreat while the extended castle of the City Palace recreated the times of Kings and Queens with its hilly exteriors and tasteful interiors. Hawa Mahal also become the icon of Jaipur tours.

Jaipur is one of the most famous tourist places in India. Every year, this city greets many people from all over the world. blocks.text: The Grand city of Jodhpur reverberates tales of the distant past in the barrenness of the desert. Jodhpur located in Rajasthan is popularly known as “The Sun City”. It is called so because it remains bright and sunny almost throughout the year. This city was founded by Rao Jodha (a chief) in 1459, and thus got its name Jodhpur. Previously this city was known as Marwar. It is the second largest city in Rajasthan. Jodhpur was partitioned into two divisions, namely the old city and the new city. A 10 km long wall surrounds the old city. Tourists from all over the world used to come and witness this sculpted city of Rajasthan located in the commercial heart of the city. Every element in Jodhpur reflects the deep architectural grandeur and great Rajputana history. Here you can witness the Mehrangarh Fort and the grand sandstone palace of Umaid Bhawan.

Jodhpur offers a lot of tourist destinations namely the Mehrangarh Fort, Umaid Bhavan Palace, Jaswant Thada, and Rai ka Bag Palace. The Mehrangarh Fort in Jodhpur soaring to about 125 meters offers an amazing architectural spot to be visited by travelers. With many graceful palaces, forts, and temples, Jodhpur brings alive the remarkable historical greatness, art, music, and tradition of people that have failed to allure travelers, since time immortal. The Jodhpur lifestyle is simple and traditional, displaying the royal India tradition. The people in Jodhpur wear costumes that are artistically designed and fabricated. The colorful festivals and the rich culture have always attracted tourists from around the entire globe. One of the important festivals is the Marwar Festival which is celebrated yearly and is one such impressive bonanza.

The Balsamand Lake and Gardens in Jodhpur is an idyllic places for excursions. Jodhpur in Rajasthan is also home to many fascinating temples. The Sun Temple, Kali temple, Sachiya Mata Temple, etc. are some of the prominent temples in Rajasthan. blocks.text: Travel straight to the heart of Assam with this 5-day Jorhat Majuli Kaziranga Tour Package ! In this trip, you’ll get to be up close with Assam‘s culture.

Whether it’s the unique cuisine or its culture reflected through art performances & the ancient craft techniques dating back centuries, this eastern land never leaves a single soul untouched! And that’s not all – the place has a regal touch to it. From its colonial bungalows to charming tea estates, there’s really a lot to be amazed with!

And just when you think your trip can’t get any better, we’ll take you to the best wildlife adventure. Enter Kaziranga National Park , a place that boasts of a high density of tigers and the endangered one-horned rhinoceros! Enjoy elephant safaris, jeep safaris, or both – you’re in for the time of your life. Moreover, the stunning Orchid Park here will give you enough photo ops to flaunt the pictures on your stories! By the way, our well-crafted itineraries are ideal for a trip down here and see the best of the best that this place has to offer. Wait no more, call us now and set out on this one-of-a-kind trip!
